chapters.title: Chapter 3380 A Dream of a Different Tune! IV
paragraphs: Archimedes affirmed a terrifying truth as he had been out of it for a whole day, his mind coming to as he found himself on a soft bedding made from the feathers of a dead Phoenix, the visage of Lacana snuggled up beside him while covered by a seam of feathers as she slept peacefully.
On the bedding, he raised his stellar obsidian hands to look at himself as at this time, he felt a sense of disconnect.
As if he knew this body wasn't his, and that it was very real somewhere else entirely.
His eyes became unbearably cold at such a distinction!
Years continued to pass after Archimedes confirmed the state of things, and the war reached a critical juncture.
On a certain day.
10 years into the Megalos War against Nihilos.
In a region of white, gray flames burned all around as massive winged Nematodes led by titanic Nihilos Poxviridae faced the armies of the Great Instrument of the Beyonder.

The Nihilos Poxviridae looked like massive round blobs burning with gray flames, white wings expanding behind them as there were hundreds at the Existence Severing stage looking coldly towards the cluster of Outerversal Morphons, Antediluvian Leviathans, and other races of the Megalos Beyond and Megalos Ynnere!
Archimedes and Lacana were in the middle of their army as Lacana's gaze was cloudy on this day, her voice light.
"I've heard some weavings about this battle, if...if I do not make it, know that you have my heart with you, always."
She raised a foreboding flag right before the battle began as not even seconds later...
CAA!
The white space behind the massive Nihilos Poxviridae split as an aura far exceeding Existence Severing bloomed!

A terrifying Nihilos Marburg worm-like creature appeared- its aura rising to terrifying levels as even the Great Demolisher and other Existence Severing entities on the armies of Ynnere and Beyond turned pale.
This...was a Pioneer!
|Insatiable Ants!|
HUUUM!
|I curse you with endless decay!|

A ring of terrifying gray brilliance erupted from it and spread out towards the army, the Existence Severing entities roaring out with shock and hatred as above them, the skies split again as a stellar obsidian hand stretched out.
It smashed away the oncoming gray brilliance, but some still turned into tendrils of gray lightning that smashed chaotically across the Legions of Ynnere and Beyond!

Any entity that was touched by this terrifying gray brilliance roared out in terror and shock as an Existence Severing Antediluvian Leviathan whose skin shone with purple splendor saw his body shaking as bubbles of pus began to erupt all over him, his weavings rapidly deteriorating.

He had severed his existence as very little could affect him, and yet the tendrils of gray flames bypassed his natural barrier that isolated his existence, jumped onto him, and now he felt like his very weavings were unraveling!
His skin split open as he began to bleed gold blood, this blood turning vile and gray as it became pus moments after.

His mental state rapidly began to deteriorate as his vision gradually faded- utterly horrific events unfolding just seconds after a Pioneer of Existence made a move- even when a large part of its attack was blocked!
The few tendrils that managed to pass through affected everyone alike, whether they were Existence Severing Entities or those that were One With Existence!
A sliver of a tendrils shot out among many as its tremendous speed clashed with multiple entities, until the last shred of it flashed before Archimedes.
It radiated a vile brilliance that would take down at least one more entity, but the moment it was about to strike...
SAA!
The visage of Lacana appeared before Archimedes as her back was slashed open by the gray flames.
Her expression was one of sadness and resignation, her skin rapidly beginning to peel as her existence broke down from a mere residual attack of a Pioneer of Existence!
In the middle of all this, Archimedes bent down and held the body of Lacana while billowing out, seeing her rapidly dissolving existence as in her last moments, she held a smile.
"You've...been different these last few years, but they were among the happiest I've had..."
WAA!
Her Ordinance that was fused with her was dismantled and decayed as in a short few seconds, her whole body turned into gray sludge.
Archimedes held what remained as he felt a sense of desolation, raising his head above and roaring as there, in the distance, terrifying entities were facing off.
Every time they came in contact, existence tumbled and shook as if behemoths were treading through it!

The Nihilos Marburg Pioneer roared out with brilliance as it faced a titanic humanoid obsidian Pioneer of Existence, their battle holding mysteries and profundities others could even easily discern as at times, they seemed frozen in place, and at other times, their figures were only flickers of light that couldn't even be seen by the eyes of Existence Severing entities!

But the results of their clash were known far too quickly, a gap in power existing between the two as shockingly, a cry split apart the space of Nihilos, the titanic body of the Outerversal Pioneer briefly appearing in the skies with its obsidian chest cracked.
BOOM!
Pristine globules of blood bloomed from it that the terrifying Nihilos Marburg devoured, but a few globules of blood rolled out and scattered.
One smashed onto an enraged Archimedes as the pressure and weight of this globule of blood alone nearly shattered his existence, his figure thrown far back before he came to a stop.
When he came to, he only found himself grasping and holding a single globule of stellar obsidian blood that trembled with shocking complexity, and above...
The body of a Pioneer was entirely split open as a Nihilos Marburg fed on it rapidly!

The scene left the armies of Ynnere and Beyond in shambles as they all roared to retreat, with the terrifying Pioneer of Existence above not allowing such a thing to happen as it was about to move to massacre!
At such a time.
HUUM!
Existence shook and tumbled as it came with a heavy symphony, space becoming torn open as the terrifying pressure of a creature unheard of in the Megalos bloomed.
The escaping Outerversal Morphons stopped and became elated as they called out.
|The Great Instrument!|
|The Sword of the Beyonder!|
They called out with hope and fervor as terrifying weavings erupted out.

The Nihilos Marburg gazed up with a sense of somberness and trepidation as amidst the billowing eruption of weavings, the visage of Archimedes shook uncontrollably when they appeared as his consciousness became extremely heavy.

The appearance of the coming aura seemed to have triggered something as the moment it bloomed, it actually didn't even focus on the opposing Pioneer of Existence, but instead in the far back Legions where the body of Archimedes held a drop of blood of a Pioneer!
A terrifying intent of the Great Instrument bloomed with immense rage as if it recognized something within Archimedes, but before anything else could occur...
BOOM!
The lids of Archimedes that were already far too heavy closed, and a heavy dream came to an end!

chapters.title: Chapter 3381 Appaling Complexity! I
paragraphs: Inside a certain Dream.
BOOM!
The moment the lids of Archimedes closed, a unique weaving was forever lost within him.
Inside that moment, an expression of relief and sadness overcame Archimedes as near him, the globule of blood of a Pioneer shockingly warped and disappeared from existence entirely!

And an instant later, the terrifying will of the Great Instrument of the Beyonder wrapped around Archimedes- an unfathomable light of pressure and complexity cascading down as the body of Archimedes became crushed into obsidian paste.
The Will within it was decimated, with the weavings of the Great Instrument of the Beyonder seemingly searching for something inside these collapsed weavings as it couldn't find it!
HUUM!
Its weavings shook with interminable complexity as in the distance, the Nihilos Marburg, a Pioneer of Existence became stern as ever so cautiously, it backed away.

The Nihilos Marburg held terrifying weavings of power as a Pioneer, and it regarded the visage of the Great Instrument of the Beyonder with Great caution- even gazing around it as it kept its eyes peeled!
This creature had to have the support of other Pioneers to be able to do what it did with Ynnere, and now the war it was waging against Nihilos.
So the body of the Pioneer of Existence, Nihilos Marburg, looked around cautiously while a large part of its intent was still focused on the veiled visage of the Great Instrument of the Beyonder!

The aura of that entity that was for some reason enraged with someone on its own side was stifling, and it didn't even pay attention to the Nihilos Marburg at this moment as above its massive veiled obsidian visage, the barely observable body of the Great Instrument of the Beyonder vibrated as a terrifying rune swelled up above it.
It was a rune radiating intense fervor and power that read...AMARANTOS!
Amarantos.

But it was extremely solid and filled with complex smaller runes that constantly shifted and changed, with its radiance being so luminous as if it could be used to dream of a terrifying number of things!
It radiated terrifying complexity above the Sword of the Beyonder as at this time, barely a glimpse of its intent could be discerned.
|I will find you.|
|I will find you!|
BOOM!
The massive Rune of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos flashed again and again rapidly as if it were seeking a specific direction- for a specific dream, but it wasn't able to find it.
Terrifying weavings of complexity erupted as a certain Dream...supposedly continued to unfold long after the weavings of Archimedes perished!
The Great Segregator felt her Severed existence trembling as it continued to support the storm of weavings around the Instrument of the Beyonder these past few minutes.
With every passing second that she stabilized her Severed Domain, a burst of complexity erupted from it that reinforced her weavings again and again in ways she didn't know were possible!
The reinforcement felt entirely unique and new as if she had never come across it before in all her cycles of life.

She could feel her degree of complexity increase substantially with every passing second, her emotions unable to jump from alarm to euphoria as she felt like if she didn't focus for even a moment, everything would collapse.
And now...
HUUM!
A burst of obsidian light flashed as the dazzling rune of Amarantos above the Instrument blared with brilliance.
The Great Segregator wanted to curse as she could feel complexity building up again- almost as if for one last burst.
What the hell was happening now?!
Within the Severed Domain.
Eyes alongside a Will fluttered with brilliance as an array of words rose.

|Even with the initial low level of proficiency of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos, an unsurpassable dream of unique weavings of Existence was experienced due to a convergence of multiple factors.|
|This Unsurpassable Dream has been brought to an end after weavings potentially harmful to you made themselves present.|
|Your proficiency in the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos has been elevated to the Fourth Echelon, with your Proficiency at 88%.|
|Based on this, the weavings of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos you can obtain are somewhat exceptional.|
|All memories of the Unsurpassable Dream are retained.|
The memories of Archimedes flashed within the mind of Ozymandias.
His weavings.
His love for the tragically lost Lacana!
His ambition.
All of it came and went far too quickly. And in the end, all of it collapsed.
Thinking of this, Ozymandias couldn't help but feel melancholic as he knew that Dream...was far too real!
There was a Lacana. There was an Archimedes. And now, their weavings were forever collapsed and gone.
His weavings vibrated brightly as the prompts continued.
|The Weavings of this single Dream can be retrieved, with two out of three components viable for retrieval due to the current Proficiency of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos.|
|The Components of the Dream capable of being chosen are as follows.|
|Outerversal Physiology Echelon VIII, Megalos Regnum Echelon VIII. 3 Billion Pure Delegatus Channels.]
[Weavings and Research of dozens of Source Complexity of Entities from the Megalos Nihilos. The Full Sword of the Megalos Transcendent Megalos Ability.]
[A Single Globule of Blood of a Pioneer.]
Three dazzling singularities wondrously rose before his eyes as he had to choose between them.
Ozymandias only glanced at them for a moment before the choice was made.
[The full weavings of a Single Globule of Blood of a Pioneer have been retrieved]
[The Full Weavings and Research of dozens of Source Complexity of Entities from the Megalos Nihilos and The Full Sword of the Megalos Transcendent Megalos Ability have been retrieved.]
[Part of the Dream of Outerversal Morphon Archimedes, the Great Titan, has been forever lost.] ...!
Choices were made.
And from these choices, came consequences!
BOOM!

Within the Severed Domain, the voice of the Great Segregator rose up as it felt tumultuous waves of complexity erupting out- a terrifying aura briefly flashing within her space that caused even her to feel trepidation!
It was an aura that far exceeded Existence Severing- its brief flash of brilliance causing her to shudder as just as quickly as this brilliance appeared...it faded!

chapters.title: Chapter 3382 Appalling Complexity! II
paragraphs: A brief appearance of a truly complex brilliance!

Within the Severed Domain, the Great Mother was closest to Ozymandias as she felt it the most, her visage that was benefiting greatly from this phenomenon standing powerfully at Ordinance Amalgamation as she was able to catch a glimpse!
She saw.
She saw the appearance of a heavy and bright globule of blood that could not belong even to an Existence Severing entity, and it had to be the blood of something far more pristine than that.

Her existence seethed as her tendrils turned blood red- blinded by an intense greed and want that almost made her voraciously surge towards the Instrument of the Beyonder and obtain this globule of blood for herself!
She was horrified by such a thought as she quickly controlled her existence and regained her lucidity.
She almost wanted to bellow out towards the Instrument of the Beyonder for him to reap the rewards of whatever that was before too many eyes turned towards their direction!
That drop of blood.
It caused her to remember the sensation she felt many, many cycles ago when she caught a brief glimpse of that man.
The Great Beyonder himself.
The inkling she got when she gazed at that Great being from afar!
Yet as soon as that flash of a globule appeared, it disappeared just as quickly.

And the body of the Instrument of the Beyonder began to pulse and hum as if trillions of ancient beasts were rioting under his skin, bursts of terrifying pressure and complexity erupting around him as his weavings became utterly intense!
Intense and so bright that the tendrils of the Great Mother observing everything and siphoning off some of the gains within this space were forced to pull back.
BZZZT!
The spare around him flickered as his erupting complexity was reigned in, as if a titanic beast that had unleashed its aura was being closed off in a deep space and sealing everything momentarily.
Only then did his eyes open wide as above, the dazzling rune of Amarantos faded!
|An Impossible boon is coursing across your weavings of Existence.|

|Stemming from a distant Dream, a drop of blood that contains the scattered Severed weavings of existence and scattered path of a Pioneer flows within you and is becoming assimilated into your existence.|
|Your own complexity is rising by a large amount, your Outerversal Physiology and Megalos Regnum advancing within tremendous leaps.|
His Megalos Regnum and Outerversal Physiology.
There was a reason why he didn't choose those of Archimedes that had already attained the Eighth Echelon!
He had an inkling that the assimilation of the drop of Blood of a Pioneer may just get him there.
There was that, but it was not all.
Something he entirely did not expect.

|The scattered Severed weavings of existence and scattered path of a Pioneer have been determined to belong to the Great Pioneer, Ashandus. On the 100th Cycle of his life, he severed all attachments and weavings that bound him, attaining a Severed State of Existence. On the 200th Cycle of his life, he finished roaming the vast Megalos Beyond and finally Pioneered his own weavings above Severing. A drop of his blood has generated the capability for you to Sever a single, small aspect of your own weavings, including but not limited to Individual Concepts, Individual Values, Individual Techniques...|
|Anything Severed will be unshackled from the common norms of existence, even allowing you a sense of definition for the individual severing.|
Ozymandias gazed at the brilliance of the blood coursing through him as his Regnum buzzed with grandiosity.
He could choose to sever a small, individual part of himself.
Not something as major as the soul or origin.
Not something that made up a core part of him.
Something individual.
Something small.
But even this was utterly insane as what did it mean to Sever?

This was something only possible after one had their entire existence amalgamated to a single thing- with their complexity raised to a terrifying level as only then could they have the chance to sever their entire existence
The single Drop of Blood of a Pioneer...actually granted such an obscene capability!
HUUM!
As the weavings of Ozymandias buzzed.
The space they were in flickered and trembled as they felt a rejective force taking them out.

The Great Mother and Ozymandias alike were spat out of a massive swaying flower whose face was panting at this moment, tendrils of stellar obsidian authority surging around it as its complexity had experienced a major jump!
Yet its expression was ashen and filled with alarm at this moment as its face stared towards Ozymandias somberly.
It had to eject them.
Because at this moment, in her small domain within the Blancverse, dozens of eyes had appeared and were staring towards her.
Towards them!

The auras terrifyingly raged from Ordinance Amalgamation to Existence Severing- multiple Great Ones appearing in this region as they were all drawn in by the shocking amount of complexity exploding here.
And they were further pulled in by the flash of a brilliance that came and went for the span of an instant!
But at this moment, it all faded.

The Great Segregator panted as at this moment, she realized just how tremendously her complexity had risen as she looked towards the calm visage of an obsidian humanoid Outerversal Morphon and spoke out.
|What brings so many faces to my domain? We are merely aiding the Instrument of the Beyonder in his rise of complexity!|
She could sense their voraciousness.
So she spoke out with a burst of complexity to remind them where they were, while her massive swaying body appeared in front of Ozymandias!
At this moment, as she felt her elevated complexity, she had thoroughly become a believer.
He was the Instrument of the Beyonder? Sure, why not!

If he could do what he just did within her domain again- and this time she would be even better prepared to ensure her Severed Domain did not come to a risk of collapse, then she would believe any status he was giving himself.
At her words, half the crimson eyes peering here pulled back and faded.
Another half remained a little longer, as a few began to come forward- their auras not showing any hostility.
|Great Segregator, Great Mother, why did we not get alerted that the Instrument of the Beyonder was here? We would have joined in the celebrations.|

A massive obsidian Deep Pantheon Octopus floated forward, others coming forward alongside it as they wanted to understand just which Outerversal Morphon had walked into the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse!

As for the being in question, 90% of his weavings weren't even focused on the pleasantries of Ordinance Amalgamation and Existence Severing entities- they were on the musings of the drop of Blood of a Pioneer coursing through him!

sentences.text: A brief appearance of a truly complex brilliance!

Within the Severed Domain, the Great Mother was closest to Ozymandias as she felt it the most, her visage that was benefiting greatly from this phenomenon standing powerfully at Ordinance Amalgamation as she was able to catch a glimpse!
She saw.
She saw the appearance of a heavy and bright globule of blood that could not belong even to an Existence Severing entity, and it had to be the blood of something far more pristine than that.

Her existence seethed as her tendrils turned blood red- blinded by an intense greed and want that almost made her voraciously surge towards the Instrument of the Beyonder and obtain this globule of blood for herself!
She was horrified by such a thought as she quickly controlled her existence and regained her lucidity.
She almost wanted to bellow out towards the Instrument of the Beyonder for him to reap the rewards of whatever that was before too many eyes turned towards their direction!
That drop of blood.
It caused her to remember the sensation she felt many, many cycles ago when she caught a brief glimpse of that man.
The Great Beyonder himself.
The inkling she got when she gazed at that Great being from afar!
Yet as soon as that flash of a globule appeared, it disappeared just as quickly.

And the body of the Instrument of the Beyonder began to pulse and hum as if trillions of ancient beasts were rioting under his skin, bursts of terrifying pressure and complexity erupting around him as his weavings became utterly intense!
Intense and so bright that the tendrils of the Great Mother observing everything and siphoning off some of the gains within this space were forced to pull back.
BZZZT!
The spare around him flickered as his erupting complexity was reigned in, as if a titanic beast that had unleashed its aura was being closed off in a deep space and sealing everything momentarily.
Only then did his eyes open wide as above, the dazzling rune of Amarantos faded!
|An Impossible boon is coursing across your weavings of Existence.|

|Stemming from a distant Dream, a drop of blood that contains the scattered Severed weavings of existence and scattered path of a Pioneer flows within you and is becoming assimilated into your existence.|
|Your own complexity is rising by a large amount, your Outerversal Physiology and Megalos Regnum advancing within tremendous leaps.|
His Megalos Regnum and Outerversal Physiology.
There was a reason why he didn't choose those of Archimedes that had already attained the Eighth Echelon!
He had an inkling that the assimilation of the drop of Blood of a Pioneer may just get him there.
There was that, but it was not all.
Something he entirely did not expect.
|The scattered Severed weavings of existence and scattered path of a Pioneer have been determined to belong to the Great Pioneer, Ashandus.
On the 100th Cycle of his life, he severed all attachments and weavings that bound him, attaining a Severed State of Existence.
On the 200th Cycle of his life, he finished roaming the vast Megalos Beyond and finally Pioneered his own weavings above Severing.

A drop of his blood has generated the capability for you to Sever a single, small aspect of your own weavings, including but not limited to Individual Concepts, Individual Values, Individual Techniques...|
|Anything Severed will be unshackled from the common norms of existence, even allowing you a sense of definition for the individual severing.|
Ozymandias gazed at the brilliance of the blood coursing through him as his Regnum buzzed with grandiosity.
He could choose to sever a small, individual part of himself.
Not something as major as the soul or origin.
Not something that made up a core part of him.
Something individual.
Something small.
But even this was utterly insane as what did it mean to Sever?

This was something only possible after one had their entire existence amalgamated to a single thing- with their complexity raised to a terrifying level as only then could they have the chance to sever their entire existence
The single Drop of Blood of a Pioneer...actually granted such an obscene capability!
HUUM!
As the weavings of Ozymandias buzzed.
The space they were in flickered and trembled as they felt a rejective force taking them out.

The Great Mother and Ozymandias alike were spat out of a massive swaying flower whose face was panting at this moment, tendrils of stellar obsidian authority surging around it as its complexity had experienced a major jump!
Yet its expression was ashen and filled with alarm at this moment as its face stared towards Ozymandias somberly.
It had to eject them.
Because at this moment, in her small domain within the Blancverse, dozens of eyes had appeared and were staring towards her.
Towards them!

The auras terrifyingly raged from Ordinance Amalgamation to Existence Severing- multiple Great Ones appearing in this region as they were all drawn in by the shocking amount of complexity exploding here.
And they were further pulled in by the flash of a brilliance that came and went for the span of an instant!
But at this moment, it all faded.

The Great Segregator panted as at this moment, she realized just how tremendously her complexity had risen as she looked towards the calm visage of an obsidian humanoid Outerversal Morphon and spoke out.
|What brings so many faces to my domain?
We are merely aiding the Instrument of the Beyonder in his rise of complexity!|
She could sense their voraciousness.
So she spoke out with a burst of complexity to remind them where they were, while her massive swaying body appeared in front of Ozymandias!
At this moment, as she felt her elevated complexity, she had thoroughly become a believer.
He was the Instrument of the Beyonder?
Sure, why not!

If he could do what he just did within her domain again- and this time she would be even better prepared to ensure her Severed Domain did not come to a risk of collapse, then she would believe any status he was giving himself.
At her words, half the crimson eyes peering here pulled back and faded.
Another half remained a little longer, as a few began to come forward- their auras not showing any hostility.
|Great Segregator, Great Mother, why did we not get alerted that the Instrument of the Beyonder was here?
We would have joined in the celebrations.|

A massive obsidian Deep Pantheon Octopus floated forward, others coming forward alongside it as they wanted to understand just which Outerversal Morphon had walked into the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse!

As for the being in question, 90% of his weavings weren't even focused on the pleasantries of Ordinance Amalgamation and Existence Severing entities- they were on the musings of the drop of Blood of a Pioneer coursing through him!

chapters.title: Chapter 3383 Appalling Complexity! III
paragraphs: A single dream held too many implications.
Ones that Ozymandias had to take into account and think of deeply.
Through this Amarantos Dream of the Megalos, he had discovered different weavings of existence that opened up a whole new avenue of possibilities.
A whole new world he needed to understand.

The Rune of Amarantos shone with a brighter hue than ever as he knew it was the key to those different Weavings of Existence, in addition to the complexity of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed and the unique environment of the Severed Domain provided by the Great Segregator.
All were required!

So when the drop of blood of a Pioneer coursed through him, and he had the chance to sever something individual and something small, he was currently leaning towards the only key he currently had to explore weavings he didn't know existed!

As he thought of this, the small domain of the Great Segregator became filled with Outerversal Morphons, the Great Mother and Segregator doing all the talking as Ozymandias made it seem like he was still acclimating to his elevated complexity.
It gave him time to organize everything as he thought of Pyrrhus.
The weavings of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, and all other Megalonians for that matter, cultivated in a way where they utilized possible versions of themselves across the Megalos.
Possible versions born from their choices.
But all of them stemmed from the same Weaving of Existence.
A single body, simply utilizing possible variations of this body by sheer possibilities across the Megalos.
Meanwhile, the Amarantos Dread showed that in other Weavings of Existence, one may not even exist to have any possibilities!
Ozymandias wasn't able to find the Great Mother or the Great Wheel, and the Simians were actually extinct with the Commonwealth not existing in those Weavings of Existence.
But, the Great Instrument of the Beyonder was there.
And before Archimedes collapsed, weavings of that entity had surged towards him as this Great Instrument...was not kind towards Ozymandias!
Someone who was taking over its distinction.
Did this mean that at this moment, there was another Great Instrument of the Beyonder that had risen in the Megalos Beyond, but was just yet to be discovered?
Ozymandias thought of this as his weavings cycled rapidly, the choice in what he had to sever becoming more and more firm.
For the different weavings of existence, only a single thing was there to stabilize everything.
Something many looked up to as all states of Existence were connected to getting ever closer to it, gradually becoming unbound and forging one's own path in relation to it!
It was none other than the Wheel of Existence.
He recalled all the many things he had heard and experienced regarding this.
The Commonwealth.
The Simians.
The Outerversal Morphons.
All of them spoke about the turning of the Wheel. About the purity of existence in relation to the Wheel!

For him to better understand what he had just experienced in the most recent Amarantos Dream- what it truly was and how he could get into it again...he had to gain a bit more information on the Wheel of Existence!
And so.
"Sever."
While the Great Mother was exchanging pleasantries with others.
She swore that she heard a terrifying word that made her tentacles begin to tremble, her gaze going towards Ozymandias as she wanted to make sure she heard right!
Sever?
Sever?!

He had just declared his Ordinance as he hadn't even amalgamated with it, what did he mean sever?! He wasn't actually trying to sever his existence even before undergoing Ordinance Amalgamation, right?!
With trepidation, the Great Mother turned her will to focus on Ozymandias as apart from his brimming complexity...she didn't feel anything else.
No heavy eruption of weavings, and no crazy complexities suddenly breaking out.
Was she wrong?
Nothing shocking boomed out from Ozymandias even after he had uttered a heavy word, but it wasn't because he truly wasn't Severing something at this moment.
He did use the power of the drop of blood of the Pioneer to sever an individual thing. An individual concept.
But the source of this concept lay in another part of him!
So through the unshakable connection with the Infiniverse Megalos Seed. Through the intricate weavings between his souls shared between them.
The terrifying weavings of the Blood of the Pioneer that could sever a single, small part of himself flowed from Ozymandias and went towards another part of the Expanse!
What he severed was not the rune of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos.
It was a key, yes.
But he needed a door.
And the door was the one thing that contained all weavings.
The Wheel of Existence!
Across the Expanse.
Far away from the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse where a portion of the Outerversal Morphons lay.

In a region where a Blancverse floated serenely behind, a man and woman radiated heavy waves of complexity were looking at the broken-down weavings of the existence of three Anti-Matter Ordinance Amalgamation entities and the remnant corpse of the Vital Fist Emperor!
It had been a moment of research to grasp the weavings of Anti-Matter, and all of this research was elevated to another level when the rewards of the life of Archimedes flowed into Ozymandias.
Years worth of dissection and understanding of the Source of Existence of Anti-Matter.
What he found was the initial study that allowed him to see the fundamental makeup of Anti-Matter beings' weavings of fundamental particles he termed Positrons, Antiprotons, and Antineutrons.
And from all the tests conducted, whenever these fundamental particles of Anti-Matter came in contact with Matter or Dark Matter, there was only a single conclusion.
Annihilation.

Not an unstable explosion or rejection between the two sides, but sheer Annihilation as everything regarding the involved particles became destroyed and released energy in the form of gamma rays- throwing out heavy and terrifying swathes of unstable complexity of existence in the form of unstable radioactive decay of the most fundamental makeup of Matter, Anti-Matter, and Dark Matter!

chapters.title: Chapter 3384 Appalling Complexity! IV
paragraphs: It meant any inclusion of Anti-Matter into Noah himself at this moment would simply result in the breakdown of his existence.

Any Source of Existence he added to his Atlas at this moment would not be supported, as the only thing it would lead to was a shocking collapse and terrifying release of complex radioactive decay of weavings of existence themselves!
The Three Body Problem.
It wasn't so easy to solve as two bodies may have been easy to mix and stabilize, but the moment a third body came, everything went haywire.
The Shield of the Commonwealth, Old Man Eudemus, had been stuck here trying to understand for eons and nothing came of it.
To this day, there was no solution to the Three Body Problem.

Even in the different weavings of existence where Archimedes was in, the Great Instrument of the Beyonder was seeking to solve this Three Body Problem as he had already laid siege and conquered the Megalos Ynnere, and he had begun his incursion into Megalos Nihilos!
And yet by the time Archimedes perished, there were no solutions.
When he arrived here, Noah wasn't daunted nor did he feel like he faced a major setback.
Because he thought of the Fat Monkey.
He thought of the Tzar Versepiercer!

He thought of his Weapons of Mass Existential Omniversal Destruction and wondered just how terrifying they would become if he could incorporate Anti-Matter into them in addition to the already impressive mix of Matter and Dark Matter!
||I'll start on this project, Master. And-||
HUUM!

An explosion of terrific power erupted through the Infiniverse Megalos Body and through Noah at that moment, the weavings that Ozymandias sent forth arriving as they carried with them the unique power to Sever.
And the target of severing was something that was held deeply within Noah- within his Atlas of Existence!
It coursed through him with indomitable splendor and focused itself on none other than the Source of Existence of Kuklos.
Of the Wheel!
Inherited from the Simians.
From the Commonwealth that said they stood to protect the Weavings of the Wheel.
The purity of the Wheel.

They lived their lives seeking to emulate the Wheel of Existence in their structures and their systems as they sought greater control- which only meant a smoother advancement across the states of Existence as they got closer and closer to the Wheel of Existence!
Noah did not doubt that once reaching a sufficiently high enough state of existence, one may be able to look at the Wheel with great clarity.
Maybe beings like Bob, who came and went with ease, were at this stage.
But at this moment- deep within him, something was cleaved.
Cut.
And the closest and most accurate description he could state to describe what this cleaving truly did...was that this whole time, he only held a counterfeit golden wheel in his Atlas of Existence.
And after this cleaving, this counterfeit Wheel had its fake layer decimated, and something real within it arose.
A true Wheel.
A True Source of Existence of Kuklos!
As if what the Commonwealth chased and sought to emulate this whole time was only a shadow of the Wheel, and Noah was, at this moment, actually looking at a genuine one.
HUUM!
The nearby golden strings of the Expanse pulsed.
As if it were the norm for Noah, a dazzling mountain appeared below and gushed out waves of authority while a dazzling tree appeared above.

He nearly sighed with the over-the-top absorption of energy that always occurred in the Expanse as if every time, it wanted to alert and let others know that someone else was making great gains within it.

But with the appearance of the dazzling mountain and tree, Noah's existence was able to feed the terrifying complexity rising within the Source of Existence of Kuklos- his surroundings beginning to be painted gold as with his body as the center, dozens of spokes began to erupt around him.
Spokes.
Lines that made up the core part of a Wheel.
They constructed with him at the center as after extending a certain distance, they stopped as a ring of golden light formed around and connected the Spokes of this blooming Wheel!
It emanated terrific power as the absorption of the authority of the Expanse only became more intense, with Noah's weaving pulsing maddeningly.
|The System of Existence, Kuklos, has been Severed by the power carried in the Drop of Blood of the Pioneer of Existence, Ashandus.|
|Something was Severed, but the tool used for the Severing was anothers. Due to this, a small Weaving of Causality has formed between you and the Pioneer of Existence, Ashandus.|

|The Source of Existence of Kuklos has been elevated to become the Severed Source of Existence of Kuklos. The limitations and bounds of what it could achieve under weavings of Existence have greatly changed, with the extent of what these changes are requiring analysis and practice.|
Many prompts came and went, but there was one that Noah did not like.
An Entanglement with the one that this Severing power originally belonged to- the Pioneer of Existence, Ashandus!
But he watched this being die.
Decimated by the terrifying Nihilos Marburg worm.

And yet at this moment, he was entangled with it as the effects of this were unknown. He proceeded forward cautiously as he now had to try the reason for Severing Kuklos to begin with, his existence radiating a terrifying light as above him, a radiant rune of Amarantos began to manifest.
Ozymandias had his Dream, and Noah was also due for his.
But unlike Ozymandias, Noah did not have the Severed Domain of an Existence Severing Entity.
He instead...had a Severed Source of Existence of Kuklos at this moment!
So he initiated the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos.
He put the complexity of the Infiniverse Megalos Physiology into it.
He put the complexity of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian into it. And around him, the extremely real golden Wheel began to spin.
"Dream..."
He whispered gloriously as all of these factors came into play!

And the Wheel around his body vibrated with terrific radiance as above him, the rune of Amarantos flashed- its light landing on one of the many spokes of the Wheel around Noah as moments later, his consciousness faded away as he fell into a deep slumber!

chapters.title: Chapter 3385 Appalling Complexity! V
paragraphs: Light years away from Noah's current position.
Where he used to be when the Daughter of Existence, Sentara, was decimated by the Infiniverse Megalos Body.
|Here?|
An intent echoed out as groups of tremendously powerful Ordinance Amalgamation entities floated in the golden strings of the Expanse.
There were a dozen in each group, with there being 4 groups here as each one was being led by an Ordinance Amalgamation entity that far exceeded others in that same group.
Immovable Sacred Legions of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse!
They exceeded the power of any other entities of the same stage as they were successful in doing something very few even had access to.
Modus Operandi for the weavings and utilization of their complexity of existence that allowed them to erupt with power multiple times greater.
The one who had spoken was a man with vibrant blue hair and eyes, his gaze steady as at this moment, his body lit up with intricate lines that looked like...circuits.
Circuits!
They flashed over his body in intricate ways as they seemed to originate from a single point at the center of his body- a point that if one looked truly close, they would observe a shimmering rune!
As if a heavy engine was being turned on, the bustling complexity of this being pulsed before he looked in a certain direction.
|The Blancverse moved in that direction. Follow steadily and alert the other groups. We are only at the observation stage as we will not engage with the enemy.|
|Understood!|
The Immovable Sacred Legions moved with order and power.
In the Expanse, even if they came across an Existence Severing entity, they didn't hold fear of perishing.
They tracked the scent of a certain being while under orders of other entities that they didn't even know the true aims of, events being put in motion as nobody knew just what they would lead to!
As if one was waking up from a long slumber.
The fluttering of the eyes was rapid as a slumber ended, and an entity opened their eyes.
They saw...the appearance of a gigantic multicolored tree that rose up endlessly, and they were seated in a meditative position atop a flowing river of clear water that gravitated around this area!

Hundreds of other tendrils of vibrant rivers floated serenely around this massive tree, the bodies of entities pulsing with vibrant radiance of purity also being seen as they were all in seated positions as if they were patiently waiting for someone.
Memories came and went.
As the awakened beings looked at the surroundings and even further beyond, he confirmed he was in a special domain that seemed like an Omniverse, but his awareness could not spread outside of it!
And in this domain...the vibrant life forms that were Antediluvian Leviathans filled it with abundance.

In the area they were in, the massive tree that looked suspiciously close to the Tresorverse Primaltree of Existence, albeit smaller, was surrounded by Ordinance Amalgamation and Ordinance of Existence Antediluvian Leviathans.
The Awakened being felt the vibrant Ordinance of Moirai coursing through his being, not yet amalgamated, and yet shining with complexity as he didn't seem too far away!
He was...Boros. An Antediluvian Leviathan whose very being was aligned with Moirai as he thought to understand the profundities of fate and causality.
He was waiting like all others here as the long wait that all Ordinance of Existence and Ordinance Amalgamation Antediluvian Leviathans were experiencing came to an end as at this moment...
HUUM!
An austere aura emerged from a singularity and floated at the midpoint of the trunk of the massive Primaltree of Existence- this visage shining with multicolored radiance as it was none other than...
|Omnifather.|
|Omnifather!|
The Antediluvian Leviathans called out respectfully and with fervor as they all looked up towards this being!

He smiled with astral radiance as his whole body emanated terrifying waves of power, his appearance acting like a signal as in the next moment, multiple Existence Severing auras also appeared in the surroundings.
The Omnifather.
Boros, waking up in these weavings and affirming his identity, confirmed that similar to a previous dream that Ozymandias had, this dream of his was something far too put together and real!
He kept his gaze down and didn't focus on the Omnifather himself out of an abundance of caution, and this entity began to speak as soon as he appeared.

|After cycles of wading across the Expanse, I can expand a bit on all that I've learned. Those at the Ordinance of Existence level have barely reached the qualifications to understand this and get a head start, but do not be deterred if you cannot pick up anything, okay?|
The voice of the Omnifather was magnetic and filled with tremendous confidence, every single word causing one's weavings to buzz!
Looks of reverence spread out from all around as the Antediluvian Leviathans looked up to him with fanaticism.
Even the Existence Severing Antediluvian Leviathans in the background had looks of respect and somberness towards this being as he smiled and continued!

|Since the earliest records of weavings of existence, all beings rise and reach out towards the Source of Existence itself. They start off by increasing the complexity of their existence- their body, origin, and soul as a variety of means can be used towards this. The Rules that allow for existence to flow are grasped as their understanding takes one ever closer. Life, Death, Light, Dark, Entropy...anything that allows the flow of existence can be grasped to bring one ever closer, until...one follows their selected extremes and understands its complexity so much to become one with it. To become One With Existence.|
WAA!
The eyes of the Antediluvian Leviathans were bright as they felt like they were listening to the order of existence- listening to a lecture that could very well outline their path for the future!

|Attaining a State of Existence allows one to truly start understanding the nature of things, with the realization of the distant and unfathomable Wheel of Existence becoming their main goal. A goal that everyone has been running towards for many cycles now. But...when one gets closer and closer to the Wheel of Existence, they came to understand that they were also further and further away as there still existed a huge chasm they could never cross. As if there was a huge barrier between them and the Wheel that could never be crossed. Ordinance Amalgamation entities felt this, and even those lucky enough to Sever and establish their very own Weavings of Existence felt this. An unsurpassable and uncrossable rift!|
HUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 3386 Appalling Complexity! VI
paragraphs: The weavings of all listening Antediluvian Leviathans began to tremble as they felt like they had arrived at a precipice.
The reason that the Omnifather gathered them all here today!
This multicolored being smiled as he looked around the Primaltree of Existence, gazing at the myriad of individual Antediluvian Leviathans as he posed a question.
|Runes...what do you all know about his concept?|
Runes.
The moment he asked this, many Antediluvian Leviathans were confused while some Ordinance Amalgamation and Existence Severing Leviathans began to radiate a terrific light of brilliance.
Receiving no answer, the Omnifather continued.

|Runes...actually became a solution to the unsolvable problem of an uncrossable chasm. Over time, many came to learn that it was entirely a barrier of communication that existed between them and the Wheel of Existence, where no matter how far they traversed across the states of Existence, they still felt far away. The Wheel of Existence seemed to have an entirely different methodology of communication as, after eons, a few Great entities came to understand a type of language to breach that chasm and better communicate with the Wheel of Existence- Runes.|
WAA!
As he spoke.
His hand twirled as within it, a singularity filled with extreme heaviness bloomed.
It looked like the strokes of ancient letters coming together as just its appearance caused a stifling sensation to those in the surroundings!

|That is what Runes are- what they were discovered to be. A type of language. Something that made it easier to communicate and grasp the profound weavings that keep Existence flowing. They can seem small, but they are unique because they can compact a tremendous amount of weavings and complexity...into a single small letter. A Single Rune.|
As Boros listened, the will within him was pulsing with brilliance as Noah thought about many things.
Runes.
The Transcendent Megalos Abilities designed by the Great Beyonder.
After one inherited the Transcendent Megalos Ability, a rune formed within their existence as any time they sought to activate it, they simply had to infuse complexity of existence into it!
This...was even what Noah had done to arrive in this Dream.
He had activated the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos by infusing terrifying droves of complexity of existence...into the AMARANTOS Rune.
Paired with the Severed Source of Existence of Kuklos and the terrifying Complexity of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed, he arrived here.
In this supposed dream.
In these different Weavings of Existence.
All from the utilization of a single Rune!

A single rune made many things possible. The Rune of Amarantos Dream of the Megalos made it possible to attain the Blood of a Pioneer by someone who was only in the Ordinance of Existence stage. And the utilization of this Blood to sever a part of himself!
A drop of blood...to sever a part of oneself.
Wait.
His weavings buzzed for a small moment of realization.

As the Omnifather showed the terrifying complexity of a single rune he conjured up, Noah took a moment to reflect on a single rune and the terrifying thing he had done due to what he obtained through it.
He had Severed a Small Part of himself.
A small part for him was a single concept- Kuklos.
A single Source of Existence.

This was small for him, and he had been able to Sever it with the drop of Blood of Pioneer that was somehow able to be brought back to him from Archimedes and cross unknown distances to enter his weavings of existence through the Amarantos Rune.
And then, a small part of him- a single Source of Existence which he held multiple of, was Severed due to it.
But this small part of himself...if Old Man Eudemus was put forth on his behalf, this was everything to him!
He only had the single Source of Existence of Kuklos as, at this moment, Noah had managed to sever it even before he underwent Ordinance Amalgamation with Kuklos.
He Severed it before his existence Amalgamated with it.

He hadn't even stopped to ask whether it was possible, and simply did it after taking the boon that was the Drop of Blood of a Pioneer that stemmed from a journey in other weavings of existence...initiated by a Rune.
A rune designed by the Great Beyonder!

|Being such an intricate language, Runes of Existence can be utilized to do a great deal of things, with one only truly able to speak this language and understand it themselves when their complexity gets close to Ordinance Amalgamation. And even then, if one seeks to design their own Rune for any unique purpose, they may only be able to design the lowest tier of a Rune of Existence- like the one in my hands. It is merely a type of a Terrestrial Rune of Existence.|
The words of the Omnifather continued as he looked around and then pointed towards an Ordinance of Existence Antediluvian Leviathan who was looking towards him with awe.
|You. Strike against this broken Pillar of the Expanse with as much strength as you can.|
WAP!

The surroundings flickered as instantly, a massive gray stone-like pillar appeared and floated before their eyes. The Antediluvian Leviathan picked by the Omnifather adopted a solemn expression as his body was aflame with a crimson light of none other than the Ordinance of Destruction- and it struck out heavily while crossing Great distances to smash onto the broken Pillar of Existence as...
BZZT!
A single white scratch appeared.
The eyes of the Antediluvian Leviathan trembled as in the distance, the Omnifather nodded.
|Mmm, sufficient. That can be considered a peak power of an Ordinance of Existence entity. Now, Destruction is not my Ordinance, nor is it a path I've been following. But...|
HUUM!
His hand tapped out once more.
And with the tap, utterly appalling waves of complexity of existence erupted as a blinding white singularity bloomed- its outline being hazy to many as it was a Rune!
|Even without truly understanding Destruction, if I can lay out a single rune that is able to communicate with it, I can command this Weaving of Existence to act on behalf of my complexity and...|
The White rune flashed with radiance as it instantly burst into crimson brilliance that shot towards the pillar that an Ordinance of Existence entity had only managed to leave a scratch on, and....
BOOM...CRACK!
The entire pillar was decimated as debris flew about everywhere.
|Runes.|
The voice of the Omnifather was heavy.

|If you can learn this advanced language. If you can begin communicating with the Wheel of Existence in a frequency actually acceptable towards it, you will come to find many things deemed impossible...a mere reality.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3387 Runes of Existence! I
paragraphs: The Antediluvian Leviathans were stupefied.
They gazed towards the Omnifather as if they were looking at a prized treasure, and out of the corner of the Primaltree of Existence, a voice echoed out.
|How do we get started, Omnifather?|
It was the voice of an Existence Severing Antediluvian Leviathan.
They radiated a blue radiance all over their bodies as expansive cerulean wings extended behind them, but their eyes seemed to be those of someone greatly seeking to learn at this moment!
At the question, the Omnifather only smiled before replying.

|Like anything that had come before, you learn with practice. Others had no teacher as they had to figure the path out themselves, while you all have someone who can provide guidance. Once your complexity approaches Ordinance Amalgamation and beyond, you will be able to more easily understand the intricacies of Runes of Existence and eventually become capable of designing simple runes yourselves. To get you all familiar with Runes, I will impart a rune I've been designing that has exceeded the bounds of Terrestrial Runes and stepped forward to become a Minor Constellation Rune of Existence. I call it...The Quintessential Sacred Complexity Rune of Existence. A single rune that contains within it a methodology to aid one in increasing the output of their weavings of existence by at least 150%. You will have this in your weavings as you should familiarize yourselves with it and its mysteries. Its design, its flow...if you can decipher and analyze any of these, it will make the next few steps even easier. There will be some of you with talent in this, and there will be others without. Do not falter, and keep trying.|

The eyes of Boros became extremely sharp as Noah's will within observed the Omnifather tap his finger out hundreds of times in an instant, and dazzling purple runes carrying heavy brilliance formed and shot out towards every single Antediluvian Leviathan here.
A Quintessential Sacred Complexity Rune of Existence!
Was this not the same as the Quintessential Sacred Complexity Modus Operandi that Entities were fighting for at this very moment in his weavings of Existence?
For them to gain control of Quintessential Tresorverse Towers of Existence, of which there were only 9 of!
Yet here, the Omnifather freely gave hundreds of such runes to hundreds of Antediluvian Leviathans.

At this moment, within the Tresorverse Sacred Domain of the Omnifather, a singularity was extinguishing as Noah would gain control of an Origin Tresorverse Tower of Existence that would grant him the Origin Sacred Complexity Modus Operandi- it turned out this inheritance would have been a type of Rune of Existence even more advanced than the one that at this moment....
SAA!
Bloomed before him.
Gloriously purple as it showed off its unbound tyranny, and yet waves of deep and intricate Complexity flowed around and within it.
Boros, like all other Antediluvian Leviathans, raised their hands forward and grabbed onto this dazzling rune as it became a streak of light that shot into their bodies!
And the moment it did so...
HUUM!
Their weavings of existence buzzed.

The Constellation Rune of Existence settled into the center of their being as it flashed with power and automatically activated the first time, instantly causing brilliant circuits to bloom and settle in the weavings of existence of every single entity containing this Rune of Existence!
Circuits.
Meridians!
Lines that divided and set up roads across weavings of existence- roads that glow across one's weavings to form a system of circulation akin to an empowered engine coming to life.

When the Quintessential Sacred Complexity Rune of Existence settled within Noah, he felt his complexity utilized to automatically activate it as a dense number of Meridians stretched across his existence- 64 to be exact!
64 dazzling circuits- dazzling meridians that looked like vibrant vessels that were there purely for the purpose of the rapid acceleration and increase in output of weavings of existence.
They hummed like an ancient engine waking up as seconds later, Boros felt his body brimming with twice as much potency compared to before.
His complexity remained the same...but what he could release was increased by more than a factor of two!
Over the skin of his body, the purple Meridians flashed and made the golden light of Moirai seem even more penetrative, its complexity seeming a notch higher.

|Study this rune. Familiarize yourselves with as much of it as you can. It exceeds the boundary of Terrestrial Runes of Existence, but its complexity will make it so that if you understand even a percentage of it, you can already start deciphering and designing Terrestrial Runes of Existence thereafter. I will be back in a year to continue.|
A year.
This was how much time they were given to grasp and understand as much as they could.
Boros, an Ordinance of Existence entity whose body was filled with Moirai placed his whole focus and weavings into this Rune and the dazzling meridians it allowed to course through him.

His input of weavings was taken off moments later as he couldn't sustain and power up the rune constantly, but it remained within his weavings of existence as he studied every single angle and form he could- trying to decipher its complexity and mystery!

Inside these weavings of existence- inside this dream, he didn't have the weavings of the Protagonist, Infinity, Mana, Quintessence, or even the terrifying complexity of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed. He only had his Will.
But this alone wasn't enough to recreate his overpowered sense of being as progression within this Dream, within these weavings...were always slow.
So he would take as much time as he had to analyze the shocking rune that presented itself, and at the same time...the Amarantos Rune that glowed calmly within him!
This Rune was one of the few things still retained within this dream as it lay there silently until the time came for the dream to end.
It felt...even heavier and more complex than even the Quintessential Sacred Complexity Rune of Existence.
Noah began studying them both in conjunction.
How they were different. How they were the same. Whether they were both Constellation Runes of Existence- just a large gap existing between them.
All these questions and more buzzed within the weavings of Boros for the next weeks and months!

Was this not the same as the Quintessential Sacred Complexity Modus Operandi that Entities were fighting for at this very moment in his weavings of Existence?
For them to gain control of Quintessential Tresorverse Towers of Existence, of which there were only 9 of!
Yet here, the Omnifather freely gave hundreds of such runes to hundreds of Antediluvian Leviathans.

At this moment, within the Tresorverse Sacred Domain of the Omnifather, a singularity was extinguishing as Noah would gain control of an Origin Tresorverse Tower of Existence that would grant him the Origin Sacred Complexity Modus Operandi- it turned out this inheritance would have been a type of Rune of Existence even more advanced than the one that at this moment....
SAA!
Bloomed before him.
Gloriously purple as it showed off its unbound tyranny, and yet waves of deep and intricate Complexity flowed around and within it.
Boros, like all other Antediluvian Leviathans, raised their hands forward and grabbed onto this dazzling rune as it became a streak of light that shot into their bodies!
And the moment it did so...
HUUM!
Their weavings of existence buzzed.

The Constellation Rune of Existence settled into the center of their being as it flashed with power and automatically activated the first time, instantly causing brilliant circuits to bloom and settle in the weavings of existence of every single entity containing this Rune of Existence!
Circuits.
Meridians!
Lines that divided and set up roads across weavings of existence- roads that glow across one's weavings to form a system of circulation akin to an empowered engine coming to life.

When the Quintessential Sacred Complexity Rune of Existence settled within Noah, he felt his complexity utilized to automatically activate it as a dense number of Meridians stretched across his existence- 64 to be exact!
64 dazzling circuits- dazzling meridians that looked like vibrant vessels that were there purely for the purpose of the rapid acceleration and increase in output of weavings of existence.
They hummed like an ancient engine waking up as seconds later, Boros felt his body brimming with twice as much potency compared to before.
His complexity remained the same...but what he could release was increased by more than a factor of two!
Over the skin of his body, the purple Meridians flashed and made the golden light of Moirai seem even more penetrative, its complexity seeming a notch higher.
|Study this rune.
Familiarize yourselves with as much of it as you can.

It exceeds the boundary of Terrestrial Runes of Existence, but its complexity will make it so that if you understand even a percentage of it, you can already start deciphering and designing Terrestrial Runes of Existence thereafter.
I will be back in a year to continue.|
A year.
This was how much time they were given to grasp and understand as much as they could.
Boros, an Ordinance of Existence entity whose body was filled with Moirai placed his whole focus and weavings into this Rune and the dazzling meridians it allowed to course through him.

His input of weavings was taken off moments later as he couldn't sustain and power up the rune constantly, but it remained within his weavings of existence as he studied every single angle and form he could- trying to decipher its complexity and mystery!
Inside these weavings of existence- inside this dream, he didn't have the weavings of the Protagonist, Infinity, Mana, Quintessence, or even the terrifying complexity of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
He only had his Will.
But this alone wasn't enough to recreate his overpowered sense of being as progression within this Dream, within these weavings...were always slow.
So he would take as much time as he had to analyze the shocking rune that presented itself, and at the same time...the Amarantos Rune that glowed calmly within him!
This Rune was one of the few things still retained within this dream as it lay there silently until the time came for the dream to end.
It felt...even heavier and more complex than even the Quintessential Sacred Complexity Rune of Existence.
Noah began studying them both in conjunction.
How they were different.
How they were the same.
Whether they were both Constellation Runes of Existence- just a large gap existing between them.
All these questions and more buzzed within the weavings of Boros for the next weeks and months!

chapters.title: Chapter 3388 Runes of Existence! II
paragraphs: A new language!
The methodology to communicate with the Wheel of Existence was that of Runes of Existence, with entities of higher power utilizing them to achieve unimaginable feats.
The Great Beyonder and his Transcendent Megalos Abilities.
The Omnifather and his Sacred Complexity Modus Operandi.
All of them and more had delved into the Runes of Existence as now, Noah began to study their shocking complexity as well.
In the dazzling dream, a year passed relatively quickly under the perception of the Antediluvian Leviathans who lived for cycles.

And as promised, the figure of the Omnifather blazed with brilliance and reappeared on the midpoint of the trunk of the Primaltree of Existence, many Leviathans rousing to look at him while his multicolored figure smiled!

|A year has gone by as the gauge of whether you have any degree of ease in the Runes of Existence is done. Embarking on grasping this language seems to have many unknown factors around it, but one's own complexity of existence is one thing, and the type of Source of Existence is another, with some even saying the purity of existence allows one to forge Runes of Existence with greater success, ease, and complexity. Do not despair if you did not grasp too much in the last year- we will put things into practice today.|
The Antediluvian Leviathans were roused as they looked ahead with anticipation.

|Let's start off with the lowest Terrestrial Rune of Existence, the Rune of Blanc that can change to take on any weavings. Its complexity isn't as much as the Quintessential Sacred Complexity Rune due to what it seeks to achieve, and this is how one would draw it.|
Everyone watched with bated breaths as they saw the potent weavings of the Omnifather leak from him and transform into small, intricate fine strokes that showed off the construction of a Rune.
It wasn't easy.

With every fine stroke, a sense of balance and harmony had to be maintained. With every stroke, one had to converge a tremendous amount of complexity in an extremely small area and continue to do so for another thousands of strokes.

The Rune of Blanc- one of the lowest Terrestrial Runes of Existence...held more than a few thousand strokes simply to bring to existence as after the Omnifather was done, a blinding white rune floated before everyone's eyes.
Whoever looked at it would see it read- Blanc!
After many intricate weavings of existence made it, one could now take it and choose any weaving of existence to fill this Rune of Blanc.
A few thousand strokes.

The Quintessential Sacred Complexity Rune of Existence they had been studying this past year had at least a million strokes that all came together intricately to form this rune, while the Amarantos Rune of Existence...held at least 10 million unique strokes all around.
This was a guess from Noah based on what he had seen so far as he had not managed to understand all the strokes contained in the Runes he studied- just roughly an approximation!
But the Rune of Blanc...seemed much simpler as every Antediluvian Leviathan here tried to duplicate what the Omnifather had just done- to follow all the few thousand strokes he made.
Nobody was able to succeed on their first try.
Not the Existence Severing Entities, and certainly not the Ordinance of Existence Entities!
For many, even starting a few strokes with their vibrant and heavy complexity didn't allow the strokes to remain still as everything fizzled out even before a hundred strokes could be made.
|Failure results in the depletion of your weavings of existence, but with every failure, your understanding of the Runes of Existence will increase.|
Nobody had succeeded on their first try, but over the next day...
HUUM!

Multiple blinding white singularities bloomed on the periphery where the Existence Severing entities were, a few of them managing to complete a single Terrestrial Rune of Existence due to their own sheer depth of complexity!
When they did so, their weavings pulsed with a serene light of brilliance as the complexity they held this whole time seemed to increase slightly just from this recent practice of Rune formation.
The Omnifather nodded towards the Existence Severing Antediluvian Leviathans and continued.

|If successful, continue forming as many more Runes of Existence as you can and increase your rate of success and understanding. You will come to see that the familiarization of Runes of Existence and even forging them is a tremendous practice in increasing the complexity of your own weavings of existence. But for variation, here is another Terrestrial Rune of Existence, The Rune of Erasure...|
Vibrant lights formed around the Omnifather as he constructed another Rune of Existence under the watchful eyes of all.
With their spirits invigorated, the Antediluvian Leviathans delved into the practice of Runes fully!
In the ninth week, Boros was the first Ordinance of Existence Entity that managed to successfully construct a Rune of Blanc.
Not just the first Ordinance of Existence entity to do so, but also the first Antediluvian Leviathan after the Existence Severing entities who managed to form a Rune of Existence!

And how could he not when even though the talents of Boros were poor, he held the Rune of Amarantos that was even more complex than anything that the Omnifather had shown them so far for him to study?

His accomplishment caught the eyes of the Omnifather in the distance who nodded towards his direction, an imperceptible light flashing briefly in his eyes as he locked onto Boros before he looked away.
He continued to show more and more simple Terrestrial Rules of Existence as he systematically taught the powerful Antediluvian Leviathans, and the years passed.
Five years.
Ten years.
Fifty years!

The surroundings of the Primaltree of Existence were now filled with a shocking array of complexities as thousands of Runes of Existence floated around it, causing the concentration of weavings of Existence nearby to be enriched and pulse with activity.
A few dozen Ordinance Amalgamation Entities had also managed to embark on the path of Runes of Existence, with very few Ordinance of Existence entities succeeding in any Runes so far!
Boros remained one of the astonishing ones as at this moment, many different Terrestrial Runes of Existence surrounded him.
In the 50th year, the Omnifather gave another demonstration as he looked at the progress around him.

|Those with the ability have managed to forge a few Runes of Existence, and from them, you should feel a unique link. Every rune is unfathomably unique as it shares the signature of the one who made it, with its complexity and design being so intricate that it is forever bound by the one who forged it. Other people can be given access to the complex workings of a certain rune- a certain word that they can then utilize, but it will always belong to the single being who forged it. They may even be able to know every person utilizing the word, the rune that they forged.|

chapters.title: Chapter 3389 Runes of Existence! III
paragraphs: The most recent words to be uttered out from the Omnifather didn't cause a whole lot of tumultuous waves on the vast majority of Antediluvian Leviathans.
But within the weavings of Noah, his eyes pulsed with a terrifying light.
The Rune of Existence carried the signature of the one who designed it- to the extent that their forger of a Rune could know just who was utilizing something they designed!
Noah looked within the depths of his weavings where the Amarantos Rune of the Great Beyonder and the Quintessential Sacred Complexity Rune of Existence of the Omnifather lay.
Both...were not his.

The moment that he began using the Transcendent Megalos Ability of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos, did his name get added to a long list that the Beyonder could easily see as the one who designed this Rune?
The thought didn't entirely sit right with him as he already began to think about how he could change this in the future!

|I tell you this because from now on, I have shown you enough variations of Runes of Existence that you can design your own unique Runes. There is a region in the Expanse that holds dense variations of scattered weavings of Runes for you all to gain more ideas from, and that will be the next location of study. Come.|
The words of the Omnifather echoed out as many Antediluvian Leviathans rose with expectant eyes to follow the Omnifather!
They trusted him with their very weavings of existence as they would follow and do anything he told them.
Boros rose up as well, but at this moment...
|Not you.|
HUUM!
Silently.
Other Antediluvian Leviathans didn't even sense anything!
But the voice of the Omnifather boomed within Noah's ears as he found his body anchored in space, unable to move!
As others began to be teleported, his figure silently disappeared as well.
A flash of an instant.
Thereafter, he found himself standing on a starry blue sea of plasma, dazzling Omniverses spinning in the far distance as their sheer size and stature made one feel unfathomably small.

Above this starry blue sea of plasma, the figure of Boros appeared as behind him, the visage of the Omnifather was adorned in a multicolored robe- his arms folding behind him as he stared out at the spinning Omniverses!

|Traversing into different weavings of existence is dangerous. Unnatural. For you to appear in the weavings of Antediluvian Leviathans must mean you are connected in some way within your own weavings, thus, I allowed you to move freely and learn in the last decades. But were to keep following any further, it would become dangerous for you.|
The Omnifather spoke to Boros.
No, not Boros, but the will residing within him!
Noah turned his head to stare at the terrifying entity that was the Omnifather as his will was calm, his mouth opening calmly.
"When did you find out?"

|The moment I first laid eyes on you. Anyone above Existence Severing may be able to notice some things if they are focused on you, with more complex beings sensing even if their attention didn't just happen to fall on you. I tell you this while keeping hope that you will heed my warning. One's own Frequency of existence is more than sufficient. You can spend your entire lifespan and not be able to scour every single bound of Existence in the Weavings you were born in. Delving into others could aid in your complexity in the short term, but you will start causing changes and fluctuations not meant for those weavings of existence. And if you begin affecting a big enough change...you will fall under the eyes of those beings soon enough. Beings who can more clearly see the Wheel of Existence more than anything else as they ensure their steady flow!|
Unfathomably complex words echoed out from the Omnifather.
Words that caused Noah to turn silent as he mulled over them again and again!
The biggest thing being falling under the eyes of Entities that ensured the steady flow of Weavings of Existence.
He had just heard of this, and yet he had a great deal of questions!
Who? Why?
He had many questions, but he knew that he would very likely not receive any answers here as he looked at the Omnifather and asked about something else entirely.
|What do you know of the Megalonians?|
HUUM!
The Megalonians.

Were they destroyed in these weavings of existence as well? The moment he asked this question, the gaze of the Omnifather flickered with a tremendous amount of emotion as his gaze changed, and he waved his hands with a booming voice!
|Leave!|
The Amarantos Rune of Existence within him blared with light as he instantly felt unfathomably sleepy.
Gazing at the visage of the Omnifather and the brilliance around him, Boros closed his eyes and fell into a deep slumber- a unique complexity leaving him as an Amarantos Rune of Existence faded away!
Yet even after this occurred, the Omnifather continued to stare silently as the figure of Boros woke up soon after.
|Huh? Omnifather...!|
Seeing the visage of the Omnifather, Boros instantly rose to his feet with reverence as the Omnifather merely nodded and waved his hands, Boros disappearing from his eyes right after.
His gaze was a unique one as he seemed to be faced with a great deal of difficulty and confusion.
At a certain point...
|Why did he not appear in the other weavings of himself? Why possess another if traversing the weavings of existence?|
A query that the Omnifather had not been able to answer.

The Wheel of Existence was unfathomable, but more often than not, if there was a being capable of traveling across its myriad Spokes of Existence, they were likely to be of renowned stature and complexity across the Spokes of the Wheel.
So why not do the easy thing and traverse into another version of oneself, and instead go for the much harder possession?
Unless...a version of himself did not exist in these weavings.
But this...was highly unlikely, right?
Not receiving any answers, the Omnifather's gaze flickered with many emotions before he also disappeared!
