chapters.title: Chapter 3390 Runes of Existence! IV
paragraphs: Within certain Weavings of Existence, inside the Expanse.
An Amarantos Rune of Existence flashed brilliantly above Noah's figure as the Infiniverse Megalos Seed watched it with bright eyes in the distance.
The prompts that appeared before his eyes were ones that coursed through her, their unshakable connection carrying their memories and more together!
|A unique Dream exceeding the bounds of Weavings of Existence was experienced due to a Severed Source and intricate Complexity of Existence.|
|An Unsurpassable Dream has been brought to an end after weavings potentially harmful to you made themselves present.|
|Your proficiency in the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos has been elevated to the Fourth Echelon, with your Proficiency at 44%.|
Ozymandias and him were the same, but also different.
His weavings held an Amarantos Rune of Existence, and so did the weavings of Ozymandias as they both had their Proficiency with it.

And now that he was able to take a closer look, he could see that this so called Proficiency was only how familiar he became with the Amarantos Rune of Existence the more he used it as more and more of his own weavings entered its gaps of complexity- which allowed him to bring out more of its power next time!
|The weavings of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos you can obtain are sufficiently exceptional.|
|All memories of the Unsurpassable Dream are retained.|
|The Weavings of this single Dream can be retrieved, with one out of two components viable for retrieval due to the current Proficiency of the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos.|
|The Components of the Dream capable of being chosen are as follows.|
|Source of Existence of an Antediluvian Leviathan as the Ordinance of Existence. Ordinance of Moirai. Cycles of refinement of the purity of an Ordinance of Existence.|

|Weavings and Research of Runes of Existence spanning decades, profundities prompted by the Omnifather of the Antediluvian Leviathans. A Quintessential Sacred Complexity Rune of Existence, and many other uniquely designed Runes of Existence.|
Two dazzling singularities rose before his eyes as he made the choice between them rather quickly.

|The full Weavings and Research of Runes of Existence spanning decades, profundities prompted by the Omnifather of the Antediluvian Leviathans, a Quintessential Sacred Complexity Rune of Existence, and many other uniquely designed Runes of Existence have been retrieved.|
[Part of the Dream of the Antediluvian Leviathan, Boros, has been forever lost.] Decades of research of weavings of the Runes of Existence.
Such wonders began to flow within him as at the same time, dazzling Runes of Existence began to manifest around his figure!
Tremendous gains were made in this dream as they were mainly clustered around Runes of Existence.
Feeling the decades' worth of knowledge and familiarity, Noah spoke succinctly to the Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
"How is it?"

||I've sifted through all memories and proficiency pertaining to Runes of Existence. I can begin setting aside a significant portion of complexity in their study and design, and even begin utilizing some of the commonly learned Terrestrial Runes of Existence right away to further elevate the Complexity of Existence of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed.||
The Infiniverse Megalos Seed was efficient if nothing else.

They knew the Runes of Existence to be a potentially existence altering form of weavings, and if it was the language that many used to get ever closer to the Wheel of Existence, they would do so as well!
It was unique because this wasn't the first time Noah came across Runes, with his own weavings having come across them a few times as he went towards Extremity.
But not in this way.
Not in their complexity of how many thousands or millions of strokes a single rune could have- and the effect it could impose on the surrounding weavings of existence.
For example.

At this moment as the weavings of Runes flowed between the Infiniverse Megalos Seed and Noah, the Infiniverse Megalos Body waved her hands with an eruption of complexity as a massive white rune began to form out of a singularity.
Requiring a total of ten thousand strokes, it was the Terrestrial Runes of Existence- the Amplification Rune!
Its purpose was nothing else but to amplify the surrounding weavings of existence.
The Infiniverse Megalos Body finished it in a few seconds, her gaze sharp as she looked at the glow of this rune and how it had caused the surroundings to become brighter and more active.

||I will begin with the mass production and placement of the Amplification Runes of Existence throughout the Infiniverse Megalos Seed first. I estimate that within a few days, I should be capable of designing them as Constellation Runes of Existence with much greater effects.||

Words brimming with confidence echoed out as Noah nodded, Noah's eyes briefly turning towards a certain direction and observing there momentarily before their figures disappeared into the Blancverse along with their Loot!
Towards the area Noah had observed before he left.
A distance equivalent to five Omniverses away, Immovable Sacred Legions were wrapped up in a light of veiled brilliance as their intents moved silently around each other.
On their bodies, dazzling Meridians- Circuits that vibrated with radiance, were flowing intricately as their sources were vibrant Runes at the center of their weavings!

|Target confirmed. Accompanied by an unknown male. Seemingly human at the Ordinance of Existence level, with a possible glimmer of Runes of Existence around him. All collected weavings have been sent back to the Immovable Sacred Palace. Continuing observation from afar.|

A report was made as multiple Ordinance weaved around the Immovable Sacred Legions- their weavings masked with shocking complexity as they observed their targets that disappeared into a cloudy Blancverse!
Their report traveled far and soon reached the weavings of the Palace Master Antiope and Evrin within the very Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse itself.

When Palace Master Antiope saw the illusory images of the Infiniverse Dowager and the man beside her, her eyes trembled tumultuously as she confirmed the sighting of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian beside her!

The prompts that appeared before his eyes were ones that coursed through her, their unshakable connection carrying their memories and more together!
|A unique Dream exceeding the bounds of Weavings of Existence was experienced due to a Severed Source and intricate Complexity of Existence.|
|An Unsurpassable Dream has been brought to an end after weavings potentially harmful to you made themselves present.|
|Your proficiency in the Amarantos Dream of the Megalos has been elevated to the Fourth Echelon, with your Proficiency at 44%.|

His weavings held an Amarantos Rune of Existence, and so did the weavings of Ozymandias as they both had their Proficiency with it.

And now that he was able to take a closer look, he could see that this so called Proficiency was only how familiar he became with the Amarantos Rune of Existence the more he used it as more and more of his own weavings entered its gaps of complexity- which allowed him to bring out more of its power next time!

chapters.title: Chapter 3391 How to Kill an Existence Defying Being? I
paragraphs: Palace Master Antiope stared at the scene of the Infiniverse Dowager and the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian with extremely stern eyes.
They had, at times, been seen together.
They had worked together multiple times as they were believed to be extremely complex entities whose goals aligned, and so they worked together!
But...they actually had such a history? Even before they Severed their Existence and Pioneered their own paths, they were always together?
This information caused different parts of her mind to light up as the Infiniverse Dowager was terrifying enough.
The Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian...this Tyrant one one that many beings feared!

|The one responsible for your daughter is truly no ordinary being. If Palace Master Evrin holds trust in me, we will continue doing this my way, where we observe and follow for the next few days. After that...we will make a move that will ensure to give you closure.|
She kept her voice calm as she spoke to the Palace Master whose murdered Daughter of Existence was the root cause of this whole unfolding reality.
And Evrin only nodded as even though he knew there was something much more there, he didn't ask!
Within another area in the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse.

Palace Master Antiope portrayed the same scene she observed from the Ordinance Amalgamation Entities currently observing a certain Blancverse- the illusory image that showed the Infiniverse Dowager and the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!
|They obviously have a greater history than we came to know, but yes. He is here too. In these weavings. This chance...|
|It is not a chance as much as what we need to do has become twice as hard- nay, ten times as hard. One Infiniverse Dowager is terrifying enough, but adding the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian?|
Before Palace Master Antiope.
The only Pioneer of Existence amongst them spoke out as his gaze was one full of thought and caution.
Heracles!
Palace Master Antiope gazed at him and the only other entity to come here with them- Nisa, her gaze currently a somber one.
Palace Master Antiope breathed calmly as she spoke once more.

|I am not underestimating them, really. But again, we have a Pioneer and Existence Severing entities on our side while they have the power of Ordinance Amalgamation currently. Ordinance Amalgamation! Besides fearing so much of who they might become in the future, let us come up with ways to kill these beings that seem to defy Existence itself!|
WUU!
Her words were resonant.
Around the three of them, dazzling green leaves flowed and wrapped around everything as above Pioneer Heracles, a vibrant green rune rotated calmly.
A Constellation Rune of Existence that read- Quarantine!
It was spinning with a vibrant glow, but the level of complexity held within this single rune exceeded the complexity that all the weavings of Existence Severing could radiate.

It isolated everything about themselves and what they talked about here as with it, even a terrifyingly perceptive entity wouldn't be able to feel an inkling of a bad feeling or sensation about them being plotted against, or even the threat of death.
All possible weavings of existence were quarantined!
Pioneer Heracles gazed at the fluttering stellar green leaves around them as he spoke out with an ancient voice.

|The Wheel turns as the Wheel turns. Maybe...we shouldn't do anything at all. Maybe this is how events are supposed to flow. Our entry into these Weavings of Existence already violates enough. If we make truly significant moves...|
|We are in these weavings of existence because we ran away! From beings like them!|
Palace Master Antiope felt immense rising frustration as she pointed towards the illusory pictures of Infiniverse Dowager and the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian.
|Please, Heracles. We have already gone through this and arrived at this step. And when it comes to killing...there are many ways for it that are not just purely killing.|
|Oh?|
The brows of Heracles arose as beside him, Nisa looked towards Antiope questioningly.

|If these are the Source Weavings of Existence of the Infiniverse Dowager and the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian, we simply have to ensure they do not continue. Apart from seeking to kill them- something we are taking many precautions for, we can also do something a step below in difficulty while achieving the same result. We can...imprison them.|
WAA!
Imprisonment?
This word caused the eyes of Nisa and Pioneer Heracles to gradually shine before they radiated a terrifying light!
Nisa even rose up as the leaves around them fluttered while she asked.
|You don't mean...that place?|
That place.
Something they had only heard about, and their biggest fear before they gave up a tremendous amount of their power to take the risk of jumping into a different frequency of Existence!

The eyes of Heracles pulsed with brilliance as he also seemed to be thinking. He thought of legends from cycles past that were inherited as horror stories regarding the vastness and immensity of the Wheel of Existence! Horrors not meant to terrify children, but any entities who dared to think of traversing the different Weavings of the Wheel of Existence.

|A place feared by even the most complex beings that have communed with the Wheel of Existence. Any entities who sought it forever disappeared from any records...you think that Frequency of the Wheel we nearly fell into was it?|
Something that made even the most complex of entities fearful.
At their level of power, very few things, if any, could make such entities fearful!
Yet those who truly knew spoke in hushed whispers about a place that was part of the Wheel...and also not.
About a frequency that existed and did not truly exist as there were no weavings of it. And yet when those with weavings fell into it...they never returned.
Antiope looked at her two compatriots as her eyes didn't hold any hesitation.
Before all of this, in the past, they were all equals. She looked at Pioneer Heracles who had pulled ahead now as she spoke with confidence!

chapters.title: Chapter 3392 How to Kill an Existence Defying Being? II
paragraphs: |It wasn't just us who made the jump. Others did not make it. That flash of frequency that nearly took us out as well...I say it is worth the risk to backtrack and find that frequency once more. But not for us...we simply direct it towards our targets. Towards the Infiniverse Dowager and the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian who have yet to mature. They won't be able to avoid the pull as if we are somehow wrong and we fail, then they will fall into another Spoke of the Wheel and be deterred from their original path. If that does occur, they will be out of these weavings and give us time to grow. But if we succeed, and they truly are sent into that place where even the most complex entities fear...|
HUUM!
The three entities surrounded by swirling leaves of a Constellation Rune of Existence breathed heavily!
Pioneer Heracles had bright eyes at this moment as they seemed to flicker with countless stars.
|This...may just be feasible. But the cost we will pay is going to be extremely heavy.|
To backtrack.
To find that sliver of weaving, not just for themselves, but to direct it towards a certain location and targets!
It was going to be unfathomably difficult.
But...
Antiope's expression showed a crazed madness at this moment as she remembered how helpless she felt at the terror of the Infiniverse Dowager.
|I am prepared to pay any cost. Any cost at all!|
One was filled with conviction.
The other two looked at each other and also became firm as Heracles rose up grandly.
|We'll get started. This may take some time, and the more time passes, the more variables arise.|
Veiled in powerful complexities, a terrifying scheme unfolded within the depths of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse!
Within the Megalos Ynnere.
In an undefined Sector.
Noah gazed at the vastness of Megalos Ynnere as the Cartographer of Existence, and what he could see was getting more and more complex.
The changes began when he traversed into the other weavings of existence as Ozymandias, and then as himself.
The Map of Megalos Ynnere he was looking at...seemed to be constantly shifting and overlapping as the areas he covered seemed the same- but not.

It required more time and utilization to understand, but he felt like these changes were leading to a tremendous product as the thought in the back of his mind was...what if he could map out the Megalos of different weavings of existence entirely? Would he be able to find and traverse into specific ones with ease?
There were many possibilities, but...
|Now what?|
The voice of Command Protector Valeria echoed out beside him in the Omniversal Voyager as Noah shook his head and spoke calmly.
"Let's go say hi. Only you and your sister can come as we don't need too many extras for this."
He waved his hands calmly as he looked at the Omniverse he had entirely blocked the weavings of- where nobody could go in or out without his permission!
Everything was covered by the hazy golden light of the Ordinance of Dreams.
|Sis Valeria, what is this?|

Protector Lucretia came up behind them as Noah only waved his hands, the three of them disappearing from this Omniversal Voyager and instantly transferring into the massive Omniverse he had locked down!

With his current weavings, the figures of Command Protector Valeria and Lucretia could be considered beneath him in complexity, but he didn't want to become someone who only used others when he needed them and then threw them away thereafter.
The least he would do was Sever any points of karma between them and wrap up something that to the current him...was a minor matter.
HUUM!
They appeared atop the peak of a massive stellar black mountain the size of a Cosmos that floated in the center of this Omniverse- amidst many other mountains of similar size.
Around them, thousands of Reapers of Existence turned towards their direction, and hundreds of titanic Outerversal Morphons wriggling with tentacles surrounded them even further out.
And further ahead, the visage of a clouded figure seated on a throne of wriggling tentacles had a somber expression while looking at all of them, and Noah only nodded simply towards him.
"Hey man."
Towards the Great Ponderor.
Nietzsche!
Noah nonchalantly called out while teleporting right into the center of his forces!
Around, there were at least a dozen Outerversal Morphons that had reached the stage of One With Existence, and two that had attained the state of the Eye of Existence!
All of them were followers of Nietzsche as this was his last bastion.
And now, the man he was scheming against and seeking to make an enemy had come knocking, even when he had discussed with Savitar that he wanted things to be over!

Besides Noah, the figures of Command Protector Valeria and Lucretia were trembling as they looked around them and sensed the stifling auras of Outerversal Morphons, with Lucretia even shaking when she felt the connection towards the Great Ponderor as she looked at her sister- as if wanting to ask her. When did she know?
But she couldn't even focus on this as it felt like their very lives would end in the next moment.
Even Command Protector Valeria was barely grasping the state of One With Existence as around them, there were multiple, along with even more terrifying auras!
Why...did Protector Osmont bring them to their deaths?!
Even as such despair settled in.
None of the terrifying Outerversal Morphons made a single move.
The only one who did move was Noah as he walked forward calmly, looking around while speaking.

"I hate very little of these grand weavings of existence, but something I hold in great distaste are schemes in the dark. People thinking they can plan and plan, and then use convoluted plots to somehow win against me. You, my dear Nietzsche, thought you could do this."
WAA!
He strolled across the stellar black earth of this mountain as he went towards the throne of tentacles the Great Ponderor sat on.
At this moment, the gaze of the Great Ponderor was extremely twisted as his form gradually became clear.
He had the head of a devilish goat with tentacles wriggling beneath his chin, his body humanoid and filled with obsidian roiling tentacles as he sat on his throne.
And when he looked around all the forces he had gathered.
All the Outerversal Morphon with high echelons of Megalos Regnum and Outerversal Physiology.
Every single one...seemed to currently be frozen and unable to move moments before this being even appeared.
Faint particles of gold could be seen as the complexity of the Ordinance of Dreams filled with the weight of the Infiniverse Megalos Physiology pressed down on everything!

Noah had just ripped apart Ordinance Amalgamation entities- so what danger could there possibly be against a Quasi-Ordinance Amalgamation entity such as the Great Ponderor and the few entities under his banner that were even weaker than him?
This whole thing...was a walk in the park for Noah as the entity who was more powerful than him just a matter of a few days ago and had set his sights on him...had given him too much time.
A few days.
This was far too much time to give Noah!
Now, he came to collect with unfathomable ease!

Towards the Great Ponderor.
Nietzsche!
Noah nonchalantly called out while teleporting right into the center of his forces!
Around, there were at least a dozen Outerversal Morphons that had reached the stage of One With Existence, and two that had attained the state of the Eye of Existence!
All of them were followers of Nietzsche as this was his last bastion.
And now, the man he was scheming against and seeking to make an enemy had come knocking, even when he had discussed with Savitar that he wanted things to be over!

Besides Noah, the figures of Command Protector Valeria and Lucretia were trembling as they looked around them and sensed the stifling auras of Outerversal Morphons, with Lucretia even shaking when she felt the connection towards the Great Ponderor as she looked at her sister- as if wanting to ask her.
When did she know?
But she couldn't even focus on this as it felt like their very lives would end in the next moment.
Even Command Protector Valeria was barely grasping the state of One With Existence as around them, there were multiple, along with even more terrifying auras!
Why...did Protector Osmont bring them to their deaths?!
Even as such despair settled in.
None of the terrifying Outerversal Morphons made a single move.
The only one who did move was Noah as he walked forward calmly, looking around while speaking.
"I hate very little of these grand weavings of existence, but something I hold in great distaste are schemes in the dark.
People thinking they can plan and plan, and then use convoluted plots to somehow win against me.
You, my dear Nietzsche, thought you could do this."
WAA!
He strolled across the stellar black earth of this mountain as he went towards the throne of tentacles the Great Ponderor sat on.
At this moment, the gaze of the Great Ponderor was extremely twisted as his form gradually became clear.
He had the head of a devilish goat with tentacles wriggling beneath his chin, his body humanoid and filled with obsidian roiling tentacles as he sat on his throne.
And when he looked around all the forces he had gathered.
All the Outerversal Morphon with high echelons of Megalos Regnum and Outerversal Physiology.
Every single one...seemed to currently be frozen and unable to move moments before this being even appeared.
Faint particles of gold could be seen as the complexity of the Ordinance of Dreams filled with the weight of the Infiniverse Megalos Physiology pressed down on everything!

Noah had just ripped apart Ordinance Amalgamation entities- so what danger could there possibly be against a Quasi-Ordinance Amalgamation entity such as the Great Ponderor and the few entities under his banner that were even weaker than him?
This whole thing...was a walk in the park for Noah as the entity who was more powerful than him just a matter of a few days ago and had set his sights on him...had given him too much time.
A few days.
This was far too much time to give Noah!
Now, he came to collect with unfathomable ease!

chapters.title: Chapter 3393 Tyrannical Oppression! I
paragraphs: The whole situation was utterly surreal.
For Protector Lucretia, it even seemed like a nightmare!
The one she was bound to.
The one she felt stifled by even just thinking about! He now stood before her, his bodies layered on top of each other to show the culmination of terrifying power.
With multiple powerful Outerversal Morphons that seemed to come close to Savitar, they were entirely surrounded!
Yet...
Yet...!
Not a single movement was felt from the Outerversal Morphons even as Lucretia and Command Protector Valeria pulsed with trepidation.
Every passing millisecond that they waited for the eruption of shocking complexities, nothing happened!
They couldn't help but turn ahead towards the man walking forward and talking as if he was only taking a stroll.

He seemed to know everything that was going on as he walked across the stellar dark earth, eventually beginning to float up as he came to the eye line of the massive visage of the goat-headed Outerversal Morphon- the Great Ponderor!

Was it all him? This was all his doing? His sheer brilliance stopped the movements of all Morphons as he now stared directly at the most powerful one that gave the Commonwealth a great deal of trouble?!
"All the plotting has come to this point right here. All the twists and turns of causality since you set your eyes on me in that Half Tainted Omniverse. Is there anything else for you to say?"
The Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian had a calm expression as he asked the Great Ponderor.
And Nietzsche...had his weavings silently churning as his intent weaved out.

|One knows when to take a step back. I am willing to take this step back. I won't even fight back as you can consider this Body the price I am willing to pay to close off and sever the entangled weavings between us.|
A Great One took a step down.
And yet...
The Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian shook his head!

"You do not fight back because you cannot. I care not for your body. I want what you first want to give out. Your dignity. Your honor. Your Megalos Regnum. And don't waste too much of my time either as the more time that passes, the more I will be inclined to collapse your weavings here and in the Pantheon of Umbra as well."
His words caused the eyes of Nietzsche to vibrate and tremble!
He could see the words were not lies. Somehow, this being could legitimately reach out to even the Megalos Beyond- he could cover such a vast distance!
How? Through Savitar? No, that didn't make sense- he wasn't aura enough. Then who? Through who?!
These questions buzzed in the Great Ponderor as he listened to his weavings of danger once more.

They were overloaded in defeat at this moment as even with his terrifying complexity, even with his planning and plotting...he found that without making a single move against his enemy, he was defeated.
|Haha...|
He laughed with madness and self-deprecation while shaking his head.
|Even if I present you my Megalos Regnum-|
"I will take it."
WUU!
Noah waved his hands nonchalantly as a golden necklace lifted from his neck, showing the dazzling stellar obsidian Megalos Regnum Crown of another Great One on this necklace!
Seeing it, Nietzsche trembled while giving Noah an extremely difficult look.
With every passing second, he felt like extremely oppressive weavings of complexity would close down all around him at this moment, he closed his eyes and accepted it.
Even without a fight, he had lost!
HUUM!
His body pulsed with luminous obsidian light that all flowed to form a dazzling black crown- all of his dignity and regnum flowing into it as at this moment, Noah reached out and grasped it!
With a terrifying force, it flowed into the thread of the golden necklace as of this moment on...another Megalos Regnum Crown of a great one was bound to Noah.
He stared at the two stellar black crowns without any emotion as he spoke.
"Release that girl behind me. She is no longer your Delegatus."
Nietzsche gazed behind Noah at the stupefied visage of Lucretia and Command Protector Valeria as his eyes flashed.
|Yes...err, how should I refer to you?| With his very dignity and honor bound by another, Nietzsche adapted quickly as he asked.
"Dreamer. Dreamer of the Megalos."
|Yes, Dreamer.|
Brilliance flashed within Nietzsche's eyes as instantly, a line was cut.
In the distance, Lucretia felt a sense of weightlessness as she breathed heavily, checking deeply in her heart as truly...the connection she was bound to was gone!
This...!
She held no words as all of this seemed like a pure dream!
Yet the visage of Noah took a single step to appear before them and nodded lightly, a golden necklace with two obsidian crowns settling on his neck.
"You are forever cut off from the Great Ponderor. What you do now depends on you. Will you head back to the Omniverse of the Protectors- to the Commonwealth, or will you follow me?"
He spoke about heavy choices calmly as the two sisters gazed at each other, their buzzing minds gradually calming as Command Protector Valeria looked at her sister and then back to Noah.
She then gazed at the eerie Outerversal Morphons frozen all around them and the distant Great One that Noah had tyrannically suppressed, and she...shook her head.
|Thank you for helping me achieve something I thought would be the death of me and my sister. I cannot repay you enough for this action but...I will go back to the Commonwealth.|
A choice was made.
And Noah only nodded calmly before he flashed a smile towards these two women.
"Then everything between us can be considered closed. Until we meet again..."
WAP!
He waved his hands as the figures of the two sisters disappeared- sent back to the Omniversal Voyager that would be heading back to the lands of the Commonwealth!
While Noah himself...

He turned back and gazed at the Great One, who was much more powerful than even Savitar, as he spoke out nonchalantly. "Alright big guy. Let's see your Records and memories. From when you were born until now..."

There was much to learn and understand about the Megalos Beyond and the Megalos Ynnere, and these entities that had lived for many millions upon millions of years had a great deal of knowledge and answers!

chapters.title: Chapter 3394 Tyrannical Oppression! II
paragraphs: As Noah gained another Megalos Regnum Crown in one area within the Megalos Ynnere.

In the Tresoverse Domain of the Omnifather, a Singularity was extinguished as entities seated upon three thrones attained the right to the Origin Sacred Complexity Modus Operandi contained within an Origin Tresorverse Tower of Existence!
The Selection here was the fastest compared to the Quintessential, Rare, or Average Tresorverse Towers of Existence.
Seated on the thrones that began to move towards three different directions, the Viceroy of the Commonwealth looked towards Noah with a sharp gaze.
They left behind weaker call Ordinance of Existence beings who gritted their teeth and scrambled away to fight for the lesser Tresoverse Towers of Existence!
Within this vast space where all those that had entered the Trunk of the Primaltree of Existence were sent to, the throne Noah was on rapidly shot out into a distant golden tower.

The golden tower itself looked like a massive monolith that opened up and swallowed him whole- his body direction through layers of weavings before the crown settled itself in the center of the tower.

From the inside, the walls were transparent and vast as Noah could see what was happening outside, but the most important thing was the dazzling allure of gold light that was spinning in the very center of this tower!
As he arrived, so did the monotone intent that was ringing out this whole time arrive.

|Familiarize yourself with the Origin Sacred Complexity Modus Operandi and prepare to defend against hordes of prisoners put in a position just below you, with their freedom contingent on defeating you and destroying the towers that you and others occupy.|
The spinning golden singularity was the promised Origin Sacred Complexity Modus Operandi.
When its hazy glow finished, Noah clearly saw an extremely complex rune that held a profound complexity similar to the Amarantos Rune of Existence!
Similar- but not all the way at its level as it still seemed a level off.
But this Rune of Existence was a terrifying one that allowed one to increase their output of weavings of Existence by 500%!
Noah didn't like that it was another person's Rune of Existence, and they would know every single entity who was utilizing their Rune- but he knew this was a temporary measure.
Once he broke down the components of each Rune of Existence and understood it entirely, he could engineer his own and make it even better than before.
HUUM!
He reached out and grasped the golden Rune of Existence as it settled into his weavings- coming to settle near his chest as it pulsed with a dim gold light, asking to be activated!

Above Noah, a dazzling Sacred Primal Eye of Existence opened as he observed the intricacies of this Rune of Existence while allowing a dense amount of his weavings to flow into it, instantly causing it to spin and radiate circuits- meridians all across his body as there were 81 in number.
81 dazzling gold meridians that looked like Ethereal rivers of gold stretched out across his weavings of existence!
When his weavings flowed into them, they increased in power and potency every time they completed a cycle across all these Meridians.
The more of his weavings he put in, the more this output of power increased as his body began brimming with pressure many times more powerful than before!
This...was what a single powerful Rune of Existence could achieve.
The Great Beyonder had put out Crucibles of the Beyonder that contained things like the Amarantos Rune of Existence, the Defy Rune of Existence, and the Sword Rune of Existence.
The Omnifather took a different route and put out different variations of Runes of Existence that increased the output of one's weavings of existence!
Different methodologies, but the same results of strengthening their respective Megalos in the end.

Noah knew there had to be an equivalent entity similar to the Great Beyonder and the Omnifather on the side of Megalos Nihilos, and he felt sour missing whatever boons it had prepared for the entities within Nihilos!
'Hopefully, that guy is enjoying some of it at least...'
His eyes twinkled as he thought of the Great Usurper who had crossed Megalos Ynnere and into the Megalos Nihilos before the boons of the Omnifather had bloomed.
Alongside his thoughts, he sat down and analyzed the Origin Sacred Complexity Rune of Existence, being lost in his own weavings for some time!
Unknowingly, a few hours passed.

In the surroundings, other selections were completed as those who had enough strength to obtain ownership of Quintessential, Rare, and Average Tresorverse Towers of Existence received them. Noah's attention only came to when he felt the buzzing of the Tresoverse Domain and a booming voice that spread out all around.

|The selection of the Towers of Existence is completed. Within the next few moments, the Prisoners dwelling in this Domain will be released. Defend against them and hone the complexity of your Weavings of Existence. Be defeated, and be lost in the cycles of endless weavings.|
The voice was cold as if it was letting a dangerous reality be known- that if they faltered, they could very well perish here!

Noah spread his will out as he heard this booming voice, the landscape of this domain having rapidly changed as he found that the 3 Origin Towers of Existence were stationed extremely far apart, while Quintessential Towers and other Towers were scattered throughout. Almost as if they truly were in defensive positions and they needed to ensure that nothing bypassed them!
One region had entities at the Ordinance of Existence level, while much further ahead, Entities at the stage of Ordinance Amalgamation were stationed.

Behind and around in a circular formation, those with lesser weavings at the Eye of Existence and below were also stationed as the whole domain seemed filled with dazzling Towers of different colors, all of them together spanning and covering a region equivalent to the length of over 200 Omniverses!
They had their own battles to fight as the region a single Ordinance of Existence entity covered where they could exert their power may just be the equivalent of a single Omniverse or less.
It would be a war of expansive scale!
WU!
In the distance, terrifying auras began to leak out as in the dark void of this domain...
Far, far ahead, space ripped apart as if an endless prison was finally being opened, and those within could not wait to charge out!
From the blooming cracks in space, golden limbs stretched out and split apart the space even further- showing the appearance of Titanic golden humanoid existences.
Existences that were very reminiscent in the eyes of any entities that were lucky enough to enjoy the Reconstruction of the Megalonians!

chapters.title: Chapter 3395 Unbound Obsession! I
paragraphs: Those who had been present in the Reconstruction of the Megalonians would be able to observe that the golden titans coming out of imprisonment were eerily similar to the massive golden titan that had begun the assault on the Megalonians long, long ago. At the moment these auras arose and spread out, Noah's own will buzzed with magnificence as a terrifying obsession lying within the depths of his being blazed out- the obsession of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian howling out at the release of entities with Lineages linking back to a certain massacre!
The obsession was heavy as it called for cataclysm and blood- for destruction of utmost depth to fall on these enemies!
Noah frowned at such strong waves of obsession flowing out of the past weavings of Pyrrhus as he looked ahead at the waves of Golden Titans that were ripping apart space and coming out.

The Omnifather had jailed a whole lineage belonging to someone who led the eradication of the Megalonians? Just what power had this being attained to allow him to carry out such an action to rectify his mistakes?
There were no answers freely hanging by.
At this moment, the maddening aura of these Golden Titans continued to spread out, their wills and intent roaring out alongside their surging power.
|OMNIFATHER!|
|You will pay for this!|
|Blood for blood!|
A cacophony of noise and intent erupted out as it was unknown how long these entities were jailed for.

Among them, there were abundant auras of Ordinance Amalgamation by the hundreds, and Ordinance of Existence by the tens of thousands- and a few hundred thousand auras of those below them in the states of Existence that were surging out like waves!

It was a force that was enough to cause even Old Man Eudemus and other Ordinance Amalgamation entities to turn somber- even if they had just attained the Sacred Modus Operandi within their own Towers of Existence that amplified their weavings.
Because the level of complexity and brutality displayed by the Golden Titans as they came out...was utterly overwhelming.
Their eyes blazed with golden flames as they looked out at the cluster of Defense Towers.
Past them, they seemed to see their freedom as they howled out while moving forward with indomitable splendor!
|Progeny of the Jailer!|
|ENSLAVERS!|
The Jailer.
Another distinction of the Omnifather based on his actions as the rest of them were branded with the titles of enslavers.
Alongside these bellows, booming waves of complexity also began to arrive as an Ordinance Amalgamation Golden Titan took great strides to arrive near a multicolored Tower of Existence.
Multicolored representing Ordinance Amalgamation.
The gaze of the Golden Titan was livid as his hand reached out, enlarging for countless light years to nearly become as big as the multicolored tower that was the length of an Omniverse!
|You keep us enslaved for Cycles in order to repent? To repent for the sins of the Father?! And now, you think we will be target practices for your own Lineage?! You motherfucker!|
BOOM!
The enlarged golden hand carried interminable power as the Defense Tower it reached blazed gloriously.
Around the Defense Tower the size of an Omniverse, the illusory image of an Antediluvian Leviathan appeared- as dazzling multicolored Rune of Existence buzzing at the very center of his being.
A rune of existence that caused over 100 Meridians to shine brilliantly over his massive figure, crimson flames wrapping around this Ordinance Amalgamation entity as he was fire personified.

With his weavings enhanced by a terrifying Rune of Existence that seemed to exceed even an Origin Sacred Complexity Rune of Existence in power, along with the granted defenses of the Tower of Existence he remained inside of- he could face multiple Ordinance Amalgamation entities!
These were the preparations of the Omnifather.
To ensure that his people could overcome everything in the end, and use these Prisoners who shared a deep history and shame of his past to forge themselves into powerful combatants.
To prepare for what was to come!
HUUUM!
Crimson galaxies of flames seethed and formed in front of the Defense Tower, the heat being so potent that it could be felt from afar.
It was multiple times more powerful and complex compared to what a normal Ordinance Amalgamation entity could unleash, but in the face of all this...
|Haha...you fuckers!|
The forefront Golden Titan laughed with crazed madness.
|All these cycles of isolation. Unable to even enter the Expanse. Unable to call for help. Unable to know whether those we loved were alive or dead....we wanted to die. I wanted to die!|
The aura of this Golden Titan began to subtly change.

|I wanted to die, but my hatred kept me going. Against the one who really believed himself to be above others, as if they were some force of good for the Wheel of Existence! Throughout all of it...death was only an arm's length away as I have learned to not fear it. We...have learned to not fear death.|
HUUM!
The illusory gaze of the Ordinance Amalgamation Antediluvian Leviathan defending the massive multicolored Tower rapidly changed as he began to pant.
Ahead of him.
Towards the Golden Titan that had stated it did not fear death.
A horrid aura was rising as this creature yelled out with eerie calmness.
|Sever.|
BOOOM!
|I sever the hatred I felt during all these cycles. I sever the pain. I sever my obsession. I sever all emotions...and I sever my Existence entirely.|
A horrid progression of events.

All Ordinance Amalgamation entities and below participating in the Tresoverse Domain of the Omnifather had their gazes rapidly changed as they felt a terrifying aura bloom ahead- this Golden Titan actually disregarding life itself and not even worrying about the collapse of his existence as he went ahead and performed Existence Severing on the spot.
Not secluded in cultivation.
Not while carefully protected by others.

Mid battle, this entity sought to Sever his existence as none knew whether he would be successful or not, but what was abundantly clear...was the level of power this entity expressed as his golden hand now carried ten times as much heaviness and complexity.

It smacked down and crushed the stellar crimson flames of millions of swirling galaxies and smashed onto the multicolored Defense Tower- causing it to tremble before a crack appeared on it and it was smashed backwards!

sentences.text: Those who had been present in the Reconstruction of the Megalonians would be able to observe that the golden titans coming out of imprisonment were eerily similar to the massive golden titan that had begun the assault on the Megalonians long, long ago.

At the moment these auras arose and spread out, Noah's own will buzzed with magnificence as a terrifying obsession lying within the depths of his being blazed out- the obsession of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian howling out at the release of entities with Lineages linking back to a certain massacre!
The obsession was heavy as it called for cataclysm and blood- for destruction of utmost depth to fall on these enemies!
Noah frowned at such strong waves of obsession flowing out of the past weavings of Pyrrhus as he looked ahead at the waves of Golden Titans that were ripping apart space and coming out.
The Omnifather had jailed a whole lineage belonging to someone who led the eradication of the Megalonians?
Just what power had this being attained to allow him to carry out such an action to rectify his mistakes?
There were no answers freely hanging by.
At this moment, the maddening aura of these Golden Titans continued to spread out, their wills and intent roaring out alongside their surging power.
|OMNIFATHER!|
|You will pay for this!|
|Blood for blood!|
A cacophony of noise and intent erupted out as it was unknown how long these entities were jailed for.

Among them, there were abundant auras of Ordinance Amalgamation by the hundreds, and Ordinance of Existence by the tens of thousands- and a few hundred thousand auras of those below them in the states of Existence that were surging out like waves!

It was a force that was enough to cause even Old Man Eudemus and other Ordinance Amalgamation entities to turn somber- even if they had just attained the Sacred Modus Operandi within their own Towers of Existence that amplified their weavings.
Because the level of complexity and brutality displayed by the Golden Titans as they came out...was utterly overwhelming.
Their eyes blazed with golden flames as they looked out at the cluster of Defense Towers.
Past them, they seemed to see their freedom as they howled out while moving forward with indomitable splendor!
|Progeny of the Jailer!|
|ENSLAVERS!|
The Jailer.
Another distinction of the Omnifather based on his actions as the rest of them were branded with the titles of enslavers.
Alongside these bellows, booming waves of complexity also began to arrive as an Ordinance Amalgamation Golden Titan took great strides to arrive near a multicolored Tower of Existence.
Multicolored representing Ordinance Amalgamation.
The gaze of the Golden Titan was livid as his hand reached out, enlarging for countless light years to nearly become as big as the multicolored tower that was the length of an Omniverse!
|You keep us enslaved for Cycles in order to repent?
To repent for the sins of the Father?!
And now, you think we will be target practices for your own Lineage?!
You motherfucker!|
BOOM!
The enlarged golden hand carried interminable power as the Defense Tower it reached blazed gloriously.
Around the Defense Tower the size of an Omniverse, the illusory image of an Antediluvian Leviathan appeared- as dazzling multicolored Rune of Existence buzzing at the very center of his being.
A rune of existence that caused over 100 Meridians to shine brilliantly over his massive figure, crimson flames wrapping around this Ordinance Amalgamation entity as he was fire personified.

With his weavings enhanced by a terrifying Rune of Existence that seemed to exceed even an Origin Sacred Complexity Rune of Existence in power, along with the granted defenses of the Tower of Existence he remained inside of- he could face multiple Ordinance Amalgamation entities!
These were the preparations of the Omnifather.
To ensure that his people could overcome everything in the end, and use these Prisoners who shared a deep history and shame of his past to forge themselves into powerful combatants.
To prepare for what was to come!
HUUUM!
Crimson galaxies of flames seethed and formed in front of the Defense Tower, the heat being so potent that it could be felt from afar.
It was multiple times more powerful and complex compared to what a normal Ordinance Amalgamation entity could unleash, but in the face of all this...
|Haha...you fuckers!|
The forefront Golden Titan laughed with crazed madness.
|All these cycles of isolation.
Unable to even enter the Expanse.

I wanted to die!|

I sever the pain.

chapters.title: Chapter 3396 Unbound Obsession! II
paragraphs: A disastrous set of events unfolded as one of the foremost Defense Towers was knocked back.
Around it, the illusory visage of the Antediluvian Leviathan showed great pain as it trembled, as if their very weavings of existence had experienced a great shock!
It was the complexity of an entity that was halfway into Existence Severing!
Quasi-Existence Severing!
It was a stage barely anyone would experience or battle against as no madman would do it in front of others unless there were absolutely no options for them.
But this being...was driven by hatred and obsession to the point that they carried out such drastic actions!
But that wasn't all.
|You Peons of the Omnifather do not know our pain. Our history. Our Lineage. Today, you will know what it feels like to be judged and tossed aside. Today, you will know pain.|
HUUM!
Other Golden Titans gathered behind and around this being.
Multiple Golden Titans at the Ordinance Amalgamation stage...radiated a light of madness as their existence warped.
|Sever.|
|Sever!|
|Existence...Severing!|
One after another.
In a terrifying display of obsession and conviction, multiple Golden Titans at the Ordinance Amalgamation stage Severed their Existence- but luckily, it wasn't all of them.
After all, to even attempt to sever one's existence, one had to reach a prerequisite level of complexity.
If one's complexity was still far too low, even if they wanted to Sever, it was an impossibility.
If they forcefully did so while their complexity was far too low, their weavings would collapse within nanoseconds!
But so far, those watching counter over a dozen Golden Titans radiate the terrifying aura of Existence Severing as they stepped on a path of no return.
If they succeeded, a genuine Existence Severing entity would be born. If they failed, they would have had time to massacre the lineage of the man who imprisoned them here all these cycles at least!
This was the price for their obsession.
BOOM!
They weren't the only ones.
As Ordinance Amalgamation Golden Titans did this, those at the Ordinance of Existence level...erupted with heavy might as many proceeded to amalgamate with their Ordinance right away.
Disregarding the risk of the collapse of their existence if they weren't entirely in tune with their ordinance- they proceeded ahead!
And those below them...sought to declare their Ordinance for the first time!
It was a heavy and shocking scene as at this moment, all those who had entered the Tresoverse Domain of the Omnifather wondered...did the Omnifather account for all this?
For the obsession and hatred of the ones he imprisoned over the cycles to be this high?!

The weaving of existence ahead of them caused them to feel a sense of trepidation, with these beings moving with crazed power as, even in their state of Severing, they charged toward the Defense Towers!
WUU!
As if the weavings of Existence themselves were moving against them.
The entrants who should have been experiencing a rapid period of growth within the Tresorverse Sacred Domain of the Omnifather fell into unprecedented peril.
The area where the multicolored Tower of Existence was smacked away from now held no protection of an Ordinance Amalgamation entity, and a Quasi-Existence Severing Golden Titan moved forward.
|Time Snap.|
HUUM!
His intent radiated outwards.

Full of malice and wild abandon, it targeted the towers manned by the Ordinance of Existence entities and below, in addition to the knocked away multicolored Tower that held a flickering illusory radiance of the beaten back Antediluvian Leviathans.
The Ordinance of Time erupted from the Golden Titan. He was amalgamated with it, and he now Severed himself outside the scope of existence with this Ordinance at his core!
A circular purple radiance spread out around him and covered an equivalent length of 10 Omniverses- an illusion of a massive round purple clock blooming and holding everything in place.
It was filled with heavy complexity as all those within the scope of this illusory clock...found themselves frozen and unable to move their weavings!
As if they were stuck in a weaving of time that they couldn't move back or forward against, with everything being frozen.
Thereafter...
|AOUU!| The Golden Titan bellowed while throwing out a simple fist into the illusory purple clock.
The instant the golden Fist was thrown into the illusory clock, multiple illusory purple Temporal Fists formed in front of all frozen Towers of Existence.
They tumbled forth with interminable power of extinction and malice as they smashed onto every single tower- no matter whether the tower was the size of an Omniverse or less!
The moment the impact occurred, there was no conflict.
No fight.
No opposition.

The smashed Towers of Existence shattered and broke apart into purple shards influenced by the shocking Severed Ordinance of the Golden Titan, the entities within these towers who were brimming with possibilities minutes ago....they felt their own weavings of existence smashed with the Existence collapsing Temporal Fists as everything about themselves began to shatter into shards of purple light!
The multicolored Tower of Existence that had the dazed Ordinance Amalgamation entity was the first to shatter- along with its owner inside it.
All other Towers in the area affected by the illusory purple clock followed such a fate as horrifically, it seemed like there wouldn't be any survivors in this single strike of a Golden Titan!
It seemed that way.
But.
In the affected area glowing with purple radiance.
There was a single Golden Origin Tresorverse Tower of Existence.
One that had an entity who had an Origin Sacred Complexity Rune of Existence swirling within him, but he also held much more.
Oh, so much more!
Faced with the Temporal Fist that was extinguishing all other Towers of Existence without even a fight, his Tower of Existence radiated a tremendous light of complexity.
It even seemed to tremble at the sheer complexity being released by him that it had to support!
Against the unstoppable light of a Quasi-Severed Ordinance of Time- one that was in the process of being Severed anyway, a dazzling golden wheel bloomed around the Tower of Existence.
Kuklos!
Ignoring the shackles of Time.
This golden wheel radiated an ancient air of complexity as...it seemed to be defiantly Severed.
Severed?
Why would a Severed Source of Kuklos appear in a Tower of Existence occupied by an Ordinance of Existence entity?!

chapters.title: Chapter 3397 Unbound Obsession! III
paragraphs: The scene was a disastrous one.

Merely one of the Quasi-Existence Severing Golden Titans made a move, and yet an Ordinance Amalgamation Antediluvian Leviathan and the Tower of Existence he protected was shattered alongside a dozen Towers of Existence that Ordinance of Existence entities occupied, including a few dozen towers manned by those less powerful!
By all means, it was a scene of devastation.
And yet!
Among this devastation, there was a single tower that was untouched!
Around it, a dazzling golden wheel formed and spun as it radiated a light of Severed Existence.
It was the only thing capable of moving in this domain of frozen time!
When it bloomed, many found themselves questioning with emotion.
Was there actually an Existence Severing entity on their side hiding this whole time?
It was a question for many- the wonder if there were multiple Existence Severing entities that entered the Tresoverse Domain of the Omnifather.
At this moment, they would truly be needed as these terrifying Golden Titans could become genuine Existence Severing entities at any moment!
If their weavings didn't collapse.
If many were successful in their Severing.
The Tresorverse Sacred Domain of the Omnifather would turn into a land of bloodbath!
HUUM!
The Severed golden wheel of Kuklos spun with heaviness and indisputability.
The Golden Titan looked towards this wither with crazed eyes as he bellowed out.
|Break for me...Break for me! Temporal Decimation!|
His words were those of a maddened entity.
But his power was very real as all around, the purple brilliance brought with it a light of extinction that made its descent on the golden Tower of Existence!
But...
WU!
The wheel continued to spin heavily as around the Tower of Existence, the hazy illusion of a devilishly handsome Emperor manifested.
An Origin Sacred Complexity Rune of Existence spun rapidly at his center as 81 Meridians lit up brightly, his gaze currently exceedingly cold!
But his eyes.
His eyes stared towards the Golden Titan as they held...a hint of an undeniable obsession. An obsession that showed complex rage and hatred that didn't entirely fit the calm face!
But such eyes looked at the Golden Titan as if they already considered him dead.
When his figure made an appearance, many were astonished as some had seen his face before when they were climbing the roots of Primaltree of Existence.

Those belonging to the Commonwealth were even more astonished as they had seen the face and details of this being after the Viceroy asked about him- even more so when he was able to attain one of the three Golden Origin Tresorverse Towers of Existence!

His figure was shrouded in mystery as he should be a Protector of the Commonwealth, and yet he wasn't. He should be weak, having barely entered the states of Existence, and yet...he wasn't! The only reason he wasn't labeled an enemy was that until this point, Old Man Eudemus vouched for him.
And now, he showed a Severed Source- and it was Kuklos nonetheless?!
In a far distance, the Viceroy of the Commonwealth was in his tower as he looked towards this direction with blazing eyes!
Amidst the Antediluvian Leviathans, there was one burning with waves of Entropy around a multicolored Tower of Existence at this moment who stared over in shock.
Wasn't this...that young friend he had been racing on the roots of the Primaltree?!
There were many gazes and reactions.

But the man in question didn't bother with all of this as he focused on the enemy before him, the weavings of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian buzzing as if that scene of decimation all those cycles ago was playing in front of its face again and again.
His very blood burned as his Meridians pulsed.
His weavings were amplified as through them, he carried the weight of the Infiniverse Megalos Physiology and cycled it through the buzzing weavings of Kuklos!
"Time is merely a part of the weavings of the Wheel."
HUUM!
His voice reverberated out with seemingly just as much hatred as the Golden Titans. "Why would your time hold any significance before the Wheel?"
A blinding light of gold pressure and weight blasted out of the spinning wheel that seemed far too solid.

The light blazed and actually fractured the purple brilliance and the illusory clock that had formed into a domain that could cover an entire Omniverse, and it formed into trillions of smaller golden wheels that surged to smash onto the massive Golden Titan like a halcyon sea!
BOOM!
Like an unstoppable tide, it smashed forth and illuminated everything as it was far too fast.
It was heavy, and yet so fast!
The countless golden wheels smashed onto the body of the Golden Titan mightily, imposing a tremendous weight and pressure that seemed to be asking again and again...
|What is Time before the Wheel of Existence?!|
|What is Time before the Wheel of Existence?!|
|What is Time before the Wheel...!|
Again and again, his body was bombarded with such an intent along with the sea of golden wheels.
|OOOH!|
He roared out with maddening purple fervor as the clash dispersed, but his expression was livid as even though he didn't take heavy damage...his body was currently trembling with instability.
The reason why many would seclude themselves when Severing their existence.
Any heavy interruptions that could sow any seeds of doubt to what one was Severing could be deadly!
And after facing a bombardment of trillions of Wheels while having his Ordinance questioned...his weavings now trembled with instability and began collapsing!
Collapsing!

|OOOH!| The Golden Titan bellowed out with unfathomable wrath towards the illusory figure watching him coldly, other Golden Titans arriving beside him as their expressions were heavy. Their eyes were filled with malice as they all turned to gaze toward the interminable visage of the one responsible.
The gazes of all Quasi-Existence Severing Golden Titans and those behind them!

The single man on a lone Tower of Existence took their gazes and stares without backing down, an obsession in his eyes even rising as his illusory visage was seen breathing in waves of authority, his roar billowing out!
"Let's go!"
WAA!

The single man on a lone Tower of Existence took their gazes and stares without backing down, an obsession in his eyes even rising as his illusory visage was seen breathing in waves of authority, his roar billowing out!
"Let's go!"
WAA!

chapters.title: Chapter 3398 Unbound Obsession! IV
paragraphs: Golden Titans on one side.
A single Golden defense Tower on the other.

The image of an illusory emperor within this tower staring at the shocking number of forces of the Prisoners all by himself etched itself in the minds of many- as if he alone would shoulder this burden!
But they knew.
The moment he fell, a disaster would bloom.
So in the next instant...
|Charge!|
|Defend!|

The Tresorverse Towers of Existence stretched out across this space buzzed and moved, with the Ordinances of the Ordinance Amalgamation Entities shooting out across the equivalent length of 5 Omniverses or mortuary forming a tide that surged towards the Golden Titans.

They saw that they didn't necessarily have to have the power to overcome and defeat the Golden Titans- they only had to disrupt their weavings significantly enough to ruin their Severing or Ordinance Amalgamation and cause the collapse of their Existence!
So they moved.

The Golden Titan that had initially faced Noah and now held collapsing weavings of existence roared out, turning into a streak of purple gold brilliance as even while his Ordinance and weavings collapsed...there were still waves of purple radiance trying to reverse everything.
|Death, I do not fear!|
He roared maddeningly as he came before Noah's massive tower once more; Noah's eyes honed in on him and the other auras that now moved alongside him as he let out a harrumph.
In terms of Complexity, he wasn't far off.
In terms of Runes of Existence, he was even putting himself above them!
And to take care of this burning obsession of Pyrrhus...bathing in the Blood of these Golden Titans didn't seem bad as he once more pulled upon the heaviness of the Infiniverse Megalos Physiology!
In the surroundings.
|Defend!|
Other Towers of Existence arrived as in one, the illusory visage of a seated old man could be seen.
It was none other than Old Man Eudemus who was looking towards Noah's Tower of Existence with an extremely somber gaze that seemed to hold millions of questions and no answers.
Alongside it, dozens of other multicolored Towers of Existence holding the terrifying weavings of Ordinance Amalgamation also arrived and erupted out towards the Golden Titans!
It felt like two roiling seas of weavings would soon clash, and no side wanted to lose as every single entity joined in.
Whether they were at the Ordinance Amalgamation stage or merely One With Existence.
They all released their attacks that joined in together to form a startling sea of brilliance!
And Noah, at the center of all of this, let loose entirely to satiate and give way to an obsession for the last time.
After this, he could keep this obsession repressed as he moved without listening to its blazing wrath, merely having it in the background as a tool of recognition of the enemies around him!
But at this moment, it was free.
He could feel the unbound obsession within the very blood of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian as time seemed to slow down to a minute, incomprehensible level.
The Severed golden wheel of Kuklos that was spinning slowly began to speed up as countless waves of authority flowed into it.
Infinite waves of authority!
The weight of the Infiniverse Megalos Physiology was terrifying, yes, but there was also the weight of infinity.
It may not carry as much tonnage, but it had the genuine weight of endlessness that at this moment, Noah let loose freely.

Countless concentrated waves of immense complexity flowed into the rapidly spinning wheel- his whole Tower beginning to radiate a terrifying Golden light as at such a moment...his massive illusory body channeled all of this power into his fists.
An obsession wanted carnage.
He was granting carnage.
In slow motion, his right fist struck out once as his hand burned like a scorching Golden sun.
His left fist then followed with a similar presentation as it seemed unfathomably slow!
But in this slow pacing, his hand pulled back as he punched out again, and again, and again!
The stopped time only seemed to be for him as if the weavings of Kuklos deemed it so.
And his golden fists that seemed like slow bombs of power...gradually began to seem extremely rapid as they turned into a barrage of golden fists composed of trillions of small golden wheels.

The moment the span of an instant passed, what bloomed in front of Noah's tower were thousands of massive golden outlines of his fists shooting out, each one equivalent in size to a tenth of an Omniverse as they covered absolutely everything.
They caused the sea of attacks on their side to shine with golden brilliance as many were only able to catch a glimpse of it before the impact bloomed on both sides.
BOOOM!
It was an unfathomably heavy cluster of complexity coming together all at once as every single entity was swept up in it!
As this heavy impact of two seas occurred.
Outside of the Tresorverse Sacred Domain of the Omnifather.
Within the Megalos Ynnere.

An unkempt entity that was floating in the blankness of the Megalos Ynnere with multiple Omniverses circling around him raised his head and looked far above- as if there was something only he could see that others could not.
His eyes were starry and filled with brilliance, with an aura far exceeding that of Existence Severing silently bubbling under his skin!
The entity that had disappeared from the throngs of the Commonwealth just before the portals leading to the Tresorverse Domain bloomed.
An entity that Old Man Eudemus and others had never been able to truly understand or grasp the true extent of his power.

At this moment, his gaze seemed to be crossing untold distances to see what was happening within the trunk of the Primaltree of Existence, his eyes filling up with ever increasing brilliance as he sighed.
"Is this truly the right path, Omnifather?"
Words of doubt and longing at the same time.
This being wondered of such weavings as he rose up- intently gazing up and ready to move in case he needed to!

chapters.title: Chapter 3399 Carnage! I
paragraphs: Within the Megalos Ynnere, a being wondered whether the path he was on was the right one.
Around him, dozens of Omniverses rotated as the complexity required to keep them all miniaturized and in such a state was utterly unfathomable.
Even the strongest of entities with immeasurable complexity of existence experienced doubt, much less those who were weak.
It was general. It was unavoidable.
Across countless weavings.
Outside the scope of the vast Megalos Ynnere, Megalos Beyond, and even Megalos Nihilos.
Within a unique frequency of Existence.
Within an extremely unique Spoke of Existence!
Inside a region of the Expanse filled with a mixture of black and white strings.
There was a shadow of a woman who was sitting on a white string, her hands holding an Omniverse as she seemed utterly engrossed in it.

Her entire figure seemed to be made of a cluster of shadows that existed and didn't exist at the same time, her complexity being utterly frightening as it was not at the level of a Terrestrial Entity nor a Constellation Entity!
Even a Pioneer of Existence that stood above Existence Severing...was still a Constellation Entity.
Above that...was a Source Complexity.
Source!
The complexity of this entity could only be at this stage as, at this moment, another shadow flashed near her.
She didn't even turn towards it as she flipped the weavings of the Omniverse in her hands and asked lightly.
"What is it now? At least tell me it is local."
Her voice was sweet and commanding at the same time, its intent firm and undeniable.
The other shadow was a man with an equally terrifying aura who spoke calmly.
"Sadly not local. A mission of high priority in another Spoke of the Wheel."
"Oh?" The shadow of the woman frowned at such words as she looked up.
"Yes. A few kids are planning on carrying out an action in a unique frequency of the Wheel. We just need to ensure it succeeds."
"Oh? Any more details? Any reason why?" Using the same word, the shadow of the woman replied again.
The shadow of the man was still calm as he paused at these questions momentarily before he replied.

"The only details I was given are that a little Pioneer and two Existence Severing Constellations seek to impose the weavings of...THAT Spoke of the Wheel to ensnare a target. No details were given on who they are or why they are doing what they are doing. We just need to ensure they succeed. As for why...we do not question orders. We merely follow. You know this by now."
The shadow of the woman was briefly silent before it continued.
"Who is the target that even deserves our attention to ensure they end up in that place?"
A heavy question.
Yet the reply was heavier!

"Mission parameters did not include their details either. Nor are we to probe the weavings of the target. Even those above us do not subjectively look at the identities of all those involved as we are supposed to stay away from any Entanglements. We are only supposed to ensure the weavings of the target are ensnared and pulled into that place, that is all. Barbatos...your position may be unique, but you are not above all of us. You cannot operate differently from us. Our job makes it so that we only do what we are told without tainting the Weavings of the Wheel. We only exist-"
"Yes, yes."
The shadow of the woman waved her hands dismissively.
Her shadowy figure was short and vibrant, her eyes sharp and filled with endless light as she continued with her interruption.

"I know. We only exist to ensure the flow of the Wheel. I just...find it odd that we are supposed to never question. Who are they to say that supporting or denying a certain event in some frequency of the Wheel is what allows the smooth turning of the Wheel to continue? We move covertly to make sure our actions aren't observed by THEM, who also stand to watch and ensure the flow of the Wheel. So really...who is right, and who is wrong? Have you ever stopped to consider this, O Amalthos?"
Her reply caused the other dark shadow, another Source Complexity entity, to frown before he replied!

"Barbatos...your father sits among those who gaze across countless weavings and see which screws need to turn in order to keep the flow. If you question him, you can do so yourself. I remain here speaking to you because I was ordered to undertake this mission with you. Simply because I am supposed to be here at this moment, in this Weaving. Otherwise, I would not bother."
WAA!
His words were cold.
Barbatos put away the Omniverse in her hands and looked at him closely as she sighed.
"Supposed to be here...you truly believe such a thing? The flow of the Wheel..."
Her surroundings began to buzz.
As if she was about to say something truly dangerous and profane.
She wanted to say that since she was born, she felt like nobody could truly read the flow of the Wheel.
Nobody could really understand where and what was supposed to happen!
Those who tried to take control, like her father and others, and said what they did was all for the continued flow of the Wheel... may very well be in the wrong.
There were others who took an entirely different approach and simply monitored, preventing any other forces from interfering or jumping between different weavings of the Wheel!
At the end of the day, everybody believed themselves to be right.
As for her? Maybe even she was wrong.
"Haa...never mind." She sighed once more as she rose up.
"Lead the way. I merely exist to follow orders too, yes?"
The other shadow, Amalthos, looked at her silently before terrifying power and complexity began to bubble around him.
Within the span of an instant, they disappeared right after.
Their disappearance wasn't just to another location, but towards another Spoke of the Wheel entirely!

chapters.title: Chapter 3400 Carnage! II
paragraphs: Within a certain Spoke of the Wheel.
Inside the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse.
|How is it?|
Palace Master Antiope and Nisa gazed towards Pioneer Heracles who was focusing on a concentrated singularity of shocking complexity at this moment.
His brows were furrowed as his whole existence of an extremely high level of complexity seemed to be under a great strain!

|When we did this before, we had much more power, and I wasn't alone. Seeking to grasp a pathway that we took before also carries a high level of complexity, and finding the coordinates of that place we nearly fell into to recreate it and then superimpose it on a certain location...is even harder. I do not know how long it will take.|

His words showed just how tremendously the degree of difficulty was even for him, and Palace Master Antiope looked at Palace Master Nisa at this moment before her gaze became firm- her hand turning sharp and sinking into her chest firmly as bursts of golden radiance erupted out.
Her face became pale and gray thereafter as her hand pulled out a dazzling golden singularity that she pushed forward to a shocked Pioneer Heracles.
|Half of my Source of Existence. Use it freely to make sure we achieve our intended purpose.|
Her eyes were filled with conviction.
She knew the terror of the Infiniverse Dowager and the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian as she would do anything.
She would do absolutely anything if the Source of such beings could truly be taken into that place and never get the chance to grow and terrorize countless weavings!
Pioneer Heracles looked at her as his gaze became even firmer, grasping her Source of Existence and taking it into himself while he focused on the complex singularity before him even more.
BOOM!
Tendrils of brilliance erupted all around him as a massive golden Rune of Existence appeared, followed by a purple one, a green one...and many more colors!
His expression turned euphoric as he exclaimed with shock.
|I've found it...I've found the start of the pathway! So long as I follow it, I could bring these weavings to that frequency that terrified us, and then impose it on their location!|
They couldn't do it before.
He couldn't catch any trace of the pathway or reverse it before this, but now, after adding the Source of Existence of Palace Master Antiope, he was successful.
But...was it all because of this, truly? Or was there another hand at play?
Pioneer Heracles controlled his emotions as he turned towards Antiope and Nisa.

|The Blancverse Domain is still in the same place? I'll begin directing coordinates towards it right away so that the moment I get a hold of the weavings of that terrifying Frequency, I can impose them there.|

|Mmm, still at the same place. We have to hurry. Anything can change in an instant.| Palace Master Antiope replied weakly as she focused on the information she was receiving from the Immovable Sacred Legions that were observing a distant Blancverse.
By all means, everything seemed to be proceeding smoothly!
In the Trunk of the Primaltree of Existence.
Within the weavings of the Tresoverse Domain of the Omnifather.

Two seas of complexity crashed into each other, the explosion being something that caused a heavy impact in the weavings of existence- so much so that the whole domain filled with Tresorverse Towers of Existence and the place where all the Golden Titans had been imprisoned were distorted and fractured!
Weavings of existence themselves unwound and shattered as if a painting was torn to pieces, with dozens of Towers of Existence thrown back and filled with cracks as some directly shattered.
On the other side, Golden Titans seethed as from among them, multiple cried out as their weavings of Existence began to collapse.

Those attempting Ordinance Amalgamation, and those Severing their Existence who were smashed with the deadly impact of weavings, especially those massive golden fists that questioned their very core concepts...their weavings began to deteriorate and collapse as they roared out!

In the chaotic weavings of extinct Existence, many wills swept out to ascertain the current situation as they saw a single Golden Tower of Existence still remained right where it was, the illusory figure of a devilishly handsome Emperor gazing at everything with a cruel light as he bellowed out.
|Apocalypse!|
HUUUM!
There was a need for decimation and carnage.

And so, even in this reality where Existence itself was torn to pieces with the very domain of the Omnifather being affected, the Ordinance of Apocalypse was imposed as tremendous weight and complexity was added to it.
Instantly, dreary darkness and crimson flames began to descend and cover an equivalent length of...ten Omniverses.
Ten!
The weavings of Apocalypse imposed themselves over such a vast region as illusory decimated Omniverses began to emerge all around, typhoons of cataclysm forming as hellish flames began to rage!
It was the advent of an Apocalypse that would bring about even more carnage.
But...in the midst of all of this.
|Haha!|
A golden light shone along with a burst of radiant laughter.
It stemmed from the side of the Golden Titans as, at this moment, a terrifying aura rose and continued climbing up with perverted madness.
With utterly perverse weavings of complexity!
It was not quasi.
It was not halfway.

It was a genuine, unblemished aura of Existence Severing as from among the masses of Golden Titans, one had managed to rapidly and successfully sever the shackles that bound them and truly enter into the Existence Severing stage!

Such a phenomenon caused many gazes to change as powerful Towers occupied by Antediluvian Leviathans and the strongest among the Commonwealth, and those who didn't belong to any specific Lineage but had high attainments at Ordinance Amalgamation all came to float around a single Golden tower.
The tower that held a single illusory entity with an Origin Sacred Complexity Rune of Existence spinning rapidly as opposite him...
A massive Golden Titan took center stage while a few others collapsed, his eyes radiating a terrifying light as he looked toward Noah.
|I'm gonna fucking flay you to pieces!|
With indomitable might, an Existence Severing entity moved against the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!
