Weavings of existence themselves unwound and shattered as if a painting was torn to pieces, with dozens of Towers of Existence thrown back and filled with cracks as some directly shattered.
On the other side, Golden Titans seethed as from among them, multiple cried out as their weavings of Existence began to collapse.

Those attempting Ordinance Amalgamation, and those Severing their Existence who were smashed with the deadly impact of weavings, especially those massive golden fists that questioned their very core concepts...their weavings began to deteriorate and collapse as they roared out!

In the chaotic weavings of extinct Existence, many wills swept out to ascertain the current situation as they saw a single Golden Tower of Existence still remained right where it was, the illusory figure of a devilishly handsome Emperor gazing at everything with a cruel light as he bellowed out.
|Apocalypse!|
HUUUM!
There was a need for decimation and carnage.

And so, even in this reality where Existence itself was torn to pieces with the very domain of the Omnifather being affected, the Ordinance of Apocalypse was imposed as tremendous weight and complexity was added to it.
Instantly, dreary darkness and crimson flames began to descend and cover an equivalent length of...ten Omniverses.
Ten!
The weavings of Apocalypse imposed themselves over such a vast region as illusory decimated Omniverses began to emerge all around, typhoons of cataclysm forming as hellish flames began to rage!
It was the advent of an Apocalypse that would bring about even more carnage.
But...in the midst of all of this.
|Haha!|
A golden light shone along with a burst of radiant laughter.
It stemmed from the side of the Golden Titans as, at this moment, a terrifying aura rose and continued climbing up with perverted madness.
With utterly perverse weavings of complexity!
It was not quasi.
It was not halfway.

It was a genuine, unblemished aura of Existence Severing as from among the masses of Golden Titans, one had managed to rapidly and successfully sever the shackles that bound them and truly enter into the Existence Severing stage!

Such a phenomenon caused many gazes to change as powerful Towers occupied by Antediluvian Leviathans and the strongest among the Commonwealth, and those who didn't belong to any specific Lineage but had high attainments at Ordinance Amalgamation all came to float around a single Golden tower.
The tower that held a single illusory entity with an Origin Sacred Complexity Rune of Existence spinning rapidly as opposite him...
A massive Golden Titan took center stage while a few others collapsed, his eyes radiating a terrifying light as he looked toward Noah.
|I'm gonna fucking flay you to pieces!|
With indomitable might, an Existence Severing entity moved against the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!

chapters.title: Chapter 3401 Criticality! I
paragraphs: Existence Severing.
A higher order among the weavings of complexity- a higher order of a Constellation!
There were Minor Constellations, Greater Constellations, and Elder Constellations!
Existence Severing was the last cusp among Greater Constellations as when one went even further beyond, they would have Pioneered their own path and become Elder Constellations.
The level of complexity they could wield...
BOOOM!
Was fast.
And immeasurably heavy.

Instantly, a golden hand enlarged and smashed onto the golden tower surrounded by a Severed Source of Existence- the strike being so heavy that the tower tumbled back and even smashed into other Towers!
Bellows erupted out as over a dozen towers were thrashed like pinballs, heavy damage transferred throughout as the only one that was holding it together was the tower that was struck first.
The massive illusory visage of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian had its chest split, but it was healing rapidly while staring out towards the entity that successfully severed their existence.
A terrifying Golden Titan that had muscles roiling above its skin, a golden horn protruding on its forehead as currently, a terrifying might swirled around it.
|So many years...so much desolation!|
He bellowed out with maddened fervor as Noah...had withstood a strike against such a being!
But of course, this wasn't the first time.

The Infiniverse Megalos Body had survived an Existence Severing will from the Daughter of Existence, and he himself had survived the Will of the Weaver from the Ancient Phrike, Vujun, when he attained the Infiniverse Megalos Physiology!
They could survive, but they couldn't take too many strikes.
After all, the complexity was far too intricate for those who had severed their Existence- escaping the bounds of common sense and becoming capable of doing things others couldn't imagine.

After all, a single Severed Source of Kuklos from Noah had made it possible to traverse into another Weaving of Existence. Of course, the tremendously complex weavings of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed were required, but this was what Severing could do!

The Golden Titan raised his hands high as the descent of Apocalypse itself in the surroundings was halted and rejected, the many illusory shattered Omniverses disappearing as all the land gradually became painted with a golden hue.
This...was the Ordinance of Gold itself.
Gold.
|Gold!|
The Golden Titan proclaimed gloriously as his single word was akin to a declaration.
Instantly, in the proximity of ten Omniverses, everything began to turn Gold.
|OOH!|

Dozens of Towers of Existence became anchored in space as they began to turn Gold, those within it feeling their very weavings become stagnant as all their wills and very being gradually turned into Gold!
First, own Severed their existence.

They became unshackled as the Source they Severed could then be imposed with wild abandon on the surrounding existence- to cause an effect that would have never been so widespread and possible compared to before!
Many eyes watched as this tinged of Gold surged towards Noah's Tower.

In the back, the Tower holding the illusory visage of Old Man Eudemus shot forward, accompanied by one with the visage of the Sword of the Commonwealth as behind them, a golden Tower with the illusory visage of the Viceroy followed!
|Do not let him die!| Old Man Eudemus bellowed out.

His eyes were hazy as they looked at the illusion of the devilishly handsome man who had appeared in front of him days ago as someone who had not even become One With Existence- as someone who hadn't even stepped into the Omniversal Realm!
And now, here he was showing a Severed Source of Kuklos.
There were only two weavings that could be true.
One was that he had always and already been at the Existence Severing stage the time his Omniverse X-999 was discovered and concealed it even in front of Old Man Eudemus.
The other was that truly, he had been an entity that had not even entered the Omniversal Realm, and had not even touched the states of Existence days ago when they first met.

And in that period of time, he had gone through to become One With Existence, attain his Eye of Existence, and then proceeded to declare the Ordinance of Kuklos, Amalgamated with it, and even Severed it!
Two possibilities.
One seemed like sheer fantasy and was filled with incredulity.

After all, if a being truly could truly become One With Existence, attain his Eye of Existence, declare an Ordinance, Amalgamate with it, and even Sever it in a few days...what were the rest of them even doing? They should just lie down and die!
It should be impossible, but Eudemus still deemed it as a possibility.
So if there was even a shred of such a possibility being real...this being could not die!
But how could they stand against a genuine Existence Severing entity?
The allure of gold oppressively pressed all around as it currently blanketed the Tower that Noah was in, seeking to impose its weavings right away!
The dazzling Severed wheel of Kuklos rotating around the tower gradually became slower and slower- but it still held off against this terrifying power of Existence Severing.

In the distance, Old Man Eudemus arrived as the illusions of multiple stacked wheels rotated around his tower, with his weavings enhanced by a Constellation Rune of Existence actually being empowered enough to momentarily stand against the Severed Ordinance of Gold pressing down!
|Pull back! Fight together!|
Old Man Eudemus bellowed out towards Noah's Tower of Existence.
Behind him, the Sword of the Commonwealth had a cold gaze as he looked towards Noah, while the Viceroy held a cloudy expression during all of these shocking revelations!
But even in the face of all these unfolding wonders and dangers, Noah's massive illusory body still looked towards the Existence Severing Golden Titan with coldness and tyranny.
As if he still had cards up his sleeves he had yet to pull out!
Others didn't know.
But at this moment, the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian was wondering.
Was it time for the deployment of Tzar Versepiercers?!

chapters.title: Chapter 3402 Criticality! II
paragraphs: Just as the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian was about to make a drastic decision.
HUUM!
The Trunk of the Primaltree of Existence trembled and vibrated as from above, the weavings of space tore while a single finger bloomed.
A single finger!
And yet this finger was exceeding the size of an Omniverse alone as it appeared and pressed down with shocking complexity above the Existence Severing Golden Titan!
The Golden Titan who bellowed out while throwing a punch upwards, a tide of Gold flowing with him.
Yet before this single finger, the tide of gold seemed unfathomably small.

The allure of gold did nothing, unable to change any weavings of existence in the face of this finger as it cracked and dissipated like foam, the expression the the Golden Titan rapidly changing and worsening as he screamed out while his whole body exploded to become a massive golden sea!
A gold sea that was stretching out to be as vast as possible, rapidly exceeding the length of two Omniverses and only growing.

Yet, the descending finger that didn't seem to have any superfluous air continued to come down, a terrifying force erupting from it the closer it came as the expanding gold sea began to rapidly constrict and become smaller.
As if an unseen pressure of complexity that this gold sea could do nothing against was focused on it!
From exceeding the size of two Omniverses, the golden sea was shrunk so rapidly and heavily that it became the size of a Cosmos, galaxy, and then a world in a matter of seconds.

In another second, the single white-skinned finger continued pressing down as the golden sea became the size of a pebble, its sheen of gold being astonishingly bright as heavy and unresigned screams could be heard from it!
And yet, it still couldn't fight back.
It was compressed to become the size of a grain of sand soon after as within moments...
POP!
The Severed Source of Gold- a newly established Existence Severing entity, perished under the complexity of a single finger.
The chaotic domain turned utterly silent.
The chaotic domain turned utterly silent.
Utter silence!
A single finger had extinguished an Existence Severing entity as how large a gap was required for this?
Such a reality caused those within the Towers of Existence to rejoice while the Golden Titans opposing them gazed forth with blazing resignation.
Why.
Why did they have to be treated like this at every turn?
Why, after cycles of imprisonment, they couldn't even fight back?

Any Golden Titan who successfully crossed the bridge and Severed their existence represented their hopes in getting out of this place- with the Omnifather promising in the past that so long as they used their power to fight their way out, they would have their freedom!
And yet...
|Liars!|
|Cowards!|
|Enlavers!|
The bellows of the Golden Titans rang out with interminable brilliance as their complexity moved like a churning tide.
Those whose Existence was collapsing as they failed to Sever or amalgamate.
Those who still had hope in the process as they continued to seek a path forward!
They all moved as one and continued surging forth like an endless golden sea.
The finger dissipated after killing the Existence Severing Golden Titan, never to reappear again since then.

Noah's illusory gaze had turned above towards the Source of that single finger with a somber gaze, his eyes only turning back to the Titans a moment later as his golden tower moved with wild abandon once more.

Within him, the Origin Sacred Complexity Rune of Existence continued to spin and be studied as he sought to understand and replicate it for himself, with the Infiniverse Megalos Seed making even greater advancements in this field as all of its domains contained in the Blancverse within the Expanse were experiencing further advances due to Runes of Existence!
A language to speak and get ever closer to the Wheel of Existence.
This area was designated one to focus on even during battles as Noah continued to test the limits of what he could do!
Far from the Tresoverse Domain of the Omnifather though.
Within the Omniverse of the Protectors where Noah had left a single body to study the droves of records of the Commonwealth inside a Library.

This body had been sitting opposite Old Man Eudemus, who was shifting about multiple chess pieces, but these chess pieces had all fallen over at this moment haphazardly as Old Man Eudemus looked at him with a difficult gaze.
"Which one is the truth?"
He asked with complex emotions as he sighed.
"That you always had a Severed Source of Kuklos before you even came here, or that you forged it in the past few days when you had not even become One With Existence?"
Old Man Eudemus wanted to know.
He felt like it was critical to know!
Noah looked at this being seeking to solve the Three Body Problem as he smiled and shook his head.
"Does it really matter?"
WUU!
Whether it was one or the other.
What would it truly change?
The gaze of Old Man Eudemus became even more cloudy at such a reply as he asked slowly.

"Did you solve it? Are you further advanced than us in this field- is that why? I ask this not to advance my own hubris, but for the betterment of the Megalos Ynnere. For the solution of the two other Bodies entangled with it. I only seek to understand."
The man's words were filled with earnestness.
Noah looked at the haggard appearance of Old Man Eudemus as he asked with contemplation.
"What do you know about different Weavings of Existence? Different Frequencies of Existence that are just like ours, but different?"
Two questions.
But they caused the facial muscles of Old Man Eudemus to tremble as more chess pieces fell!
"You mean...?" His pupils vibrated all around as he asked like a starved scholar.
Noah looked at the chessboard as he continued.

"Other weavings of existence where another version of Old Man Eudemus may exist. A version where the Commonwealth prospered and became distinguished across the Megalos Ynnere. A version of Weavings of Existence where the Commonwealth was destroyed without a single part of their forces surviving. A version of weavings of existence where Outerversal Morphons have already overcome any resistance and rule over the Megalos Ynnere. Different variations, different Frequencies, and we all exist alongside them on the Wheel of Existence."
BOOM!

chapters.title: Chapter 3403 Criticality! III
paragraphs: The words Noah uttered out were ones that caused Old Man Eudemus to leave behind many things he knew.
To listen without bringing any preconceptions of what he knew!
Different weavings of existence.
Different Frequencies of the Wheel of Existence!
Old Man Eudemus looked towards Noah somberly as he calmed himself and spoke out.

"These...different weavings- are a thing of fantasy that I have only thought of in theory. Whispers that seem to be extinguished just as quickly as they arise. How are you...able to speak of them so freely? How did you learn of them?"
He asked probingly while making sure he wasn't crossing the line. He didn't know much about the being in front of him, and he knew even less now that he mentioned something as shocking as this!
He proceeded carefully.
And Noah looked at the chaotic chessboard before him as he began to pick up the pieces.
"I learned of them through Dreams. An endless dream of countless possibilities, and I only gathered a glimpse of such weavings."
Through Dreams.
Old Man Eudemus smiled when he heard this.
"A dream...how do you know it was real? That it wasn't something constructed of your own weavings?"
It wasn't that he didn't believe.
It was just that this represented far too important a concept!
Yet Noah only smiled while picking up the pieces.
"It was very real. After coming back from a unique Frequency of Existence, I was able to Sever the Source of Kuklos right after. How can it not be real?"
WAA!
The old hands of Eudemus trembled at such words.
Did this confirm that one possibility? That this entity before him truly went from nothing to Existence Severing in days?!
This possible truth caused him to become unfathomably serious as he became silent.
Silent with contemplation.
Silent with heaviness!
Until after a whole minute passed...
"Did you glean any solutions to the Three-Body Problem through this? Did you understand any more than we currently know? Do those different weavings...provide any solutions?"
Understanding and solutions. Were there any to be obtained through these different weavings? Noah smiled at this as he replied while shaking his head.

"I do not know any more than you do. I only know of other possibilities. Other ways to acquire power. The solution you seek, at the end of the day, may be obtained simply if you hold a sufficient amount of power. If you expand what you can currently observe. Because what you know about the Megalos and the Expanse is only a fraction that an Existence Severing entity or a Pioneer of Existence. In terms of Complexity, Pioneers and Existence Severing entities fall in the same stage of Constellations as if you exceed this and attain a Source Complexity...the Three Body Problem may not be a problem to you at all."
What a peasant knew and what a king knew were very different.
The eyes of Old Man Eudemus trembled as he repeated the words that resonated in his mind.
"Source Complexity...Source? Are they able to redefine their own Source? Forge other Sources? How close are they to the Wheel of Existence?"
The Shield of the Commonwealth wondered.
And the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian smiled with reminiscence as he replied.
"I've met one such being in the Expanse. He's either at Source Complexity if not higher. Bob was his name."
"Bob?" Old Man Eudemus raised his brows.
And Noah nodded lightly. "Bob." —
Within unique and unfathomable weavings of existence.
"I feel a tingle...is someone talking about me?"
An entity with a round head surrounded by multicolored waves of singularities scratched his smooth top and looked around.
His surroundings were utterly complex weavings of chaotic brilliance- with it being difficult to even discern what exact location he was in based on this.
But the senses of this being were never wrong as his singularities for eyes turned contemplative.
"Could it be that kid? Or that girl? Or the most recent one?"
Many faces passed across his eyes as he couldn't decide, eventually shaking his head before he began to frown.

Moments later, around these complex weavings that even most Source Complexity entities would have a hard time figuring out, a pathway opened amidst the multicolored radiance as a figure slowly walked in.
"Sir Bob, I hope you don't mind my intrusion. I came to see if I could pick the brain of someone as esteemed as you. Maybe a cup of tea as well?"
The voice was feminine in nature.
It stemmed from an entity who seemed to be made of pure white light, her form humanoid as her face only held two singularities and a mouth!
A star of white floated above her head serenely as she gave off immense waves of peace and serenity.
Yet when Bob looked at her, his singularities squinted as a sharp light flashed through them.
"You motherfucker. You wouldn't come here unless you wanted to use your light to prevent me from seeing something. What are you planning? What have you done?"
WAA!
His words were direct without any roundabout means.
He looked at the entity that was made of pure white light who looked wrong right after!
"Sir Bob, I would never. I respect you far too much for me to do something like that. I truly came to pick your brain about something."
The entity stated so as she floated near the immensely complex weavings around Bob, starting that she came here to discuss something, and yet so far, she had not mentioned anything!
Bob looked in her direction coldly as he shook his head while voicing out.

"Don't fuck around with me. I have no qualms about ignoring any semblance of rules if I'm really pissed off. When will you all come to learn and accept not to interfere with the weavings of the Wheel of Existence? When will you understand that it never needed any of us to ensure its flow? The Wheel has been here long before you or I. Who was overseeing its flow then? You all..."
Bob shook his head with great distaste as he looked at the being before him!

sentences.text: The words Noah uttered out were ones that caused Old Man Eudemus to leave behind many things he knew.
To listen without bringing any preconceptions of what he knew!
Different weavings of existence.
Different Frequencies of the Wheel of Existence!
Old Man Eudemus looked towards Noah somberly as he calmed himself and spoke out.
"These...different weavings- are a thing of fantasy that I have only thought of in theory.
Whispers that seem to be extinguished just as quickly as they arise.
How are you...able to speak of them so freely?
How did you learn of them?"
He asked probingly while making sure he wasn't crossing the line.
He didn't know much about the being in front of him, and he knew even less now that he mentioned something as shocking as this!
He proceeded carefully.
And Noah looked at the chaotic chessboard before him as he began to pick up the pieces.
"I learned of them through Dreams.
An endless dream of countless possibilities, and I only gathered a glimpse of such weavings."
Through Dreams.
Old Man Eudemus smiled when he heard this.
"A dream...how do you know it was real?
That it wasn't something constructed of your own weavings?"
It wasn't that he didn't believe.
It was just that this represented far too important a concept!
Yet Noah only smiled while picking up the pieces.
"It was very real.
After coming back from a unique Frequency of Existence, I was able to Sever the Source of Kuklos right after.
How can it not be real?"
WAA!
The old hands of Eudemus trembled at such words.
Did this confirm that one possibility?
That this entity before him truly went from nothing to Existence Severing in days?!
This possible truth caused him to become unfathomably serious as he became silent.
Silent with contemplation.
Silent with heaviness!
Until after a whole minute passed...
"Did you glean any solutions to the Three-Body Problem through this?
Did you understand any more than we currently know?
Do those different weavings...provide any solutions?"
Understanding and solutions.
Were there any to be obtained through these different weavings?
Noah smiled at this as he replied while shaking his head.
"I do not know any more than you do.
I only know of other possibilities.
Other ways to acquire power.
The solution you seek, at the end of the day, may be obtained simply if you hold a sufficient amount of power.
If you expand what you can currently observe.
Because what you know about the Megalos and the Expanse is only a fraction that an Existence Severing entity or a Pioneer of Existence.

In terms of Complexity, Pioneers and Existence Severing entities fall in the same stage of Constellations as if you exceed this and attain a Source Complexity...the Three Body Problem may not be a problem to you at all."
What a peasant knew and what a king knew were very different.
The eyes of Old Man Eudemus trembled as he repeated the words that resonated in his mind.
"Source Complexity...Source?
Are they able to redefine their own Source?
Forge other Sources?
How close are they to the Wheel of Existence?"
The Shield of the Commonwealth wondered.
And the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian smiled with reminiscence as he replied.
"I've met one such being in the Expanse.
He's either at Source Complexity if not higher.
Bob was his name."
"Bob?" Old Man Eudemus raised his brows.
And Noah nodded lightly.
"Bob." —
Within unique and unfathomable weavings of existence.
"I feel a tingle...is someone talking about me?"
An entity with a round head surrounded by multicolored waves of singularities scratched his smooth top and looked around.
His surroundings were utterly complex weavings of chaotic brilliance- with it being difficult to even discern what exact location he was in based on this.
But the senses of this being were never wrong as his singularities for eyes turned contemplative.
"Could it be that kid?
Or that girl?
Or the most recent one?"
Many faces passed across his eyes as he couldn't decide, eventually shaking his head before he began to frown.

Moments later, around these complex weavings that even most Source Complexity entities would have a hard time figuring out, a pathway opened amidst the multicolored radiance as a figure slowly walked in.
"Sir Bob, I hope you don't mind my intrusion.
I came to see if I could pick the brain of someone as esteemed as you.
Maybe a cup of tea as well?"
The voice was feminine in nature.
It stemmed from an entity who seemed to be made of pure white light, her form humanoid as her face only held two singularities and a mouth!
A star of white floated above her head serenely as she gave off immense waves of peace and serenity.
Yet when Bob looked at her, his singularities squinted as a sharp light flashed through them.
"You motherfucker.
You wouldn't come here unless you wanted to use your light to prevent me from seeing something.
What are you planning?
What have you done?"
WAA!
His words were direct without any roundabout means.
He looked at the entity that was made of pure white light who looked wrong right after!
"Sir Bob, I would never.
I respect you far too much for me to do something like that.
I truly came to pick your brain about something."
The entity stated so as she floated near the immensely complex weavings around Bob, starting that she came here to discuss something, and yet so far, she had not mentioned anything!
Bob looked in her direction coldly as he shook his head while voicing out.
"Don't fuck around with me.
I have no qualms about ignoring any semblance of rules if I'm really pissed off.
When will you all come to learn and accept not to interfere with the weavings of the Wheel of Existence?
When will you understand that it never needed any of us to ensure its flow?
The Wheel has been here long before you or I.
Who was overseeing its flow then?
You all..."
Bob shook his head with great distaste as he looked at the being before him!

chapters.title: Chapter 3404 Criticality! IV
paragraphs: The being before Bob shook their head and replied serenely.

"You observe and ensure. I also observe and ensure. I only move because others move. We all move to stop the movements of others who may do what they shouldn't, or go where they shouldn't. We are all on the same side."
Bob looked at this being calmly as he shook his head in a manner that seemed to show his disinterest and apathy.
As if he knew that whatever he said would not matter here.
So he simply lied back and relaxed while echoing out a few more words.
"One of these days, you all are going to force the hand of something truly heavy with your actions. When that day comes and you all cannot bear the weight..."
Foreboding words.
With them, everything faded into oblivion as the weavings in this area became heavily veiled!
At such a moment.
Within the Expanse.
Inside of the Immovable Sacred Palace.

|Haha...this should be impossible- but I think I've found it. I'm barely able to hold on, but I've found it! With it, the pull of the Frequency will absolutely take in the chosen targets and any possible signatures of their weavings across these weavings of Existence. Clones, separate bodies...anything sharing a connection will be taken without fail! Haha!|
Pioneer Heracles didn't believe the smoothness of how everything had been going so far.
With bloody eyes, he turned towards Antiope again.
|The Blancverse hasn't moved, right?! It is still at the same place? I can move these weavings there right away if so!|
His whole existence was vibrating as he couldn't keep this up too long.
A terrifying singularity of complexity- and even he was afraid of it as he could now only keep it at bay for so long!
|Wait, let me confir-...! What!|
Palace Master Antiope gritted her teeth as blood flowed from her mouth.
|The Blancverse just moved! Hold on, the Immovable Sacred Legions are tracking it again!|
The situation instantly turned chaotic.
Pioneer Heracles was somber as he only spoke out grimly. |It has to be quick. It has to be quick!|
It had to be quick.
As their forces scrambled within this region of the Expanse.

Noah was within the Infiniverse Megalos Seed as he observed the dazzling emergence of grander and grander concentrations of complexity as multiple massive Amplification Runes of Existence were now forged and floating across many regions of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
This was just the start as these Runes of Existence were extremely versatile, and there were far too many uses!
Around him, the very Ordinance of Runes swirled as he continued to fill it with waves of Complexity to aid in the understanding and forging of Runes of Existence.
He wanted the time to freely study them as this whole time, he sensed the cluster of Ordinance Amalgamation entities in the background who seemed to be intent on observing him and not making a move.
They no doubt came as the forces that the now-dead Daughter of Existence promised would come, with there being one or multiple Existence Severing entities behind them.
He couldn't yet freely decimate Existence Severing entities, but he also wasn't worried about the protection of the Blancverse!
But being under a constant surveillance was also not something he preferred as if they wanted a chase until some time passed and they would all be eradicated in time...he would give it to them.
"Let's move."

He spoke succinctly as authority pulsed lightly from him, through the Infiniverse Megalos Seed, and into the Blancverse Domain as it blazed brilliantly before warping away- moving rapidly across the golden strings of existence!
In a faraway region of the Expanse.
Flickering shadows could barely be discerned as everything about themselves was masked- as if nothing about their auras could leak or touch any weavings of Existence here.
At this moment, one shadow looked at another.
Barbatos stared at the shadow of Amalthos as he spoke with stern eyes.

"The weavings below are at a critical juncture. The target is moving away as we simply need to keep it in position now, and then ensure they are pulled towards that place. Remember, we do not peer through their weavings at all- no knowing their identities or anything else. We cannot be entangled!"
"Yes, yes." Barbatos rolled her eyes at this as she pressed down with her hands, exerting a silent pressure along with Amalthos beside her!
The complexity of their power was something few could understand.
A press of their hands could mean far too many things as at this moment...a Blancverse that was moving rapidly across the Expanse became wrapped by a terrifying silver black light.

Instantly, the strings of existence around it flickered and pulled as if they had fallen under the control of another, and this Blancverse followed a path in reverse as within moments, it returned right back into the position it was at!
The Immovable Sacred Legions that were already setting off came to a stop as they looked at the returning Blancverse Domain in shock and stupor.
It came back? This...
Even as their weavings buzzed, they reported this information back to the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse!
Within the Blancverse, Noah and the Infiniverse Megalos Body stepped out of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed- entering the larger Blancverse itself as their gazes were somber.
The action of the Blancverse Domain was shockingly reversed, a terrifying weavings of power pressing down from all around as Noah felt a sense of foreboding!

The Infiniverse Megalos Body also moved sternly as she stared at the boundless complexity of the silver black light surrounding the Blancverse, her hands clapping and releasing a heavy shockwave that...
BZZT!
Was only absorbed seamlessly akin to the waves of a sea.
Noah's weavings burned when he saw this.
A terrifying Sacred Primal Eye of Existence opened as he tried many things!
Moving the Blancverse was shockingly deemed impossible as if a terrifying complexity locked them down in place.
He sought to move the Infiniverse Megalos Seed...and even this was anchored in place!

Every single thing was shockingly anchored in space in a manner they couldn't even fight against- this type of complexity they faced far exceeded the bounds of Existence Severing as it had to be that of a Pioneer or higher!
The silver black authority...held a feeling of inevitability as if it stated no matter how much one struggled, what it deemed to come to pass would come to pass.
Why? Why did this terrifying power seek to keep them in place? Noah did not want to wait to find out.
Infinite waves of authority began to leak out from him as by his side, Ruination appeared and turned into a massive, austere armament!
These...were the weavings of their actions.
But far from them.
In the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse.
|They...they returned to the same initial location! They can't seem to move, as if they are being held down...|
Palace Master Antiope blinked in shock and confusion at the scene that didn't make sense.
But before her, Pioneer Heracles could barely hold on any longer as he roared out while releasing the singularity filled with shocking complexity in his hands.
|I cannot hold it any longer! If he is in those same coordinates, then I shall send it there!|
BOOM!
The space around them splintered and shattered as a singularity filled with shocking complexity warped, instantly appearing above a Blancverse in a far away location!

chapters.title: Chapter 3405 Inevitability! I
paragraphs: Palace Master Antiope and Nisa watched the terrifying singularity warp and held towards a certain location.
Their weavings felt breathless at this moment as they almost couldn't believe it.
Would it truly succeed?!
|I...I want to see it for myself! If the Infiniverse Dowager and the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian are truly about to disappear forever, I want to see it for myself!|
Her eyes were burning with crazed fervor as she remembered the humiliation and fear she felt at the hands of the Infiniverse Dowager.
Having to run away just from hearing she neared their positions!
She wanted to see her disappearance for herself!
BOOM!
The space in front of her splintered as she disappeared into it- golden strings leading to the area where the Immovable Sacred Legions were burning brightly.
The haggard visage of Pioneer Heracles was ashen as he didn't even get the chance to stop her, his eyes cloudy as he sighed and also moved- Palace Master Nisa also gritting her teeth and following.
Two Existence Severing Constellations and a Pioneer.
They already had the location on hand as with a single jump, they warped above the Immovable Sacred Legion within moments and observed the shocking reality up ahead.
The moment they arrived...
|Move further back!|
Pioneer Heracles shouted out towards everyone as he warped away a distance of three Omniverses.

The others soon scrambled away as well as they watched a terrifying silver-black radiance hold down a Blancverse, and now, an even more terrifying complexity erupted out in the form of a singularity as it ensnared the Blancverse and everything within it!
From the singularity, a gray string bloomed.
A single gray string.
And yet it carried such a complex and profound ancientness that even from afar, every single entity felt a sense of trepidation.
A sense that told them if that gray string touched them, their weavings would cease to exist!
Ordinance Amalgamation Entities, the two Existence Severing Palace Masters, and Pioneer Heracles, all felt this same sensation without a doubt equally.
As if power didn't matter before this gray string.
Before the gray frequency that Pioneer Heracles had simply pulled upon a minuscule amount of its weavings for.

And even this nearly cost him all his weavings as he wasn't seeking to traverse across another frequency of existence- but simply to start the journey towards a specific frequency to cover a certain area!
The power of the frequency in question would do the rest.
It's pull, once caught in it- even Source Complexity entities could not run away from it.
But for everything to line up and work out as it was...far too many things had to align just right.
Pioneer Heracles was somber as he saw the silver black brilliance of authority in the surroundings slowly begin to fade away.
The power that had actually held the Blancverse here.
|There is another hand at play here...it wasn't just us making a move!|
Pioneer Heracles became even more haggard at this realization as the others were stern.

Palace Master Antiope had a crazed look as she peered deeply into the Blancverse, where a shocking level of complexity far exceeding even the most top-tier Ordinance Amalgamation entities was erupting out.
|It doesn't matter, does it? So long as the Infiniverse Dowager and the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian are lost towards that frequency!|
She spoke freely with a hint of exhilaration as she saw weavings of that frequency entirely wrap around the Blancverse.
It would not be able to escape now no matter what!
So she freely talked as while peering into the Blancverse, her eyes came in contact with the three Entities currently within it- especially the one she always feared this whole time!
The gaze of the Infiniverse Dowager.
HUUUM!
Palace Master Antiope subconsciously stepped back and breathed heavily before she stood firm and stared back.
The Infiniverse Dowager was about to forever disappear.
Nothing of her weavings could hurt her!
While staring straight at the Infiniverse Dowager, her fierce gaze caught the enraged eyes of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian as well.
A terrifying calm rage she had only heard of before during events of that great war where hundreds of thousands of Existence Severing entities fell.
But so what? No matter what his rage could do now-
OOOOH!

She felt the bellow of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian travel from afar as it shook her to her core, observing a terrifying Golden Severed wheel blooming around him as it sought to break from the influence of the inescapable weavings covering the whole Blancverse!
That...
|Existence Severing?!|
Palace Master Antiope was shocked while Pioneer Heracles shook his head with a wry smile.

|What did I tell you about not underestimating them? Especially the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian. Imagine if we had gone in and fought thinking they only held power at Ordinance Amalgamation, and then they suddenly reveal a Severed Source of Existence. I wouldn't be surprised if they had other tricks, so this path was the best one! Even if another hand played a part in it...|
Heracles looked around them silently as he couldn't sense any weavings of anything else whatsoever.
The only thing he saw...was the Blancverse beginning to warp as it rapidly began to be swallowed into a terrifying gray string!

|Existence Severing, Pioneer...none of it matters before the weavings of that frequency.| Palace Master Antiope gritted her teeth as she looked towards the disappearing Blancverse and bellowed out all her fears and frustrations.
|You will not be missed, Infiniverse Dowager! You can fuck off all the way, Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!|
A bellow of all her resentment from so many years. From the sleepless nights and the terror she felt towards their future weavings!
It reached the Blancverse and the entities within that had tried everything to no avail.
|Antiope, hush! Never celebrate before utmost completion!| Pioneer Heracles remained stern as he looked around constantly- observing the rapid rate of disappearance of the Blancverse!
At the same time, those within the Blancverse became unfathomably somber as they stared above- at gray light wrapping around everything as it made one thing abundantly clear.
Inevitability.
This single word and what it stood for was made abundantly clear at this moment!

|Existence Severing, Pioneer...none of it matters before the weavings of that frequency.| Palace Master Antiope gritted her teeth as she looked towards the disappearing Blancverse and bellowed out all her fears and frustrations.
|You will not be missed, Infiniverse Dowager!
You can fuck off all the way, Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!|
A bellow of all her resentment from so many years.
From the sleepless nights and the terror she felt towards their future weavings!
It reached the Blancverse and the entities within that had tried everything to no avail.
|Antiope, hush!
Never celebrate before utmost completion!| Pioneer Heracles remained stern as he looked around constantly- observing the rapid rate of disappearance of the Blancverse!
At the same time, those within the Blancverse became unfathomably somber as they stared above- at gray light wrapping around everything as it made one thing abundantly clear.
Inevitability.
This single word and what it stood for was made abundantly clear at this moment!

chapters.title: Chapter 3406 Inevitability! II
paragraphs: Nothing worked.

No matter if Noah Severed all the hundred plus Sources of his existence, no matter if they were all amalgamated with him- he had the distinct feeling that even with such complexity, he couldn't escape that blooming gray brilliance.
He recognized it to be the brilliance of a frequency of the Wheel.
But it was far too terrifying.
Once wrapped up in its light, it was inevitable to flow into it as this held many implications!
And the ones to cause all this...
|...You will not be missed, Infiniverse Dowager! You can fuck off all the way, Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!...|
The intent of the newly appearing entities from a distance rang out clearly across the Blancverse as the culprits were made clear.
Infiniverse Dowager.
Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian.
They knew them.
They knew of them!
But...
'From other weavings of existence?'
Noah's eyes were bright as he thought of the only possibility where these beings could have met them or known of them.

He had many questions and things to think of, but the terrifying gray light above didn't give any recompense as with a brilliance of inevitability, it touched him, the Infiniverse Megalos Seed and Body, and Ruination!
Instantly, his gaze became even more somber.
Far from the Expanse.
In The Megalos Ynnere.
Opposite a chess board, a figure of Noah seated in front of Old Man Eudemus instantly changed his expression as a terrifying gray light wrapped around him, and he disappeared right away. ...!
On the other side of the chess board, Old Man Eudemus scrambled back with a horrified look as his weavings of existence continued to shake from merely being near the gray light!
In another region of the Megalos Ynnere.
Within an Omniverse where the Great Ponderor had taken refuge in.
Nietzsche looked utterly terrifying as the new Master that had just bound his Megalos Regnum was warped away by a gray light that made him feel like a newly born Morphon!
Within the weavings of the Tresoverse Domain of the Omnifather.

Inside of a Golden Tower of Existence, Noah's brilliance was only just beginning to unfold when in the next moment, blinding gray light that caused the Golden Titans and those within other Towers of Existence to feel trepidation and fear erupted out.
It consumed the brilliant Golden Tower Noah was in as anybody near scrambled away with fear, and when they looked back...they only saw a split tower.
Lifeless and dim, it was decimated as the weavings of the one within it were far gone.
Nobody moved in the next few seconds as they feared the reappearance of the gray light that had just flashed!
Any weavings of Noah's.
His clones.
His other bodies.
Anything related to Noah Osmont...was not spared as it was ensnared by the terrifying gray light that only left behind terrified observers.
All of it was brought back and superimposed on his body within the disappearing Blancverse!
Back in the Expanse, Noah stared at the terrifying gray light somberly as he spoke to the Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
"Be ready for anything. Entanglement is guaranteed, but death is not."
He couldn't feel a sensation of death from this terrifying gray light.
But the feeling it did give seemed to be even worse than death! What could be worse than death?
He didn't know, but he would be ready for it as he watched the gray light that was enveloping everything.
Within the Expanse.
Surrounded by complex weavings of Existence, a shadowy figure confirmed a few things before he nodded.
"Alright, let's go. The target is ensnared in the weavings of that frequency as we have ensured the success of this event. Mission parameters stated not to be near whatever blooms here."
Amalthos uttered out calmly as his figure began to flicker with silver black radiance.
What others found unfathomably hard to do- the traversal of different weavings of existence, was merely something that required a decent amount of effort to achieve.

Since they were done here, and were not supposed to peer and see any details regarding those involved in this event, their mission was entirely completed as the only thing remaining was to ensure that none of this could be traced back to them!
"Yes, yes. Let's go." Beside him, Barbatos was wrapped up in the same brilliance as her shadowy body began to flicker away.
Within the span of an instant...
WAP!
The shadows of these two beings entirely disappeared as if they were never here to begin with!
And silence reigned in this area as slowly, veiled complexity began to die down.
It began.
But it didn't take long before space flickered with radiance as a single dark shadow returned!
"Haa, escaping the senses of that fool is hard."
The shadow of Barbatos flickered as a part of it remained!
Going against mission parameters, a part of it silently came back as...
It was curious.
For the first time, it wanted to see the contents of the mission.
Her hands moved haphazardly as thousands of terrifying Runes of Existence burst around her.
She had to do a few things to ensure no blowback or entanglements by observing those of other weavings of existence- especially those she had a hand in completely altering their future weavings.
From her shadowy brilliance, her figure slowly became clear.

Dark hair and eyes that pulsed with appalling complexity. A somewhat small figure, but with curves that showed a gorgeous sculpted visage. The chest and waist were plentiful as her skin shone with a caramel-colored radiance!
Her eyes held an inquisitive light as she questioned and wondered.

Who was involved? Why was it best for the Wheel of Existence for them to be sent away to that place? Why was it deemed this was the path to follow to ensure the smooth flow of the Wheel? Who deserved to not just be killed, but locked away like this?

"Who, who, who...." She spoke with curiosity as she freely looked at this moment, the veil she and others always set up when conducting their missions being broken down as she was able to see down below for the equivalent length of over 100 Omniverses of distance.
She saw the Immovable Sacred Legions and the Pioneer amidst them who should be the one they had been subtly aiding and influencing to find the frequency of that place.
She then saw the Blancverse being 97% pulled into that place as her inquisitive eyes rapidly delved into it, intent on seeing just who was deserving of this treatment!
She saw the inside of it.
She saw multiple figures.
But her attention and all weavings of existence were pulled towards and locked onto a single figure.
A face.
A man with the visage and demeanor of an Emperor.
With devilish handsomeness and profound valor.
At this moment, he was bellowing out with defiance and calm rage as he still burned with shocking complexity against the inevitable pull nobody could escape!
Seeing his face, her heart shuddered.
Her mind buzzed as tears rapidly began to flow down her face.
"Ah..." She let out a silent scream as she felt heart-searing pain- as if something within her was being pierced by trillions of needles!
Subconsciously, she reached out towards that figure that valiantly stood in defiance even while wrapped in the light of inevitability!
She didn't know why.
She didn't know why it hurt so much!
But she had to...
WAP!
Like a flickering singularity, the Blancverse entirely disappeared.
Along with everything inside of it.
"NO!"
Barbatos screamed out as she felt like her own heart had disappeared!
Her body was trembling uncontrollably as her mental state buzzed, unable to make heads or tails about what was going on.
Who was that? Who was that?!
Why did her heart break so much just seeing him? Why did she feel such an appalling sense of desolation right now as he was forever taken away?!

chapters.title: Chapter 3407 The Erasure of Noah Osmont! I
paragraphs: A scream that wasn't all scream echoed out for nobody to hear.
Barbatos lay on a swirling field of abundant complexity as her face was filled with pain and confusion.
She felt like she had lost every single thing important to her- when she didn't even know she had it!
Tears freely streamed down her face as her heart...
"Why? Why?!" She didn't understand it.
She clutched her chest and felt the pain in her heart as if she had wronged her most precious person.
All her life, she had lived with privilege and power within her weavings of Existence.
When she had Pioneered her path long ago, she was trained for the complex missions through different weavings of Existence and the one critical thing to do during traversal.
To avoid Entanglements.
To not observe who or what was within those weavings of existence, as unforeseen results could occur during Entanglements!
She didn't expect that the first time she dropped the veil to see just who she had helped throw into that unforgivable frequency was- this would occur.
She felt a sense of desolation even though she didn't know who the person she was looking at was. It could only mean...
A version of herself here was connected to that man in an extremely unfathomable way!
She raised her tanned hands as she looked at herself. She wiped the tears and stood up, feeling the aching in her heart as she knew she couldn't just sit here.
She knew she had to leave and not entangle herself even deeper, but...she just couldn't!
So she looked around.
She saw the figures who were responsible for initiating this event and the ones she and Amalthos had aided to ensure its success.
She saw them, and she flickered away from existence!
In a region filled with golden strings.
Palace Master Antiope looked towards Pioneer Heracles with excitement and trepidation as she asked.

|How will this affect those weavings of Existence? Those frequencies were the future Infiniverse Dowager waded through? With her source sent to that place, would events rewrite themselves? Will entire Frequencies of the Wheel correct themselves? Will This present action that we took change past results concerning us?!|
She bombarded question after question as she became increasingly excited with each.
The change.
The result of their actions!
If the Infiniverse Dowager and the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian had their Source Weavings locked away in that place, then many things should change...or have already changed in the past.
As she asked this, Palace Master Nisa beside her also had a complex expression as she thought of many things.
Pioneer Heracles on the other hand, had a difficult expression.

|This...is hard to say as nobody truly understands the weavings of different Frequencies of Existence. Due to the paradoxical factor and uncertainty of time in some Frequencies- we can't truly tell the results of our actions in the past. The best possibility I can think of...is for us to experience the results in our current future.|
It was confusing.
Anything dealing with the Frequencies of the Wheel took extremely extraordinary minds to truly understand!

|So...nothing that we went through in the past has changed? We won't suddenly revert back to our original Weavings of Existence since we never would have had to leave due to the Infiniverse Dowager that is no longer there?|
Palace Master Nisa asked hesitantly.
And Pioneer Heracles massaged his temples as he replied.

|If everything was to be changed like that and we were returned to our previous weavings, it would also mean that we never arrived in these weavings to find the young Infiniverse Dowager and the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian to begin with. If we weren't here, then they wouldn't be locked away right now. It...is truly difficult and paradoxical to understand as we can go in circles thinking about it, but we should see the change ourselves in the coming future, and not the past. We will know soon enough the initial results of locking away the Source Weavings of Existence of the Infiniverse Dowager and the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian.|
Convoluted. Hard to grasp.
But Pioneer Heracles made it clear that changes would likely occur forward in time! From now on.
But what possible changes could bloom from what they just did?
Palace Master Antiope's mind was buzzing with possibilities as she was about to speak again when...
TING!
A booming and utterly terrifying sound that caused their weavings of existence to buzz emerged above them.
A sound akin to something that was tightly wound snapping.
|What...?|
Their gazes were stern as they looked up, and there, within the Expanse...
TING!
Their wills vibrated as they saw a golden string snap.
A golden string.
A String of Existence!

There were countless of them stretched out across the Expanse as those truly powerful knew how to utilize them to traverse tremendous distances of hundreds or thousands the equivalent length of Omniverses in a short period of time.
They held even more complex meanings that very few knew about, but at this moment...
TING! TING!
With horrific snapping sounds, the tightly wound Strings of Existence were breaking one after another.

The halves disappeared on opposite ends as if one didn't observe it closely, they wouldn't even be able to know that it happened as even now, you had to look extremely close to see that there were larger gaps between some strings of existence compared to others!
It was an eerie unfolding of reality as Pioneer Heracles was ashen.
|What is this?|

He had to ask. With this phenomenon occurring as soon as they successfully sent the Source Weavings of Existence of the Infiniverse Dowager and the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian into that place where they could never return, they could not say that it wasn't connected!
But...why did such a phenomenon occur in response to that?
HUUM!
Amidst this shocking unfolding of reality, all of nearby surroundings for the span of the equivalent length of ten Omniverses turned silver black and froze.
All weavings froze as in the next second, the visage of Barbatos appeared before Pioneer Heracles and the two Existence Severing Constellations beside him!

chapters.title: Chapter 3408 The Erasure of Noah Osmont! II
paragraphs: But their figures remained utterly frozen as they didn't even know they were in this state!
Their wills, their eyes, their very existence knew absolutely nothing.
In such an environment...
TING!
Barbatos turned up as she also observed the snapping Strings of Existence, her gaze becoming stern as with every snap...she felt the concentration of the weavings of the Expanse lessen!
She turned her head towards the three Entities that she and Amalthos had aided without knowing their identities.
She now became entangled with them as well as she floated towards their frozen figures- tendrils of silver light leaking from her fingers and connecting onto the foreheads of the three beings!
WUU!
Brilliance vibrated and trembled as the eyes of the frozen Pioneer Heracles, Antiope, and Nisa became blank while their heads were forcefully turned up.
Barbatos wanted to know.
Who were they targeting? Why?
She invasively entered their weavings of existence and began to peruse as very quickly, her expression changed!
Much of their weavings were scattered. Their memories lost through scattered weavings of existence.
They did not even belong within this Weaving of Existence as they fell here after running away from theirs!
When it came to the distant weavings of that place, Barbatos wasn't able to pull anything as she could only wade through their weavings in this frequency of Existence.
And there, she found names.
"The Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian..."
She uttered out these words as her heart ached even more.
This was the man that she had helped send away.
She had noticed within the Blancverse Domain that was entirely eaten up in that inevitable frequency, there was a sparkling circular domain inside of it that seemed like a miniature world.
She wasn't able to see through it in time, but there were abundant forms of life within! Was her version of existence within this frequency in there, or was she still somewhere else?
She needed answers as she gazed coldly at the three entities before her, the weavings she had managed to uncover being far too little and too scattered.
But at least she now had a direction.
She waved her hands as, in the next moment, an illusory image with extreme clarity appeared.
Constructed from all the weavings she had just obtained and what she herself saw, it was the illusory image of the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian.
His body glowed with unfathomable valor as his eyes were stern and filled with the illusion of countless weavings.
His whole visage gave off an air of dominance and power as when Barbatos looked at him, she felt her heart become ever tighter!
She had to find out more about him. About his weavings. About who he was.
And this frequency she was in...should have the answers!
She brought his illusory image into her hands and crystallized it, holding it close as she disappeared thereafter.
Moments later, the frozen space returned to normal.
|What is this? Why would that happen?!|
Palace Master Antiope looked above as she asked why Strings of Existence would be snapping!
This was something they had never heard of before, nor had they seen until now.
They all felt a tremendous sense of foreboding as not a single one of them...knew or realized that their weavings had just been frozen with their memories read in the last few moments!
Not a single one!
Their hearts only felt a sense of unease as Pioneer Heracles became extremely somber.
He began to ask himself.
What had they truly just done, and what implications would it have?
As he began to see Strings of Existence snapping, he realized that none of them could truly and fully grasp just what they had done!
Noah Osmont.
His weavings, his being.
Everything about him had been taken away as his absence was felt in only a few places.
The Tresorverse Sacred Domain of the Omnifather.
The Omniverse of the Protectors.
Small areas within the Megalos Ynnere.
His weavings entirely disappeared as at this moment, no shred of Noah Osmont existed within this Frequency of the Wheel!
Within the Expanse.
In the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse where bountiful auras of Outerversal Morphons seethed.
HUUUM!
In a core region, weavings were trembling heavily as the Great Mother and the Great Segregator turned to observe Ozymandias.
His stellar obsidian visage currently radiated a tremendous sense of rage that caused the tentacles of this Outerversal Morphons to shudder, looking at him in shock as the Great Mother asked.
|O Instrument of the Beyonder, what happened?|

All others were sent away after the brief eruption of authorities that caused many powerful Morphons to enter the domain of the Great Segregator, and only the three of them were left with the Great Segregator being very agreeable after the gains she made earlier.
But now...just what had changed so drastically? They all looked towards Ozymandias whose eyes burned with interminable brilliance.
Ozymandias.
Ozymandias!
He was not Noah Osmont.
He was Noah Osmont- a piece of him that was born in an entirely different Megalos and held a different Source of Existence!
But...Ozymandias was still able to access things from Noah, and Noah could also access things from Ozymandias!
Ozymandias raised his hand in the next moment as...
WUU!
The blaring Ordinance of Infinity bloomed with a glorious blue on his stellar black skin.
WUU!
It rapidly changed to colorless as Quintessence bloomed after that, along with Tyranny, Cheats, Protagonist, and more!
His body flashed with brilliance as all dozens of Ordinances built by Noah Osmont were also his to access!
But...Ozymandias could not currently feel anything regarding his other self.
It was not death, as this sensation would be extremely painful even to Ozymandias.
But...as if they cut off, Ozymandias wasn't able to grasp any weavings of Noah.
No memories. No sight. Nothing.
And the heavy connection Ozymandias shared with the Infiniverse Megalos Seed...it felt like it was so distant and closed off that he couldn't draw any power from it!
Whatever that terrifying Frequency it was where they were drawn into, all weavings seemed to be excluded as at this moment, Ozymandias could not ascertain the state of existence of Noah Osmont.
But there were still many things he could do.
WAA!
His head whipped up as he uttered out coldly.
|The Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse has chosen to step on my dignity and must perish. Do you know of it?|
The Great Mother and Great Segregator looked at him incredulously while making sure they heard right.
The Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse stepped on his dignity? But...he had just arrived in the expanse and was with them this whole time!
As they gazed at him like this, the body of Ozymandias in the Megalos Beyond also began to move.
He had to make a descent into the Megalos Ynnere.
Within the Megalos Ynnere, there was something in Omniverse X-999 that he had to grasp!
There were many things occurring and countless moving pieces beginning to churn at this moment, but the biggest thing was singular.
The question of where exactly the other part of himself was sent to!

sentences.text: But their figures remained utterly frozen as they didn't even know they were in this state!
Their wills, their eyes, their very existence knew absolutely nothing.
In such an environment...
TING!
Barbatos turned up as she also observed the snapping Strings of Existence, her gaze becoming stern as with every snap...she felt the concentration of the weavings of the Expanse lessen!

She now became entangled with them as well as she floated towards their frozen figures- tendrils of silver light leaking from her fingers and connecting onto the foreheads of the three beings!

Brilliance vibrated and trembled as the eyes of the frozen Pioneer Heracles, Antiope, and Nisa became blank while their heads were forcefully turned up.

Why?
She invasively entered their weavings of existence and began to peruse as very quickly, her expression changed!
Much of their weavings were scattered.
Their memories lost through scattered weavings of existence.
They did not even belong within this Weaving of Existence as they fell here after running away from theirs!

Small areas within the Megalos Ynnere.

chapters.title: Chapter 3409 Gray! I
paragraphs: The sensation was a terrible one.

The moment that everything about him was swallowed by the gray brilliance of the unknown frequency, he found himself shuttled across unknown distances as after that...he felt a sense of weightlessness as he was falling from the skies!
Skies.
When his eyes could see again, this was exactly what he saw, but... its texture seemed off.
Its color seemed off.
The very skies looked gray and without any brilliance, and his figure was shuttling through them speedily as he approached...an equally gray earth!
WHOOSH! He felt the rough winds as he willed his weavings.
His weavings.
There was absolutely no response.
No Mana. Ordinances. Absolutely nothing whatsoever!
"Master!"

Through the rough winds, he heard the voice of the Infiniverse Megalos Body that currently held in her hands...a round structure with intricate weavings and patterns nearly four times her size, with a few gaps contained within it.

Through the gaps, Noah could barely discern a dim structure that looked like an infinity symbol- something he soon recognized to be the Extremity Vein of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed as around it, there were gray circles that seemed to be teetering and about to fall at any moment!
Also in the skies, the figure of Ruination could be seen as she held on to a white ring three times her size.
A white ring.
This was what Ruination held while the Infiniverse Megalos Body had what seemed to be the Infiniverse Megalos Seed, with all three of them shuttling through the skies and towards a gray earth below.
"Master!"

With the earth nearing, the Infiniverse Megalos Body moved her arms to try and get ever closer to Noah, her other hand holding onto him and wrapping around his figure- her body positioning itself below him while she cushioned him above!
And...
BOOM!
Their figures smashed onto the gray earth.
The moment it happened, Noah almost bellowed out a heavy roar.
Because for the first time in what seemed like forever, he felt the wind knocked out of him. He felt every muscle in his body aching with immense pain- his head buzzing as he nearly fainted!
He!
The Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian!
The Owner of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed!
He nearly fainted as within his body, he couldn't will any ounce of power as he felt like an utterly normal, mundane human being.
"Master, are you okay?"
Below him, the figure of the Infiniverse Megalos Body asked with caution and care as she was speaking with her mouth.
Words were coming out as sounds, with no intent or weavings of authority flowing from her either.
Noah nodded heavily while rising, his face wincing in pain as he looked towards his left hand...and saw the wrist being bent in an utterly wrong direction.
He withstood the pain and clutched his hand- forcefully bending it back in the right place as even more waves of pain burned across his body!

He breathed heavily as he looked around, seeing Ruination also coming towards them as she dragged the white ring with her, while the Infiniverse Megalos Body still held on to the Infiniverse Megalos Seed with one hand- the other hand steadily supporting Noah.
They looked around them as they seemed to have fallen...on a mountain full of gray earth and corpses.
Corpses of humanoid beings and a myriad of other animals, and even corpses of what looked like plant-like creatures!
They were strewn all around this area as Noah looked at all of this grimly while speaking out.
"What is the assessment?"
He turned his head towards the Infiniverse Megalos Body.
She seemed to have lost her color as she had a head full of dark hair, her eyes holding white pupils filled with dimming radiance.
She was adorned in a gray robe that was ripped on the bottom, showing the thigh of her left leg all the way down.
Her eyes held...emotions. Complex emotions at that as none of her monotone emotionless weavings could be seen!

"The moment we appeared here, all weavings and authority seemed to be restricted entirely. I focused all my efforts on the Infiniverse Megalos Seed as within, the workings of gravity, mana, or anything else dealing with authority were slowly shutting down. I ensured the safety of all life forms within, even during the impact here. But all quintillions of existences within the Infiniverse Megalos Seed are in a miniaturized state comparable to the Aletheian Havens and worlds they are in. Since all authority seems to be nullified, we cannot take them out, nor can we become smaller and enter the Aletheian Havens themselves."
Noah's eyes carried a terrifying light as he heard this!
Absolute nullification of all authorities.
And it seemed far more than that as his body felt so weak to the point that he found it similar to a time before he even awakened.

"But...compared to the absolute rejection Master faces, I can innately sense some weavings of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed still active. It's as if this rejection of authority affects biological lifeforms more absolutely, but planetary constructs have a thin level of leeway. I can ensure the safety of all Lifeforms in the Infiniverse Megalos Seed this way, but I still need to be careful not to apply too much force to it. Before all authorities were cut off, I sent a message to all prevalent people under Master to adapt to the current situation as long as they could, and that we may not be able to communicate with them, but that you were okay."
The Infiniverse Megalos Seed took care of everything.
Noah closed his eyes as he thought of his son. His mother.
Adelaide, Barbatos, Sona, and many others who depended on him!
He was sure that they were currently frantic in trying to get through to him, and he couldn't even sense or see them!
He breathed out as he looked at the massive circular construct five times their size that the Infiniverse Megalos Body still held onto.
They couldn't miniaturize themselves to enter any of the Havens within, but it was still so big that one could pass through the gaps and touch the dangling rings of Havens.
But it felt like with a simple touch, all of it could come crashing down and kill quintillions due to the horrific state of things all around.

chapters.title: Chapter 3410 Gray! II
paragraphs: Noah breathed out as he assessed his own body and spoke.
"My level of strength is akin to that of an utterly normal human. You two..."
He looked at Ruination and the Infiniverse Megalos Body.
Ruination has traces of her crimson gold hair still present, her figure covered with a red gold bodysuit that tightly hugged her curves and showed her exquisite figure.
She used her fingers to tug on her skin as she spoke.
"Master, My skin and body seem to emulate that of a human's, but its composition is that of some form of metal. I estimate my strength..."
She clenched her hand into a fist and punched down, causing a cloud of earth to erupt and covering her pretty face with gray sand.
She coughed and wiped the dust away as she continued.
"My strength and resiliency may be five to ten times that of a normal human, Master. But I cannot access any authority whatsoever."
This was the conclusion Ruination arrived at.
In her hands, Noah looked at the white ring she held as he sighed and asked.
"That is the Blancverse Domain?"
"Yes, Master."
A white ring.
Dim with no power, this was what remained of the Blancverse Domain.
Ruination stared at it curiously before she turned to stare at the Infiniverse Megalos Body that was holding onto the massive construct five times their size.
The two women looked at each other calmly before the Infiniverse Megalos Body spoke.
"I cannot estimate my power compared to a normal human, but the Infiniverse Megalos Seed feels weightless to me- akin to it being a part of my body. A limb or a piece of hair."
As she spoke, she raised the massive construction up and down slowly.

"The absolute denial of authority seems to affect lifeforms differently, with my makeup being forged from the Infiniverse Megalos Seed itself as it isn't as absolutely suppressed as all others may be."
This was the state of things.
It was a shocking reality to ascertain as Noah rose up while ignoring the pained muscles all over his body, looking around him once more.
They seemed to be in an area that was dry and barren, gray sand and cracked earth stretched out all around as lifeless decomposing bodies sat all around them.
He looked at their variations and uniqueness as he asked the Infiniverse Megalos Seed again.
"What assessment can you make about this place?"
He asked her and relied on her for many things as if he still had his Sacred Primal Eye of Existence, he could open it and observe everything as many prompts would come.
But there were no prompts.
There was no system.
There was no Atlas of Existence.
Absolutely nothing!
The dark hair of the Infiniverse Megalos Body fluttered in the wind as her gorgeous figure looked around them and spoke heavily.

"We are likely in a Frequency of Existence that denies all possible weavings of authority absolutely. Seeing the bodies around us, it is likely that countless entities from many frequencies fall into this place, with those who are unlucky like us and drop from the skies facing an immediate death once they smash onto this earth. Around us could be corpses of past Existential Dominium Realm Entities, Existence Severing Entities, or even Pioneers. Yet here, they are all the same."
WAA!
The Infiniverse Megalos Body looked around before she continued.

"Seeing the types of bodies here, all seem to be innately related to Matter as those relating to Megalos Ynnere would be deposited in regions around here. I can theorize that elsewhere, those stemming from Dark Matter and Anti-Matter could have their arrival as well. If this truly is a frequency, then these lands may stretch out endlessly and contain all possible lifeforms from countless frequencies that have been stuck here for who knows how many years. Of course, since no weavings of existence are prevalent here, normal physiological humans would age normally, and in less than a hundred years..."
The Infiniverse Megalos Body looked at Noah.
In his slightly injured state.
He currently had on slightly dirtied obsidian pants and a loose shirt, his body still retaining its muscular visage as the loose shirt showed the outline of his abs and abdominal muscles underneath.
His dark hair and eyes made him seem immensely normal as seeing this current state of being, the Infiniverse Megalos Body unconsciously felt drops of water flowing from her eyes.
"Ah..." She brought her hands up and saw the tears coming down as she was shocked, her voice echoing out again.
"My internal workings also seemed to have gotten scrambled. With my body expressing a high level of emotion compared to before."
She said this while wiping her tears away, looking at her Master, who had never been in this state since she was with him, as she couldn't help but feel pained!
Noah looked at her with a smile and patted her head.
"It's okay. We are in a new place filled with unknown realities and possibilities. We will come out of this stronger than ever, okay? It's a temporary hurdle as we won't always remain in this state."
He said this with a straight face.
But the Infiniverse Megalos Body couldn't maintain his heavy gaze as her eyes looked down.
On the side, Ruination was also somber as she stared out into the expanse around them.
Gazing down, the Infiniverse Megalos Body bit her lips as she spoke out.

"Master, with no authority, no workings of anything...this place is akin to a prison. A prison that nobody would be able to get out of. No portal can be formed, no pathway. No power can be conjured. Once here, it is likely that nobody comes out. I...I can't be of use to Master like I used to. If we cannot find a solution in years or decades and Master starts to age...if a time comes decades down the line where your normal human body gives out, I..."
For the first time, the Infiniverse felt complex emotions it never experienced before.
She felt...fear.
Not a fear of others or for herself, but the fear of losing her Master.
Of him being trapped here too long and his brilliance being affected!
In this fear, a silent rage burned as she thought of those who had sent them here.
She clenched her fists with her head bowed down, but in the next moment...
She felt a warmth wrap around her.
When she came to, she could feel the body of her Master hugging her.
The warmth...caused her to feel a tremendous sense of ease and peace as she calmed down. What was this? A state of mind being altered by a mere touch?
Her thoughts buzzed as Noah put her head on his chest while he spoke calmly.
"It's okay. We'll find a solution like we always do. Or do you not trust me to lead us out of something like this?"
Noah held the body of the Infiniverse as he raised her head and looked into her reddened eyes.
They became heavy and firm at this moment as she nodded, but in such a sweet moment...
PA! PA!
Her gaze changed as she picked up sounds.
Noah also turned towards a certain direction where clapping could be heard at this time, a few figures walking over from a distant hill as it consisted of a few humanoid beings!

"How sweet. Just arriving at this hellhole and already grabbing each other for company? Haha, what did I tell you all, I definitely saw fresh blood coming down. And two of them...my oh my, are they going to sell for a lot."
A vile voice.

Accompanied by a burly man in fur clothes, a jagged sword clasped in his hands as behind him, a dozen others followed with eyes full of smiles and malice- their eyes shining ever so brighter as they locked onto Ruination and the Infiniverse.
On these barren gray lands, the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian landed.
On these barren gray lands, there were countless others who had been ensured in the very same frequency.
On these barren gray lands...a terrifying epic was about to bloom!
