The dark hair of the Infiniverse Megalos Body fluttered in the wind as her gorgeous figure looked around them and spoke heavily.
"We are likely in a Frequency of Existence that denies all possible weavings of authority absolutely.

Seeing the bodies around us, it is likely that countless entities from many frequencies fall into this place, with those who are unlucky like us and drop from the skies facing an immediate death once they smash onto this earth.
Around us could be corpses of past Existential Dominium Realm Entities, Existence Severing Entities, or even Pioneers.
Yet here, they are all the same."
WAA!
The Infiniverse Megalos Body looked around before she continued.
"Seeing the types of bodies here, all seem to be innately related to Matter as those relating to Megalos Ynnere would be deposited in regions around here.
I can theorize that elsewhere, those stemming from Dark Matter and Anti-Matter could have their arrival as well.
If this truly is a frequency, then these lands may stretch out endlessly and contain all possible lifeforms from countless frequencies that have been stuck here for who knows how many years.
Of course, since no weavings of existence are prevalent here, normal physiological humans would age normally, and in less than a hundred years..."
The Infiniverse Megalos Body looked at Noah.
In his slightly injured state.
He currently had on slightly dirtied obsidian pants and a loose shirt, his body still retaining its muscular visage as the loose shirt showed the outline of his abs and abdominal muscles underneath.
His dark hair and eyes made him seem immensely normal as seeing this current state of being, the Infiniverse Megalos Body unconsciously felt drops of water flowing from her eyes.
"Ah..." She brought her hands up and saw the tears coming down as she was shocked, her voice echoing out again.
"My internal workings also seemed to have gotten scrambled.
With my body expressing a high level of emotion compared to before."
She said this while wiping her tears away, looking at her Master, who had never been in this state since she was with him, as she couldn't help but feel pained!
Noah looked at her with a smile and patted her head.
"It's okay.
We are in a new place filled with unknown realities and possibilities.
We will come out of this stronger than ever, okay?
It's a temporary hurdle as we won't always remain in this state."
He said this with a straight face.
But the Infiniverse Megalos Body couldn't maintain his heavy gaze as her eyes looked down.
On the side, Ruination was also somber as she stared out into the expanse around them.
Gazing down, the Infiniverse Megalos Body bit her lips as she spoke out.
"Master, with no authority, no workings of anything...this place is akin to a prison.
A prison that nobody would be able to get out of.
No portal can be formed, no pathway.
No power can be conjured.
Once here, it is likely that nobody comes out.
I...I can't be of use to Master like I used to.
If we cannot find a solution in years or decades and Master starts to age...if a time comes decades down the line where your normal human body gives out, I..."
For the first time, the Infiniverse felt complex emotions it never experienced before.
She felt...fear.
Not a fear of others or for herself, but the fear of losing her Master.
Of him being trapped here too long and his brilliance being affected!
In this fear, a silent rage burned as she thought of those who had sent them here.
She clenched her fists with her head bowed down, but in the next moment...
She felt a warmth wrap around her.
When she came to, she could feel the body of her Master hugging her.
The warmth...caused her to feel a tremendous sense of ease and peace as she calmed down.
What was this?
A state of mind being altered by a mere touch?
Her thoughts buzzed as Noah put her head on his chest while he spoke calmly.
"It's okay.
We'll find a solution like we always do.
Or do you not trust me to lead us out of something like this?"
Noah held the body of the Infiniverse as he raised her head and looked into her reddened eyes.
They became heavy and firm at this moment as she nodded, but in such a sweet moment...
PA!
PA!
Her gaze changed as she picked up sounds.
Noah also turned towards a certain direction where clapping could be heard at this time, a few figures walking over from a distant hill as it consisted of a few humanoid beings!
"How sweet.
Just arriving at this hellhole and already grabbing each other for company?
Haha, what did I tell you all, I definitely saw fresh blood coming down.
And two of them...my oh my, are they going to sell for a lot."
A vile voice.

Accompanied by a burly man in fur clothes, a jagged sword clasped in his hands as behind him, a dozen others followed with eyes full of smiles and malice- their eyes shining ever so brighter as they locked onto Ruination and the Infiniverse.
On these barren gray lands, the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian landed.
On these barren gray lands, there were countless others who had been ensured in the very same frequency.
On these barren gray lands...a terrifying epic was about to bloom!

chapters.title: Chapter 3411 Gray! III
paragraphs: Entrants in the dreary gray area they just landed in.
This Weaving seemed utterly terrifying to even be on as no matter one's power, they were entirely normal here with only their body to protect them!
A human was human.
An ant was an ant.
But even in these weavings, there were still people who didn't know how to handle themselves.
Seeing their appearance, Ruination instantly became stern as she appeared in front of Noah, her gaze filled with callous emotion as she gazed ahead.
Those coming made their way over calmly and imposingly as if they weren't worried, the leading burly man even gazing at the white ring that Ruination held in her hands with a smile as he spoke out.

"New blood that have only just arrived here are always faced with a rude awakening. Nothing here is as it was wherever you came from. You hold that Blancverse Ring in your hand tightly as if it is something worth something here...haha! There are dozens of Blancverse Rings being used as decorations in the nearest Settlement. Whatever authority you used to enjoy before...means nothing here!"
WAA!

"In here, men are men, women are women, animals are animals. All are equal, but also not. After all, how could a small girl like you overcome the strength of someone twice your size? I cannot remember how many times I have seen those in a similar state to yours right now- with those ferocious gazes of anger and regality, but do you know what their status was just hours later?"
His eyes turned sharp and with a vile light of cruelty as they stopped a few meters away from them.

"There was a graceful woman who asked again and again, do you know who I am?! I am the Pioneer of the Violet Palace of the Expanse! Blah blah blah, she went on. Do you know what her past status afforded her? She was sold for a few bundles of grain and a single cow in exchange to the Warlord of some settlement. Now, she has given that Warlord what, 5 Progeny? Haha, man, are you all in for an awakening."
A Pioneer.
Here, she held no authority to defend herself as she was sold and used to make children by some Warlord!
The burly man in dark fur scratches his beard as the jagged sword in his hands glinted with a sharp light.

"I am Doxono, and I will be the bringer of realization for you all. The pretty man...can be sold for a few bundles of grain as there are others with unique dispositions. You two girls...it almost feels like a shame to sell you, so we may just keep you to ourselves. Come, you can attack first. Come see just which new lands you are currently in."
He pointed his sword forward.
Noah's eyes were calm as he stared at this being.
He had listened intently as through his words, he had obtained many critical bouts of information regarding this new place as he didn't stop this being from talking!
He learned a bit about what type of civilization was here.
The strong ruled.
He looked as apart from Doxono with the sword, others behind him held makeshift wooden clubs- these clubs showing bloodstains as they had been used far too many times.
Noah's eyes radiated a silent calm as he placed his hands on Ruination while stepping forward toward these dozen or so men.
Their faces were unkempt, their fur clothes tattered, and their eyes sunken. They looked malnutritioned as in this place, one had to also ask...where would they obtain food and water?
Against such beings, did Noah really need Ruination to move?
He walked forward calmly as behind him, Ruination and the Infiniverse wanted to follow- but they listened to his wishes!
"Show me how powerless I am-"
SAA!
Before his words even finished, Doxono had already swung his sword to bisect him as truly, these entities were brutal!
His feet had already moved as he didn't even look at the sword that was swung down, only staring deeply into the eyes of this burly man.
His body only slightly turned sideways as the sword breezed inches from his clothes.
The pupils of Doxono constricted, but Noah already charged into his space after evading- his uninjured right hand shooting forward and stabbing into the eyes of this being!
"GAH!"

A furious yell echoed out the head of Doxono thrashed side to side, those behind him becoming somber and moving forward as in this short period of time while the forefront Doxono reached for his bleeding eyes, he found the grip of his sword being taken away as an instant later...
SQUELCH!
A swift sound of something being cut echoed out.
Those behind Doxono stopped in place as they saw above the head of their leader who could not see, a jagged sword had cut halfway into his head, blood and brain matter flowing freely!
"Hmm?"
Noah pulled out the sword as he saw his strength was truly too little.
He couldn't even cut through a head entirely!
But who was he?

How many years had he experienced? How many weavings had he experienced? Even if his body was that of a normal human, how could he not even be capable of predicting the movements of another normal human?
Feeling the heaviness of the sword in his hands, he looked at the less than a dozen beings before him calmly and spoke.
"Come on now."
Ferocious expressions rose up.
The unnamed extras looked at each other with heavy gazes before they roared out and moved towards Noah!
A few minutes passed thereafter.

In these few minutes, the gray earth was painted red with blood and gore as Noah breathed heavily while standing on top of a mountain of bodies, a single thug still remaining in front of him as he trembled fearfully!
"Fuck."
Noah couldn't help but curse as he felt like he had run a marathon.
His breathing was slightly labored, and he had even gained another small injury on his right shoulder!

"Master, Ruination could have taken care of all of them without you getting hurt..." The Infiniverse Megalos Body dragged over the Infiniverse Megalos Seed while observing Noah's state with heartbreak.
When had the Tyrannical Emperor ever looked exhausted and out of breath before?

chapters.title: Chapter 3412 Gray! IV
paragraphs: Noah nodded towards her with a smile as his figure was currently covered in the blood of his enemies, making him look extremely ferocious.
"I wanted to gauge the extent of this body compared to those here. And now, we have a little piggy here that looks like it's about to talk. Isn't that right, little piggy?"
He looked towards the sole remaining unnamed extra that had just witnessed the massacre.
And this being shook while looking at Noah like he was the devil, his mouth opening as he began to squeal.
"We...we come from a nearby Settlement under the lead of Warlord Maxus...."
He couldn't read the memories of others anymore or grasp their weavings.

This was the only thing he could do as he listened to the story of this unnamed extra for a few minutes, and continued to stare at him whenever he stopped as he would continue to babble on about anything he could think of after that!
After about half an hour, the mouth of the unnamed extra seemed perched as if he had nothing else to say.
Noah looked at him and nodded.
"You were a good little piggy."
SAA!
The sword in his hands flashed, and a head fell down cleanly.
Thereafter, he could only sigh as he looked up at the gray skies, digesting all the information he had collected so far.
"It really is a hellhole."

To survive, one needed food. One needed shelter. One needed sleep. Thus, many clustered towards Settlements that held loose rules, with a ruling force presiding over it and offering protection to others in exchange for many things!
The first and foremost were resources. The second was pleasure.
When it came to resources, one could find them anywhere across this gray endless stretch of land that some called Hell. Hell Terra Firma.
Others called it The Purgatory Lands.
Everyone that came here from countless possible weavings had a different name for it as only a single need drove them all- to survive and get back to their weavings!
But for those who had been here for years, they had long since given up hope of returning.
So there were Settlements to live and survive.
Those are just Human Settlements.
There were other Settlements where other races converged, these being much bigger as others only heard rumors of them.
Settlements of large beasts and other Lineages that held great stature- Settlements so large that they formed into Kingdoms.
Even if there were no authorities, what would happen if a normal human met a Dragon?
Even without any mana, the human could still be crushed with a single claw! It was akin to a human trying to win a fight against an Elephant or a Dinosaur on the blue planet.

There were even rumors of Settlements of those aligned with Dark Matter and Anti-Matter stretched out in far away regions- with this area here and many, many miles surrounding it only falling under the influence of entities stemming from Matter.
This...was just a brief overview of the knowledge he had gathered so far.
There were no doubt many intricate things going on here after an unknown number of years passed and countless entities came down.
But the main goal was to survive.
There were Huntsman like the ones they met here who waded around the periphery of their Settlement to look for anything and anyone who may have been swept into the Purgatory Lands.
Animals they could eat were routinely found this way!
And there were Gatherers who stayed within Settlements trying to cultivate vegetation in these barren lands- an extremely arduous task as water was an extremely precious and rare resource!
"...what an inconvenient place." Noah shook his head as he looked around while planning his steps ahead.
Shelter and food. There was a Settlement nearby with both as at this moment, Noah made the decision to move forward and obtain a base of operations.

"Let's go, I'll leave the fighting to you guys from here on out." He threw the jagged sword he held towards Ruination as she now dragged both a ring of the Blancverse and a sword in another hand, and the three of them began to walk towards the direction of a Settlement.
They left behind a bloody mess as Noah himself looked like he had just come from a massacre!
On their way there.

In half an hour, they were nearing the outskirts of the Settlement they had only heard of when suddenly, the Infiniverse Megalos Body stopped and showed an expression of shock that soon turned into elation!
"Master, I feel something. It is faint, and flickering in and out, but I feel another part of me! A part outside of this place...and the one to amplify its sensation right now...!"
Her eyes became wide.
They all stopped in place as Noah thought about many things, his eyes also lighting up as he thought about his other self.
Ozymandias!
Within a certain frequency.
Inside a certain sector of the Megalos Ynnere.
|Master, we are here...|
Near Omniverse X-999.
Savitar spoke with trepidation and continued shock as he looked towards the body of the Instrument of the Beyonder.

This personage had come to him in the Pantheon of Umbra and used his authority commandingly to use the loose channel between the two Megalos that Savitar had been using to send his other bodies through, and the location they arrived at...was Omniverse X-999!
Savitar read between the lines as he was shocked to realize the one who had his Megalos Regnum was Instrument of the Beyonder himself.
The Dreamer of the Megalos and the Instrument were one and the same!
|Stay here.|
His commanding voice seemed to be filled with a chilly light as his massive stellar obsidian body disappeared into Omniverse X-999.
Inside of it.
Ozymandias crossed tremendous distances in a short period of time as very quickly, near a region of space close to Cappadocia.
He appeared in this calm region of space as he waved his hands, and...
HUUM!
A dazzling Dream Aletheian Haven showed itself.
A small, insignificant part of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed that was left behind in Omniverse X-999 after it transcended its weavings of existence to enter the Expanse!

Ozymandias looked at it with bright eyes as his figure disappeared into it- his weavings billowing it out like a vast sea as he sought for anything, absolutely anything with the main component of this small piece that was equivalent to the size of a single Cosmos!

chapters.title: Chapter 3413 Purgatory or Paradise? I
paragraphs: A small piece of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
The moment he arrived in it, Ozymandias released waves and waves of Mana into it as if he was providing a source of power to light it up brightly.
His signature was taken in seamlessly as he went through its very center while wondering.
When the gray brilliance of the Frequency of inevitability hit him, every part of him, whether it be a clone or will, was affected, pulled, and merged back into him by the time he was whisked away!
Only Ozymandias, who shared an entirely different Source of Existence- Dark Matter, was not recognized and ensnared.
But the Infiniverse Megalos Seed...had a part of it not wrapped up in the Entanglement as he could only attribute this to its unique qualities!
What the Infiniverse Megalos Seed actually was.
A form of planetary domain that had risen so far above, to the extent that it became a Megalos Seed.
It had not bloomed into a Megalos yet, but it was on its way there.

When Noah became entangled, his body and the region they were in seemed to all be taken away as he saw the Tower of Existence he was in fracture with a large section of it taken when that clone was pulled back, and the same phenomenon occurred in other places where he was.
Small sections of the land and space around him were also eaten away.

But just because these small sections of land and space became entangled and eaten away into that terrifying Frequency of that place, it didn't then cause all billions of miles of land and space of that domain to also be devoured!
The Infiniverse Megalos Seed was akin to such domains.
It was entangled in the entirety with the Blancverse it was in, but it was akin to a piece of a Megalos being eaten away as it wasn't treated like a normal lifeform!
Thus, a part of it was left behind.
An isolated Dream Aletheian Haven.

It held the workings of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed, but such a small residual weaving of it was left behind as even now, after Ozymandias arrived and began nurturing it with endless waves of Mana did a sense of cognizance and will slowly begin to form.

As it did, Ozymandias had a cold expression as a devouring light erupted from him- the surrounding weavings of Omniverse X-999 also beginning to be pulled in and assimilated into this small isolated Haven to help it grow!
Weavings buzzed as such a process began to take place, the terrific visage of Ozymandias multiplying into two moments later as one left.
Outside of Omniverse X-999, the other body of Ozymandias gazed at the figure of Savitar who held an expression of stupor still as he voiced out coldly.
|Other domains of Outerversal Morphons apart from you and Nietzsche. Let's go.|
He needed fuel currently.
And there were many Omniverses out there as he continued to map sectors- especially Tainted Omniverses under the banner of Outerversal Morphons!
Coming out of his stupor, Savitar nodded brisket before their figures disappeared.

Back in the small isolated Haven, Ozymandias nurtured the connection he held with the Infiniverse Megalos Seed as he currently cradled a golden singularity that had formed after all this time- this singularity containing a budding will as with enough nurturing, it would bloom into enough complexity a sliver of the Infiniverse Megalos Body.
Or so he hoped!
Half an hour passed.
And...
HUUM!

Outside of the isolated Haven, within OmniverseX-999, three terrifying singularities tens of times larger than the Isolated Dream Aletheian Haven itself appeared- these being nothing else but three Dark Matter Cores!
The other body of Ozymandias appeared alongside them as the moment they were transported over, the Isolated Dream Aletheian Haven began to devour and assimilate them greedily!
The singularity in the hands of Ozymandias became denser and denser.
More and more complex.
After a certain point, an emergence of fantastical brilliance erupted out in front of Ozymandias that formed into complex lines of a humanoid figure!
Simmering with multicolored radiance. A level of complexity much, much lower than before!
But undoubtedly...
|Infiniverse...|

Ozymandias called out as the silent visage of the newly built Infiniverse Megalos Body opened its eyes, its pupils hazy and foggy as if there was a tremendously powerful barrier preventing its operations.
Outerversal Authority leaked from Ozymandias among much more, the light of many Ordinances flickering and flowing into the small body before him until...
|Ah...| A voice as if one was taking a breath after a long time came through.

It was followed by light filling the multicolored pupils of the Infiniverse Megalos Body, its eyes landing on Ozymandias as they showed such great surprise and relief to the extent that the moment this body formed, she threw herself towards the towering obsidian stellar body of Ozymandias and hugged it tightly!
|Master!|
A single word.
But it expressed relief. It expressed happiness. It expressed the potential beginning of the end of a terrible nightmare.
Ozymandias looked at her and wondered- just what place was his other self sent to that the monotone Infiniverse Megalos Body now expressed such emotions?
He cradled her head on his stellar chest as he asked lightly.
|Is everyone okay? Those within the Infiniverse Megalos Seed?|
A critical question to put his heart at ease.
And the newly formed Infiniverse Megalos Body blinked while calming herself.

|My state of being has been altered due to that place, and I will work on processing the overflow of emotions, Master. Everyone is okay, but my memories and records of that place are scattered and even delayed in getting to me here, it seems. Here is what I could recover...|

Her forehead glowed as she brought it in contact with his giant chest, bundles of information flowing out from her and into Ozymandias as he became clear on exactly what had happened and where his other self was!
Hell Terra Firma.
The Purgatory!
This was the place his other half was in as at this moment, he began to analyze everything about it!

His signature was taken in seamlessly as he went through its very center while wondering.
When the gray brilliance of the Frequency of inevitability hit him, every part of him, whether it be a clone or will, was affected, pulled, and merged back into him by the time he was whisked away!
Only Ozymandias, who shared an entirely different Source of Existence- Dark Matter, was not recognized and ensnared.
But the Infiniverse Megalos Seed...had a part of it not wrapped up in the Entanglement as he could only attribute this to its unique qualities!
What the Infiniverse Megalos Seed actually was.
A form of planetary domain that had risen so far above, to the extent that it became a Megalos Seed.
It had not bloomed into a Megalos yet, but it was on its way there.

When Noah became entangled, his body and the region they were in seemed to all be taken away as he saw the Tower of Existence he was in fracture with a large section of it taken when that clone was pulled back, and the same phenomenon occurred in other places where he was.
Small sections of the land and space around him were also eaten away.

But just because these small sections of land and space became entangled and eaten away into that terrifying Frequency of that place, it didn't then cause all billions of miles of land and space of that domain to also be devoured!
The Infiniverse Megalos Seed was akin to such domains.
It was entangled in the entirety with the Blancverse it was in, but it was akin to a piece of a Megalos being eaten away as it wasn't treated like a normal lifeform!
Thus, a part of it was left behind.
An isolated Dream Aletheian Haven.

It held the workings of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed, but such a small residual weaving of it was left behind as even now, after Ozymandias arrived and began nurturing it with endless waves of Mana did a sense of cognizance and will slowly begin to form.

He needed fuel currently.
And there were many Omniverses out there as he continued to map sectors- especially Tainted Omniverses under the banner of Outerversal Morphons!
Coming out of his stupor, Savitar nodded brisket before their figures disappeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 3414 Purgatory or Paradise? II
paragraphs: Hell Terra Firma.
A place where countless weavings of existence were thrown into to never return.
They couldn't return.
After all, authority was entirely and completely rejected in this place.
One could not form a portal or initiate any sort of weavings that could take them from one place to another.
Powerful entities at the Existence Severing stage or even Pioneers would arrive at this place as within a matter of decades, they would die of old age!
This was where his other self remained locked in, along with quintillions of entities inside the Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
He spoke succinctly as he pulled the Infiniverse Megalos Body away from his chest.
|Are you able to establish a connection? Anything at all? To allow for the formation of a gateway within the Infiniverse Megalos Seed there and this Haven here?|
Terrifying questions were asked.
And the Infiniverse thought for a few seconds before she shook her head.

|Authority continues to be impossible to utilize there, with the Infiniverse having a form of exception that currently only allows its workings to remain stable right now. Forming a gateway would require authority. Transporting anything or anyone else would require authority. And even if somehow the Infiniverse Megalos Seed could be used to form this impossible gateway, it would never be able to leave the Hell Terra Firma lands itself as this...would also require the eruption of authority. So, even in the best-case scenario, the Infiniverse Megalos Seed would forever remain locked in that place.|
Despotic words echoed out. They weren't just left at this though as not long after...

|But, there is an Infiniverse Megalos Seed in that place, and there is now an enlarging and gradually increasing in complexity portion of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed here. It may be possible...to allow the overlap of the two and transport something in a small concentrated area from one to the other. With the amount of remnant authority that the Infiniverse Megalos Seed in the Purgatory Lands holds and this portion of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed possibly allowing this overlap to transport something as small as a grain of sand...maybe.|
Her eyes were filled with hesitation and uncertainty as she looked around at the sandy obsidian stellar radiance all around them.

|Especially if it's through Dreams, we may be able to allow this overlap to transport increasingly bigger things over time. In theory. This opens up a new realm of possibilities when looking at the Purgatory Lands as a whole. A place where countless things from all weavings of existence get locked into with nothing ever being able to leave. What if, theoretically, we gain the capability to move something back and forth? All the things rendered useless in Purgatory Lands due to the absolute rejection of authority. That dead extra stated that rings of Blancverses are being used as decorations. And there are entities that used to be Pioneers or even higher in power. If we could obtain the body of a Pioneer and begin sending its Blood through? All possibilities. All just hearsay. But theoretically....theoretically...|
The Infiniverse Megalos Body ranked on as she made one thing clear.
Possibility.
Theoretically.
There were still a lot of unknowns as when they arrived here...
|We can try.|
Ozymandias spoke with eyes filled with Tyranny.
The Infiniverse Megalos Body looked towards him intently before she nodded.

She turned towards the swirling and increasing concentration of authority in this isolated Haven as her floating figure sat down in space and closed her eyes, terrifying complexity beginning to surge around her as one of the only ways she could see in achieving the possible theory she had...
BOOM!
Was through Runes.
Around her, the beginnings of complex Runes began to flicker as Noah appeared beside her.
Waves of complexity leaked from him as well as it flowed into her and aided in the process, these two beings attempting to do something never done before in a small corner of the Megalos Ynnere!

Within OmniverseX-999, there was a certain Ankyra that felt the eruption of power and complexity within a certain area, but it was so intense compared to himself that he was only forced to observe from a distance.
Far from Omniverse X-999.
In another sector within the Megalos Ynnere.
SAA!
Space distorted as a dazzling figure of a woman appeared, her eyes sharp as her figure was short and blessed.
The new entrant, Barbatos, looked around this region of the Megalos Ynnere as she arrived here to seek more weavings of her Entanglement!
Based on the physiology of the man she felt so much pain over, she knew he would have stemmed from the weavings of Matter as this area was her next stop.
What she had to do...was find the most complex power within the Megalos Ynnere of this frequency and see if they would know anything about the man she sought.
"Who?" Her eyes were cold and filled with a calculative light as she sent out silent silver strings of brilliance all around her.
They crossed great distances in a short period of time very quickly; she received some feedback as she looked in a certain direction!
There, the waves of brilliance she sent out returned back to her the illusory scenes of rotating Omniverses around a single being.
A single, massive rune radiating a brilliance that read [SPACE] flashed behind her, and her body shot out and rapidly disappeared!
She crossed the equivalent lengths of hundreds of Omniverses in an extremely short period of time as after a while...
SAA!
Space fizzled and melted as she arrived near a rotating Omniverse.
Below it, a stern figure rose from his seated position as he stared toward her with ever-increasing somberness!
Yet Barbatos looked at him calmly as she spoke.
"You are Pioneering your own path in this place, good for you. I have no qualms, and only seek to obtain weavings of this man here- have you heard, seen, or grasped anything relating to him before?"
In front of her, the illusory image of a tyrannical devilish entity flashed, the eyes of the entity surrounded by swirling Omniverses constricting in recognition!
No matter how small it was, Barbatos saw it as her heart filled with elation amidst the constant feeling of pain, betrayal, and heartache that she felt.
She didn't understand why, but she truly felt like her actions had betrayed herself and this being who made her very existence shudder!
Even if she didn't know what she was doing.
She wanted to know him. Who he was.
The entity before her had a complex expression as he spoke out with hesitation

"The last time anything regarding him was observed...was in the Tresoverse Domain of the Omnifather. A gray light erupted with him at the center as he disappeared entirely. If you seek his origins and records, he seemed aligned with the children of the Commonwealth. You can find them here..."
The Entity that had set many things in motion for the Omnifather released a bundle of weavings- cooperating with the newly appearing Barbatos as her complexity made him feel extremely stifled!

chapters.title: Chapter 3415 Purgatory or Paradise? III
paragraphs: "The Commonwealth..."
The eyes of Barbatos were bright as she knew she was getting further and further Entangled.
She took the weavings of information from the entity that used to be a so-called Prisoner not too long ago and nodded as her figure disappeared right after!
She left alone a single man who had dazzling Omniverses rotating around him, his expression stern as he felt like he could finally breathe once more.
He looked where Barbatos used to be as he spoke questioningly.
"A Source...?!"
Far past a Pioneer.
Possibly a Source Complexity Entity!

Why would such an entity be looking for the weavings of that man? With his exemplary showing in the Tresoverse Domain of the Omnifather and just as rapid disappearance, what about him would prompt a Source Complexity existence to be seeking him?
The Prisoner wondered. But there were no answers.

He continued to monitor the situation within the Tresorverse Domain of the Omnifather as any time that a Golden Titan successfully Severed their Existence and fully entered this stage, he would make a move as a terrifying finger would descend from above to eradicate them.

He almost moved the Existence Severing champions of this Megalos Ynnere that were being given a vastly different opportunity by the Omnifather in another entirely separate Domain, but the amount of losses they would have from being removed there were far too much.
Thus, he moved himself and continued to observe.
Far from his location.
On the Omniverse of the Protectors.

Old Man Eudemus stared at a tear in space that had yet to close with a somber expression, the vibrant visage of The Sword of the Commonwealth also being beside him as this Simian vibrated with terrific power at Ordinance Amalgamation!

Alongside them, there were a few other Ordinance Amalgamation core members of the Commonwealth whose bodies arrived after the shocking commotion- each one seeking to understand the entity who became a Protector under their very noses while holding such terrific power, alongside his terrifying disappearance.
|He didn't ask for anything? Obtain any of our core workings from you?|
The eyes of the Sword of the Commonwealth were chilly as they asked, and Old Man Eudemus turned towards him with an even colder gaze.
|Do not take my silence for weakness, O Linus. What I have said is exactly how everything went down.|
Tensions were high between all sides.
At such a moment...
"Quite a gathering here. You all are sufficient to be known as core members of this so called Commonwealth?"
HUUM!
Without their knowledge, a voice echoed out that caused their gazes to change heavily, all of them looking up and seeing a figure shrouded in darkness gazing down at them!
They didn't even know she had been there this whole time as instantly, they all became battle ready!
Above, Barbatos harrumphed as she looked down, seeing the tear in space that reminded her of the one she saw in the Expanse.
He was here before.
Another one of his bodies was here as it was pulled along into that frequency!
Looking at the few Ordinance Amalgamation entities who didn't look like they would make things smooth...
WUU!

She clenched her fist as a silent silver black radiance spread out, freezing everything and everyone here as thereafter, tendrils of silver brilliance flew out from her and connected to the heads of all beings here.
She began perusing their records and memories freely as if he was here, it meant he may have interacted with these beings.
Maybe...she could see more of him?
Maybe-
Her small figure trembled.
From the head of the one called Old Man Eudemus.
She obtained a bundle of records.
His conversations.
His last moments.
Who he was.
"Noah...Osmont!"
Barbatos uttered these words as she felt her very existence trembling with complex pain!
The name felt extremely familiar to her, and yet foreign at the same time.
The name caused her heart to feel at great ease, and yet brought down even greater feelings of guilt for having contributed in sending him to a place where nobody came back from!
Nobody.

She confirmed at this moment that any version of herself in these weavings was so intricately connected to this man that the connection...transcended weavings of existence to the extent that this Entanglement she had placed herself in was impossible to remove herself from.
She felt like the feelings of guilt and pain would drown her heart completely if she didn't get closure from them as she had to keep looking!
She went through all the memories multiple times.
His mannerisms.
The way he talked.
His smile.
It all caused her heart to feel heavier and heavier as her version here must have been impossibly bound to this being.
This type of love...
How could she have loved him so much?
Barbatos felt a pang of jealousy at this other version of herself as she was shocked to also learn that Noah had begun to Dream of other Weavings of Existence.
He had just begun, and she and Amalthos were sent off to ensure that he was locked away forever!
Was this a reason why those above wanted him sent there? Because they foresaw he was about to do something in the future that would affect not just his weavings of Existence, but others too?
Barbatos didn't know.
For this, she would have to ask her father to grasp and understand why he and the others decided on the missions that they had to undertake.
"Noah Osmont...Omniverse X-999!"
She repeated his name and the home that the Commonwealth found him in as she disappeared an instant later.
She went seeking for Omniverse X-999 in the vast sectors of the Megalos Ynnere!
Where she used to be, all weavings flowed once more as...
BZZT!
Golden wheels erupted all around the Ordinance Amalgamation entities here, their weavings looking around for the woman that was just there as...
There was nothing to be seen.
They remained in a high state of tension as to them, what had just happened was too eerie!

He had just begun, and she and Amalthos were sent off to ensure that he was locked away forever!
Was this a reason why those above wanted him sent there?
Because they foresaw he was about to do something in the future that would affect not just his weavings of Existence, but others too?
Barbatos didn't know.
For this, she would have to ask her father to grasp and understand why he and the others decided on the missions that they had to undertake.
"Noah Osmont...Omniverse X-999!"
She repeated his name and the home that the Commonwealth found him in as she disappeared an instant later.
She went seeking for Omniverse X-999 in the vast sectors of the Megalos Ynnere!
Where she used to be, all weavings flowed once more as...
BZZT!
Golden wheels erupted all around the Ordinance Amalgamation entities here, their weavings looking around for the woman that was just there as...
There was nothing to be seen.
They remained in a high state of tension as to them, what had just happened was too eerie!

chapters.title: Chapter 3416 Purgatory or Paradise? IV
paragraphs: Far from the Megalos Ynnere.
Far from any common weavings of existence.
In the place Noah found himself in termed the Purgatory Lands.
Hell Terra Firma!
He stopped a distance away amongst tall, dead, and decaying trees as he looked down in the distance where a small Settlement could be seen.
Everything about it seemed extremely rudimentary, with walls made out of stone and trunks of gray trees protecting a periphery of about 5 or so miles. Equivalent to a truly small town.
This was a major settlement in this area as within it, a few thousand humanoid entities reigned!
And at the forefront was the Warlord Maxus.

Inside the small Settlement, an area for the cultivation of vegetation was tightly guarded, as well as a farm area holding animals such as cows, chickens, and unique variations of what could be considered mythical beasts outside of here...but were smaller in size as they did not hold much power.
So they were being raised and bred for consumption over the years.
This...was a Settlement.

A place with food and shelter, and something that Noah needed if he was going to survive and not die of hunger in the next few days and weeks and months to come...if he really was going to be stuck here for that long!
At this time, he stayed back with the Infiniverse Megalos Body as he spoke to Ruination.
"Have a talk with the Warlord Maxus. Let him know to either abdicate and work under me, or he will be deposed."
Around the Settlement, those standing guard had simple weapons similar to the thugs from before, with the addition of bows and arrows on some along with spears!
Even though authority was entirely rejected in this place, there was still ingenuity and knowledge from many races.
He didn't doubt that, over time, in those larger settlements, much more powerful weapons and defense systems could be developed!
After all, his blue planet didn't have any Mana, and they eventually even developed Nuclear weapons.
But here, would the processes of even nuclear fission and fusion be rejected as advanced weaponry could never be made?
Would more advanced weapons like guns or bombs already be developed in the larger Settlements, or were even these considered a form of rejected authority?
Noah didn't know for sure as, at this moment, Ruination had already begun to move!
"I will be back soon, Master."
Her eyes held a ferocious glint.
Her body was different from normal humans as she was made entirely of unique metalloids, with her strength and resiliency being many times that of a human as she held tremendous advantage here!
She began to freely walk into the small Settlement as for the first time in a while, winds would begin to blow.

Inside a small Settlement. Many didn't even bother to give it a name as there was a sense of despondency in these barren lands of Purgatory, with all those here only clustering for survival to ensure they didn't die out in the gray lands out of nowhere.

At the peak of this Settlement was the man who had gathered a number of people and gradually established order- someone who had lived for many cycles and had reached a tremendous level of power before!
But now...
"Ah...." He lay on a makeshift bed made of feathers inside a small darkly lit room, letting out a sigh of satisfaction as a barely clothed older woman sat at the edge of the bed with blank eyes.
No matter what power he held before, he was reduced to a normal human here as aside from survival, the only things his body sought and enjoyed were the basal tendencies of his body.
Food, and reproduction!
This was all he was reduced to.
"The guards outside will get you a few bundles of grain for your services, okay?" He spoke lazily towards the woman as this time, he didn't hear a reply.

His eyes became sour as he was about to berate when he noticed the older woman clutching her clothes in shock, her eyes turned towards the entrance where the figure of a dazzlingly gorgeous young woman with crimson gold hair appeared!
Her hands and face were stained with blood as she looked coldly towards Warlord Maxus.
Staring at her, Maxus instantly became infatuated and then terrified at the sight of beauty and blood as when he looked out the door, he saw his guards groaning and holding on to broken limbs!
And her cold voice filled with distaste echoed out.
"My Master asks where you wish to abdicate your authority here or perish. What will it be?"
WAA!
Her Master.
Her Master?!
The many cycles of experience that Warlord Maxus had buzzed and kicked into his head as seeing how this young woman had gotten past his guards and who knew how many others alone...
"Abdicate! I will abdicate and present him with all I have..."
His mind worked rapidly as he spoke as such, while his eyes held a hidden chilling light!
He would lower himself and learn more about this woman and where her power came from, and who this Master of hers was.
And then in time...there were many things he could do.
Ambushed during sleep.
Poisoning the reverses of water and food.
Warlord Maxus lowered his head rapidly as many other thoughts flashed, a unique future painted as he was curious to see how it would unfold!
Yet...
"Your hidden malice is not so hidden in my eyes."
The cold voice of Ruination echoed out as Warlord Maxus raised his head in shock, only to see the right hand of this gorgeous woman swinging sideways across his neck.
SAA!
A clean cut.
As if her hands were sharp swords.
His vision then seemed to shift, and then endless darkness came down!
Ruination looked at the state of this room and the terrified woman on the bed as she grabbed the head of the Warlord and stepped out.
Out of the slightly bigger house of the Warlord than all those here, there was a trail of blood. Groans of pain were apparent for any of those who chose to stand in her way!

All around, a few hundred men and women within this Settlement watched from the sidelines as she walked out towards the entrance while holding the head of the Warlord, a sense of ease and fear spreading as she came to stop at the broken gates of the entrance!
There, she waited silently.
SIU!

An arrow shot out from the roof of a house towards the left, and Ruination didn't even turn around as she caught this arrow with her bare hands and flung it back towards the same direction with even greater speed and force!
BOOM!
The roof of the house was blown off along with an eruption of blood as immense silence reigned in after that.

Within minutes, a woman holding a massive circular structure in her left hand and a white ring on another appeared alongside a devilishly handsome man with a cold gaze, their figures arriving before the broken gates of the Settlement as the woman that held the head of Warlord Maxus bowed towards him!
He nodded while patting her head as if to praise her, and he proceeded to walk into the Settlement with her under the shaken and terrified gazes of many!

chapters.title: Chapter 3417 Purgatory or Paradise? V
paragraphs: All entities that managed to arrive in the Purgatory Lands had their own uniqueness.
Some used to be powerful entities, others didn't face much of a change in disposition and power compared once they arrived here.
But those who survived here long enough knew that when one came across an oddity or something out of the norm, they didn't mess with it!
So when they saw the head of the old Warlord Maxus held by a bloodied woman who had either killed or heavily injured any who stood in her way, they steered clear of her.
They especially steered clear of the man she brought into the Settlement- and the woman who was effortlessly carrying a massive and intricate ring filled with dazzling lines.

As they walked into the Settlement, Noah looked at the few hundred nearby and those who were hearing the commotion in the distance as he voiced out loudly and commandingly. "New Leadership has arrived, ladies and gents. Even stronger than that Warlord Maxus as you can see. Proceed as normal, and this Settlement will be something that is unreachable even if a dragon were to pass by. Expect my general to interview you all on where you'll be working on in the near future."
His voice carried tremendous power and weight as he planned to use the numbers of this Settlement to begin grand undertakings even in this place!
First, guarantee his safety and survival.
Then, understand and obtain unfathomable things that were deemed useless here, but if he could successfully take them out of here through the Infiniverse Megalos Seed...
His eyes burned with ambition as he went into the depths of the nearest Settlement he arrived at and proceeded to carve out a domain for himself.

As he settled in, Ruination secured the central fortified area where Warlord Maxus used to stay and quickly commanded a few dozen Settlers to follow her in cutting down and carrying the dead gray trees around the Settlement.

They quickly did as told as in a short period of time, an enclosed area surrounded by tout wooden walls was entrenched in the earth- Ruination moving herself to smash and entrench this wall all around!
What occurred within could not be observed by prying eyes.

At such a point, the Infiniverse had placed the dim ring of the Blancverse Domain and the Infiniverse Megalos Seed down on the gray earth, and she was now observing this intricate ring that represented far too many things before her!
"How is the connection going?"

Noah asked lightly after finding water to wash the blood off of himself, the cackling of fire being heard off to the side as a few animals were already taken by Ruination and brought over, and Noah was currently cooking them right now.

Ruination herself was sent to continue doing grunt work for now- stabilizing any possible chaos that may arise from their entry into the Settlement, and that the processing of raising animals or farming wasn't disrupted!
Infiniverse and Noah alone remained in this space as Infiniverse placed her hands on the massive Infiniverse Megalos Seed while replying.

"It's incredible; while we may not be able to send much back and forth, a possible channel is forming through the simple concept of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed existing here and in another place. What exists inside of it in a specified area here...can also theoretically be obtained in that same replicated area elsewhere. That is what another me in the Megalos Ynnere is doing right now with Ozymandias."

As she spoke, she walked towards the Infiniverse Megalos Seed five times their size, her body entering through the gaps as they arrived at the base of the slightly dim Extremity Vein surrounded by Aletheian Havens.
At the base of the Extremity Vein, a small pool of vibrant multicolored light was forming and slowly expanding!

"This little pool of water here...would be the gateway. Equivalent to the small portion of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed in Omniverse X-999 that, after swallowing multiple Dark Matter Cores, has grown to be the length of an Omniverse currently. And yet only this small pool has formed here. Something placed in this pool should theoretically also reflect on the other pool, but the weavings and makeup of what can be sent out are unfathomably little. Something without life is feasible, something small is feasible, something with a consciousness is impossible, something too large is impossible...there are far too many restrictions at this moment as it is debatable whether we can even elevate it to allow you to leave this place in the future, Master."
Her gaze and words carried a sense of despondency even in their advancements!

"The complexity we have access to is far too little. We can accelerate this process with another burst of complexity, but even if Ozymandias Severed more Ordinances or Pioneered his Path, the amount of complexity may still not be enough to change the singular truth about this place- that nobody who comes in can go out."
The state of Infiniverse was truly far too affected when it related to Noah's safety and possible exit from this place.
Noah smiled even in the face of all of this.
"It's okay. We'll take it a step at a time and see what changes. Is it already viable to test out?"
Noah was filled with a great deal of expectations.
If they could truly turn this impossibly grim situation around...
"Yes, Master, something small."
Something small.
Noah looked around this enclosure as his eyes were drawn to the headless body of a certain Warlord purposefully left behind.
"Let's try...blood, why don't we?" ...!
The body of Warlord Maxus was brought forward, the pooled and dried blood of this entity being collected in small amounts by Noah and given to the Infiniverse.
"He may have been an Existence Severing entity or a Pioneer before this, who knows? Let us test whether this place we have arrived in...is truly a purgatory, or may turn into a paradise for us!"
He could already imagine it.
If they could really transport things back and forth.
Powerful entities were nothing here as if they confirmed a Pioneer, could they not send his blood back? If Ozymandias obtained the Blood of a Pioneer and severed more Sources of Existence...

chapters.title: Chapter 3418 Purgatory or Paradise? VI
paragraphs: All pieces were set as now, it only had to be put into practice.

The Infiniverse Megalos Body moved slowly and cautiously as she took a small bundle of blood in her hands and slowly placed it towards the center of the small multicolored pool of water below the Extremity Vein.
The blood sank in silently as there was no large reaction, and both the Infiniverse and Noah watched silently.
The moment of truth for all their theories.
For many possibilities!
They watched on silently as on their side, absolutely nothing changed.

In a certain Weaving of Existence. Within the Dream Aletheian Haven that had now become much more than this- other past authorities of the Infiniverse budding and filling it up as it couldn't just be called this anymore.
So Ozymandias termed it the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed!
At the very center of this place, there was an illusory Extremity Vein that had a vibrant multicolored pool below it.
The pool was surrounded by hundreds of radiant Terrestrial Runes of Existence that swirled with power and fervor, causing it to vibrate with complexity.
It was called a pool, but it alone was half the size of an Omniverse in diameter!
It represented possibility.
At this moment, Ozymandias' massive stellar obsidian body was accompanied by the Infiniverse Megalos Body, both of their eyes on the pool before them as the latter began to speak.

|In the Purgatory Lands, our other versions are attempting to place the first test object into this theoretically overlapping domain of the Infiniverse. It is unknown if the same amount of what was placed in would be recovered, if anything comes through at all-|
PA!
Her voice stopped.
Her eyes honed in on the massive multicolored sea!
Its surface was calm and free of any blemishes, and yet at this moment, a wave spread across it!
A round wave spread out in all directions at the center of the sea as after that, the central area bubbled while the Terrestrial Runes of Existence all around it buzzed.
And the waters parted ways at the very center as a single, minute, extremely small drop of Blood rose up!
It seemed as if it were dead before, with its authority gradually increasing as if it were waking up from a long slumber!
Alongside its rising was an explosion of unique complexity that spread out silently- sending out invisible waves from here that even stretched outside Omniverse X-999.
Elation showed on the face of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed.

Ozymandias radiated a terrifying pressure as above him, a massive Eye of Existence opened as it pulsed with obsidian gold grandeur, gazing at the small drop of Blood that rose at the center of the multicolored sea!

[Globule of Blood of an Existence Severing Entity(Maxus)]:: A small drop of blood belonging to an entity lost through the weavings of existence itself. Its volume and concentration are too little to exert any viable effects. It holds little use to the current you apart from researching it to learn about the severed source it may contain...

The drop of blood remained suspended above the multicolored sea until Ozymandias waved his hands towards it, coming to grasp it in his hands with a complex expression as this single test succeeding...meant many things!
The potential empowerment he could undergo could not even be calculated as he spoke with a terrifying light of brilliance to the Infiniverse.
|Have our other selves seek Pioneers- alive or dead. Other possible items viable for passage through this...Frequency Gateway can also be gathered!|
Frequency Gateway.
This was what Ozymandias termed the massive multicolored sea of brilliance where a drop of Blood had just risen from!
|Yes, Master!| The Infiniverse seems to have been supercharged as well, it's figure studying the changes that occured with the successful overlap of an item from one entire frequency to another.

|What was sent through was only a hundredth in volume compared to what was sent in. If we can forge more complex Runes of Existence to stabilize and increase the complexity of the Frequency Gateway...|
Their current power was still too little.
If they were already capable of forging Constellation Runes of Existence...things would be moving much faster!
But it seemed that when it related to the Purgatory Lands, nothing would be so easy.
The body of the Infiniverse pulsed with light as it began to forge another Rune of Existence when...
HUUM! A terrifying light leaked from it as its gaze went above.
Ozymandias was the same as his obsidian gold eye exploded with power and complexity, his body battle-ready!
Because above them, silent fluctuations and alarms were set off as something instantly bypassed into Omniverse X-999 and even went further to arrive in the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
Far too quickly!
When their gazes landed on this entrant, so did her gaze land on them.
And...all sides froze.
Utterly froze from pure shock and incredulity on both sides!
Above, the shadowy figure of Barbatos had been scouring the Megalos Ynnere looking for Omniverse X-999 this whole time and found nothing.
And yet just now, unknown waves of complexity even she couldn't put her finger on exploded out from here and drew her gaze to this place!
And...
And!
She looked at the tall, massive visage of a stellar obsidian Outerversal Morphon as this entity caused her heart to pulse the same pain as the man she had been entangled with!
When she looked at him, she felt the same sense of familiarity as if they were one and the same.
The same love. The same hope. The same guilt.
She felt this all at once as when she looked into his pulsing singularities of eyes, she also saw the shock and happiness within them that caused her to feel even worse for what she had done.
He was here.
But how was he here? WAP!
With a single jump, his massive stellar body appeared in front of Barbatos as he asked tenderly.
"Barbatos?"
She didn't have the same fair skin. But she was exactly the same apart from that!
He just called out to her once, and her entire weavings were instantly turned tumultuous as her entanglement became further cemented!
His massive hands reached out to her in an embrace as she quickly came out of her reverie- wiping the tears flowing from her eyes as she shook her head.
"No, I'm not your Barbatos-...!"
He ignored her words and grabbed her small body, pulling it onto his stellar obsidian chest freely as Barbatos couldn't feel any strength in her body!

She held an unfathomable amount of power that would even make Pioneers despair, and yet at this moment, she found out that somehow, she couldn't muster even a fraction of such power to push away this being.
He simply embraced her, and in the next moment, she felt the heavy weight of guilt and heartache leave her rapidly as she cried.
"I'm sorry. I'm sorry...I didn't know it would be you. I didn't know our interference was to ensure you were pulled into that place!"

The Infiniverse Megalos Body moved slowly and cautiously as she took a small bundle of blood in her hands and slowly placed it towards the center of the small multicolored pool of water below the Extremity Vein.
The blood sank in silently as there was no large reaction, and both the Infiniverse and Noah watched silently.
The moment of truth for all their theories.
For many possibilities!
They watched on silently as on their side, absolutely nothing changed.
In a certain Weaving of Existence.
Within the Dream Aletheian Haven that had now become much more than this- other past authorities of the Infiniverse budding and filling it up as it couldn't just be called this anymore.
So Ozymandias termed it the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed!
At the very center of this place, there was an illusory Extremity Vein that had a vibrant multicolored pool below it.
The pool was surrounded by hundreds of radiant Terrestrial Runes of Existence that swirled with power and fervor, causing it to vibrate with complexity.
It was called a pool, but it alone was half the size of an Omniverse in diameter!
It represented possibility.
At this moment, Ozymandias' massive stellar obsidian body was accompanied by the Infiniverse Megalos Body, both of their eyes on the pool before them as the latter began to speak.
|In the Purgatory Lands, our other versions are attempting to place the first test object into this theoretically overlapping domain of the Infiniverse.
It is unknown if the same amount of what was placed in would be recovered, if anything comes through at all-|
PA!
Her voice stopped.
Her eyes honed in on the massive multicolored sea!
Its surface was calm and free of any blemishes, and yet at this moment, a wave spread across it!
A round wave spread out in all directions at the center of the sea as after that, the central area bubbled while the Terrestrial Runes of Existence all around it buzzed.
And the waters parted ways at the very center as a single, minute, extremely small drop of Blood rose up!
It seemed as if it were dead before, with its authority gradually increasing as if it were waking up from a long slumber!
Alongside its rising was an explosion of unique complexity that spread out silently- sending out invisible waves from here that even stretched outside Omniverse X-999.
Elation showed on the face of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed.

Ozymandias radiated a terrifying pressure as above him, a massive Eye of Existence opened as it pulsed with obsidian gold grandeur, gazing at the small drop of Blood that rose at the center of the multicolored sea!
[Globule of Blood of an Existence Severing Entity(Maxus)]:: A small drop of blood belonging to an entity lost through the weavings of existence itself.
Its volume and concentration are too little to exert any viable effects.
It holds little use to the current you apart from researching it to learn about the severed source it may contain...

The drop of blood remained suspended above the multicolored sea until Ozymandias waved his hands towards it, coming to grasp it in his hands with a complex expression as this single test succeeding...meant many things!
The potential empowerment he could undergo could not even be calculated as he spoke with a terrifying light of brilliance to the Infiniverse.
|Have our other selves seek Pioneers- alive or dead.
Other possible items viable for passage through this...Frequency Gateway can also be gathered!|
Frequency Gateway.
This was what Ozymandias termed the massive multicolored sea of brilliance where a drop of Blood had just risen from!
|Yes, Master!| The Infiniverse seems to have been supercharged as well, it's figure studying the changes that occured with the successful overlap of an item from one entire frequency to another.
|What was sent through was only a hundredth in volume compared to what was sent in.
If we can forge more complex Runes of Existence to stabilize and increase the complexity of the Frequency Gateway...|
Their current power was still too little.
If they were already capable of forging Constellation Runes of Existence...things would be moving much faster!
But it seemed that when it related to the Purgatory Lands, nothing would be so easy.
The body of the Infiniverse pulsed with light as it began to forge another Rune of Existence when...
HUUM!
A terrifying light leaked from it as its gaze went above.
Ozymandias was the same as his obsidian gold eye exploded with power and complexity, his body battle-ready!
Because above them, silent fluctuations and alarms were set off as something instantly bypassed into Omniverse X-999 and even went further to arrive in the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
Far too quickly!
When their gazes landed on this entrant, so did her gaze land on them.
And...all sides froze.
Utterly froze from pure shock and incredulity on both sides!
Above, the shadowy figure of Barbatos had been scouring the Megalos Ynnere looking for Omniverse X-999 this whole time and found nothing.
And yet just now, unknown waves of complexity even she couldn't put her finger on exploded out from here and drew her gaze to this place!
And...
And!
She looked at the tall, massive visage of a stellar obsidian Outerversal Morphon as this entity caused her heart to pulse the same pain as the man she had been entangled with!
When she looked at him, she felt the same sense of familiarity as if they were one and the same.
The same love.
The same hope.
The same guilt.
She felt this all at once as when she looked into his pulsing singularities of eyes, she also saw the shock and happiness within them that caused her to feel even worse for what she had done.
He was here.
But how was he here?
WAP!
With a single jump, his massive stellar body appeared in front of Barbatos as he asked tenderly.
"Barbatos?"
She didn't have the same fair skin.
But she was exactly the same apart from that!
He just called out to her once, and her entire weavings were instantly turned tumultuous as her entanglement became further cemented!
His massive hands reached out to her in an embrace as she quickly came out of her reverie- wiping the tears flowing from her eyes as she shook her head.
"No, I'm not your Barbatos-...!"
He ignored her words and grabbed her small body, pulling it onto his stellar obsidian chest freely as Barbatos couldn't feel any strength in her body!

She held an unfathomable amount of power that would even make Pioneers despair, and yet at this moment, she found out that somehow, she couldn't muster even a fraction of such power to push away this being.
He simply embraced her, and in the next moment, she felt the heavy weight of guilt and heartache leave her rapidly as she cried.
"I'm sorry.
I'm sorry...I didn't know it would be you.
I didn't know our interference was to ensure you were pulled into that place!"

chapters.title: Chapter 3419 A Heavy Entanglement! I
paragraphs: She didn't know the interference would ensure that he was pulled into that place.
A single sentence.
And yet it held an overabundance of meaning as Ozymandias and the Infiniverse were briefly shocked at its implications!
Ozymandias looked at the young woman in his arms as her face held immense guilt, and he also sensed the shocking level of Complexity her body emanated as he instantly drew a few conclusions.
Yes, this was not his Barbatos, but another.
A Barbatos with terrifying levels of power as she could only come from different weavings of existence- showcased by her dark skin in comparison to the fair-skinned Barbatos he always knew.
Another conclusion was that somehow, this version of Barbatos was directed to act against him- to ensure that the actions of those entities from the Immovable Sacred Palace struck them!

Another conclusion was that she didn't act alone. Ozymandias instantly recalled that unfathomable silver black radiance that pulled back the Blancverse- the power Noah couldn't overcome no matter how much he tried.
He thought of many things as he went back to her last words.
She didn't know.
It meant she was sent here by some force he didn't even know about, and yet he had somehow fallen in their crosshairs!
Feeling his gaze as he looked at ways in a daze, the guilt within Barbatos became even more intense as she voiced out silently.
"Please...don't hate me." She looked pained. So fearful that Ozymandias couldn't help but sigh and bring her closer!
His body rapidly altered itself as he gained more humanoid features.
He raised her chin and looked into her teary eyes as he went closer and pressed his lips against hers.
This was another Barbatos, but she was his Barbatos. That would never change!
"I would never be mad at you."
After a long kiss, he told her this.
The eyes of Barbatos looked panicked and filled with complex emotions at this simple kiss- and it seemed to wake her up as she pulled back.
She shook her head as if to come out of a trance, her hand raised towards Ozymandias accusingly as she couldn't bring herself to say anything!
At that point, Ozymandias was calm as he asked lightly.
"Can you explain a little more?"
A new entrant appeared.
Her power was unknown and seemed much higher than theirs, and she was a very familiar face.
After stabilizing her state of mind, Ozymandias sought more information!
Meanwhile.
In the Expanse.

At the location where a massive Blancverse had just been drawn into a horrific place, only two Existence Severing entities and a Pioneer remained as they observed the Strings of Existence here with somber expressions.
Ever so often, a golden string of existence would snap and disappear as they didn't know what to make of this!
Around the same time that the Frequency Gateway was utilized to transport a minuscule droplet of blood.
TRIIING!
Instantly, a dozen strings snapped all at once and sent out a shockwave of brilliance, Pioneer Heracles and others observing this with somber gazes as Heracles shook his head.
|This is not normal. But our actions shouldn't have triggered something like this...|
They couldn't fathom why.
Even with all their experience, they had never observed strings of the Expanse snapping like this!

|I will share this observation with the other Pioneers within the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse, we can use their connection to reach out to those Source Complexity personages who can grasp a situation like this much more easily...|
Pioneer Heracles took it seriously as he stated this. Palace Master Antiope and Nisa stayed quiet as they didn't disagree when it came to this!
At such a moment, Nisa raised her hand and stated a fact she had just realized.
|The concentration of atmospheric authority of the Expanse has reduced noticeably since the Strings of Existence began to snap in this area...|
A terrifying realization.
What would happen if this continued?
None of them knew as, at this moment; two remained while Pioneer Heracles left to alert others!
Back in Omniverse X-999.
Within the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed.

"I am sorry that I cannot reveal more. I've already ignored everything taught to me and am now faced with a heavy Entanglement within this Weaving of Existence. If I reveal anything regarding where I come from, what type of force I belong to, or even mention any identities, they will know. And they cannot know."
The voice of Barbatos echoed out as she seemed to have slowly regained her regality.
Her eyes were still tender whenever they gazed at Ozymandias as what she could see was exactly the same as the visage of Noah on Ozymandias!
At her words, the Infiniverse was reflective while Ozymandias listened calmly.
And after a few seconds...
The Infiniverse had a stern expression as she spoke.
|You can help us rectify this. Your complexity seems to be high as you can help us to ensure that Master's other self can come out from that place.|
The Infiniverse uttered words that caused Barbatos to stare at her with incredulity as she replied while shaking her head.

"Nobody...comes out of that place. It has been that way for countless cycles. It is a place where countless entities inadvertently fall into, and some are purposefully sent into. Entities who were caught traversing across different weavings of the Wheel...and others who violated rulings they shouldn't have are all sent there. No matter their previous power, no matter their complexity...none have survived."
None.
Her words carried a pang of heavy guilt as she knew very well where the existence of Noah Osmont was sent into!
But...Ozymandias raised his hand in the next moment as he showed a drop of glimmering blood.
"We've already been able to transfer a drop of blood from the Purgatory Lands and have them appear here."
Barbatos looked at that drop with somberness and shock, her hands waving as it came into her palm and she scrutinized it.
And moments later, her shock became extremely grave as she looked towards Ozymandias and the Infiniverse!

chapters.title: Chapter 3420 A Heavy Entanglement! II
paragraphs: How?
At such a question, the Infiniverse Megalos Body pointed to the multicolored sea that made up a large portion of the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed.

"I am different from anything you've come across before. All I need are more complex Runes of Existence to facilitate this process. Amplification, Space, Transfer, Resonance, Overlap. Any single word of the language of the Wheel at a greater level of complexity will allow us to continue doing this at a much greater pace and maybe eventually...even allow Master's other self to return as well."
Infiniverse presented the runes all around the multicolored sea as Barbatos observed them all and the dazzling sea with sharp eyes.
She wanted to say it wasn't feasible. She wanted to say that such a thing was impossible!
And yet, she found no reason for this as she could only shake her head with a sense of incredulity before she turned towards Ozymandias.
Ozymandias was gazing at her with a smile as she sighed internally while her body began to glow with silver black radiance.

"I am already this far entangled, what's a little bit more? I will do all I can to help, but there will come a limit. If I exceed it, the ones who send out people like me on missions across the different Spokes of the Wheel of Existence may find something out."
She spoke valiantly as inadvertently, she revealed a little bit more information at the same time!
HUUM!
Her small body began to pulse with waves of incandescence as she closed her eyes.
"Runes...will gradually seem less complex in your eyes the higher in complexity your weavings of existence become."
In front of her, a multicolored Rune of Existence began to form.
Its complexity was utterly frightening as it began to spell the word Amplification, yet it seemed to hold millions of strokes that Barbatos was rapidly making one by one!
The moment it bloomed, the atmospheric levels of authority in the surroundings began to bubble and increase.

"With your existence Severed, you can begin studying and forging Constellation Runes of Existence as it is akin to being blind and putting on glasses that allow you to see clearly. If you go a step further and Pioneer your own Existence, forging complex Constellation Runes of Existence becomes possible, and if you attain a Source..."
A Source.
Source Complexity of Existence!

Barbatos showed a Rune made from a few million strokes bloom and be completed in a matter of seconds, its radiance heart shaking as it moved from her and floated towards the massive multicolored sea- its multicolored radiance matching the multicolored sea as both seemed to resonate.
The sea became even more vibrant, and it even enlarged a little more.

"At a certain point, a single Rune of Existence meant to convey and assert an undeniable authority of a single word can also be infused with the meaning of other words. In that single Amplification Rune of Existence, I was also able to infuse the meaning of resonance- achieving compounding results with a single Rune. When you can start to do this, the language of Runes of Existence will feel like something you've known your whole life."
Barbatos explained silently as from her small figure, an unfathomable spark lit up in the next moment as if an endless sea was waking up.
Of tremendous complexity.
Of unfathomable power.
And a moment later...
BOOM!
It all erupted to form dozens of multicolored runes that radiated terrifying complexity.
A complexity so heavy that it spread out into Omniverse X-999 itself and caused this Omniverse to vibrate and tremble slightly!
Yet they formed en masse, multiple Runes of Existence being completed every single second before they were sent around or above the periphery of the multicolored sea- the Frequency Gateway.
They enlarged and spun with radiance as a single rune became as massive as a Cosmos- a single word conveying such terrific power and brilliance that wouldn't fade for an unknown amount of time!
Barbatos continued to do this process for the next hour- allowing for over 30,000 Runes of Existence that seemed to be at the very apex of Constellation Runes to bloom.
Each one felt as brilliant if not more than the most powerful Rune that Noah had attained from the Tresoverse Domain of the Omnifather.
A single one seemed to be just as complex as the single Amarantos Rune of Existence!
Barbatos finished her forging and stopped there as her small figure heaved her blessed chest up and down in tiredness.
"That...is as much as I can do right now. It's thousands of times more in effect than what the Runes that were here before granted. I need to rest..."
Her eyes expressed pride and tiredness as in the corner of her eyes; she seemed to be looking towards Ozymandias, waiting for praise!
Ozymandias looked at the dazzling scene of churning brilliance as he nodded.
"You've done more than enough."

Beside him, the Infiniverse seemed to no longer hold any sternness towards Barbatos as she nodded towards her while gazing at her figure like a prized possession she wanted to keep to herself to produce Runes forever!
|I will see just how great a change there is now...|
Her eyes were filled with expectation as she went towards the center of the multicolored sea that was quite literally bubbling with complexity.
This left Ozymandias and Barbatos alone as the latter appeared in front of her once more.

"Meanwhile, you and I should get to know each other some more. What are the differences, what is the same?" He spoke while he took Barbatos in his arms once more, his face nudging her tired face as she panicked and gazed down at his chest.
"We can...talk some more. I can tell you about-"

She wriggled in his arms as with her power, she could have easily broken out at any time! And yet she remained as if she was enchanted by some feeling. By a complex thought even she couldn't overcome!
She felt Ozymandias shake his head as his arms wrapped around her even more tightly.
"No, Barbatos, we are not going to talk." ...!
With a glimmer of radiance, something unobservable to the eyes of many bloomed within the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed!
