chapters.title: Chapter 3421 Giving a Monster Wings! I
paragraphs: Hell Terra Firma.
The Purgatory Lands!
An unknown number of entities lay within as with the rejection of Mana and any Natal authority, all life forms were the same.
They lived and died.
But there were lifeforms who had long lives even without the influence of Mana.
Turtles who could live for a few hundred years.
Tree lifeforms that could live for a few thousand years.
Dragons, Phoenixes, and other unique variations of lifeforms also had lifespans exceeding one thousand years or more even without Mana!
"But I am just a lone little human being, you see. My life is extremely short as I have to make the most of it."
Noah's voice echoed out as he looked at five humanoid entities suspected to have been Pioneers in this Settlement!
This was the task that Ruination had been given charge of carrying out the moment that the first test succeeded.
She commandingly asked for any information regarding Pioneers in this small Settlement, and in this population of a few thousand- 5 possible ones were identified and found.
From rumors. From something they had said before. From their disposition and gazes.
After knowing the hardships of Hell Terra Firma, very few Pioneers made their past position of power public knowledge as those who were most powerful...were those targeted the most in these lands.

A human woman that used to be an Ordinance Amalgamation entity? Not worth much. A human woman who used to be a Pioneer? Some Warlords of Settlements made it a goal to find them as they felt like they were collecting entities of extremely noble lineage and esteem!
Even male entities at the level of power of Pioneers were prized as in the Purgatory Lands, past complexity still played a role in status.
Noah looked at the five humanoid entities before him and asked thoughtfully while behind him, Ruination gazed on imposingly.
"I have no ill will towards you all, nor are your lives in danger. You will even be compensated for your services. So...would any of you step forward if you were a Pioneer before you arrived here?"
He asked calmly as he chewed on a chicken drumstick with his right hand.
Hunger was very real here, and he was a voracious man.
He ate and gazed at the five beings before him- two holding animalistic features as one had the head of a lion, and another had white fur and a tail as she closely resembled a variant of a simian.
A single woman, and five men.
When asked, they looked at each other wryly as a man with fair skin and red hair spoke gruffly.
"Compensated how?"
"Food, water, whatever one needs for survival." Noah turned his head towards this being as after he asked such a question...
He stepped out of the lineup and spoke with a gaze of solemnity and power- as if to relive his past life!
"I reached the heights of a Pioneer before being swept up in this place. What do you need from me?"
What could he need from a Pioneer?
Noah smiled and brought a few things forward.
"Just fill this little bowl with your blood."

He threw the jagged blade he obtained from an inconsequential extra as well as a small clay bowl, the man looking at this with disturbed eyes, but he made a cut on his palm and did what was asked of him!

Noah watched on and then passed the small bowl filled with crimson blow towards the Infiniverse Megalos Body who was waiting in the distance, and she took it while disappearing into the complex and massive Infiniverse Megalos Seed behind them!
He looked at the red haired man and nodded.
"This may be the beginning of a long relationship. I'll only ask for a little volume of blood from you each day, and you can live the life of a Warlord."
He spoke while also looking at the other four humanoid beings as if he were nudging them on!
None of them moved forward.
And after a few seconds, the visage of the Infiniverse climbed out of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed, her gaze frosty and filled with a cold light as she spoke out.
"Merely Existence Severing."
WAA!
There wasn't a burst of pressure or haki as there would normally be since all authority was rejected.

But the air in the surroundings felt a tad bit colder just from the calm smile fading away from Noah's face, with Ruination making a move behind him as she threw out a punch onto the chest of the red haired man and flung him back like a ragdoll!
"Do not lie to me, for it will not end well."
The eyes of the other 4 vibrated at such a scene and unnatural strength displayed by Ruination.
They looked back to see the wheezing visage of the red haired man who had only claimed to be a Pioneer to try and get resources as in their situation, how could they lose anything?
With all authority here rejected, if one said they were a Pioneer, then they were a Pioneer. After all, there was no way to check.
And yet...this being before them seemed to be able to do just that!
"So..." His gaze, now icy, turned towards the remaining four humanoid entities.
"Any chance that you all are Pioneers?"
Immense silence reigned in.
Nobody else dared to step up until...
The white furred simian woman rose up with a cold gaze.
Her eyes were radiating a dim light of coldness as she spoke out somberly.

"These three are useless things, but you can have a bit of my blood every day if you want. All I want to know is how that woman behind you can access such power. Is she of another lineage? A Miniature Titan? Progeny of Dragons? Are all able to access a smidgen of authority unlike everyone else?"
She rose and asked multiple questions.
Noah raised his brows at her as he affirmed.
"You are a Pioneer?"
White hair all over her body. Simian in nature!
This woman came forward and took another clay bowl that Noah put forward, taking out her own knife within her robes and making a cut on her palm as she slowly filled up a small bowl with blood!
"You can check for yourself."
Her gaze was firm.
Noah took the clay bowl and passed it to Infiniverse once more who disappeared into the Infiniverse Megalos Seed, his eyes expectant as this may just be the real deal!

chapters.title: Chapter 3422 Giving a Monster Wings! II
paragraphs: Within a certain frequency of Existence.
Inside Omniverse X-999.
Within the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
Surrounded by utterly intense weavings and swirling multicolored brilliance, the Infiniverse Megalos Body watched with bright eyes as something came through the center of the multicolored pool!

After the shocking revamp done through the hands of Barbatos with over 30,000 utterly complex Runes of Existence, the speed, quantity, and quality at which things traveled across the Frequency Gateway was much faster.
No longer was it just a hundredth or a fraction of what was sent in.
There was still some loss in quantity, but nowhere near as drastic as it was before.
And at this moment.
Finally.
HUUM!
The waters of the multicolored sea trembled as from it, a crimson drop of blood rose and slowly became painted with white gold brilliance as from it, a terrifying aura erupted!
An aura of potency.
An aura of power.
An aura of something that had engineered its own path!
"Pioneer..."
The eyes of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed pulsed with a terrifying light as she felt the genuine aura of a Pioneer blooming from the drop of white gold blood!

She wanted to celebrate such a stupendous achievement as she looked back, only to see the enclosed obsidian domain the size of a world where Ozymandias had taken Barbatos in floating silently in the distance.

The Infiniverse knew her Master had now gone hours without any of his clones seeing his...companions in the Infiniverse Megalos Seed, and he seemed to be making up for all this lost time on Barbatos alone as he took her within that enclosed domain and even dilated time within it.
The Infiniverse even saw multiple multicolored Runes of Existence arise and swirl around this obsidian domain- these Runes radiating the singular word of TIME!
A few minutes out here could be hours or days inside of that small enclosed domain as her Master should have gotten to know this new Barbatos quite a bit.
As the Infiniverse looked at the obsidian domain, brilliance flickered from it as Ozymandias showed himself- his body pulsing with much heavier complexity as he seemed to have made tremendous gains!
The Infiniverse looked at him with raised brows as she asked lightly.
|Dual Cultivation with a Source Complexity entity is that fruitful?|
She asked lightly as Ozymandias smiled while shaking his head.

"More than we can even imagine. But she is too restricted and cannot even reveal a tenth of her Source here, otherwise her people will track her. Obtaining a Globule of Blood of a Pioneer was successful?"
Ozymandias felt the purity and potency of his existence as he couldn't help but shake his head in amazement.

The Blood of a Source Complexity entity, even if they had just entered this complexity like Barbatos, would be even more potent. But she was also restricted on this as what she termed her Entanglement would get even worse if parts of her were spread into those of this weaving of existence and utilized to accomplish anything!
But the effects of Dual Cultivation alone were tremendous as his Complexity had more than doubled since he began his discussions with Barbatos.
He sent a clone out after he felt the blazing aura of a Pioneer as he now looked at a dazzling globule of Blood
|Yes, Master.|
The Infiniverse spared one last glance into the obsidian room before her hand made a motion towards the white gold drop of blood.
Their confirmation that this unwanted entry into Hell Terra Firma...was actually bound to be an unfathomable opportunity.
Noah was already monstrous.
Ozymandias was already monstrous!
This was akin to giving terrible monsters wings to fly even faster when they were already steamrolling everything even faster than the speed of light.
"Good..."
Ozymandias nodded with a smile as the white gold drop of blood eventually fell into his hands.

[Globule of Blood of a Pioneer(Nysa)]:: The scattered Severed weavings of existence and scattered path of a Pioneer have been determined to belong to the Great Pioneer that went missing decades ago from an unknown frequency. On the 10th Cycle of her life, she severed all attachments and weavings that bound her, attaining a Severed State of Existence. On the 11th Cycle of her life, she finally Pioneered her own weavings above Severing. A drop of her blood has generated the capability for you to Sever a single, small aspect of your own weavings, including but not limited to Individual Concepts, Individual Values, and Individual Techniques. Anything Severed will be unshackled from the common norms of existence, even allowing you a sense of definition for the individual severing...
Truly.
A drop of Blood of a Pioneer was collected, and he could continue to do so from Pioneer Nysa in the Hell Terra Firma every single day...

If he could obtain more Pioneers that he could use akin to blood bags consistently, he could obtain a source of Loot that allowed him to sever Existential shackles of every single Ordinance he had...even without the process of Amalgamation with them.
That was how terrifying this was!
Others had the threat of collapse of their Existence during Amalgamation and Existence Severing, while he went about it in such a terrifyingly different way as the results were obscene.
He took the Globule of Blood into his body as he voiced out silently.
"Sever Outerversal."
WUU!

Outerversal Physiology. Megalos Regnum. What hung over them and held them together would soon be bathed with a glorious light of severing as at the same time, Ozymandias waved his hands and caused the appearance of a Blacksmith's Forge the size of a Cosmos to bloom behind them.

Light was already brightly burning in this forge as multiple dazzling items were already inside of it, and they were spat out at this moment as they included thin but extremely durable body armor, sets of white, crimson, and golden full body armors, spears, swords, crossbows, guns, cases of bullets, military grade equipment, helmets, and many others things that looked like the equipment to adorn a terrifying army!
The material utilized was meant to be as light as a feather while holding tremendous durability and heaviness, this being easy work for the Forge of the Secondary Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
Such an assortment of equipment floated out of the forge and towards the center of the multicolored sea below them, the eyes of Ozymandias radiating a terrifying light as he spoke!

"My other self will have to obtain more Pioneers. Countless are to be found across the Settlements and lands of Hell Terra Firma as for this...he will have access to resources that others cannot even imagine in this hellish lands."
They could send things out of Hell Terra Firma as this was a hard hurdle.
What about sending things in?
Ozymandias didn't even bother to ask as dazzling sets of equipment were thrown into the multicolored sea!

chapters.title: Chapter 3423 Giving a Monster Wings! III
paragraphs: It was a ridiculous occurrence.
Hell Terra Firma was a place where authority was absolutely rejected, and a place where countless entities from all sorts of weavings of existence could find themselves drawn into.
Most of the time, it was accidental.
Other times, it was through the hands of others as it was intentional.
But whichever way it was, once someone arrived there, they would be faced with a complete rejection of mana and everything else and be reduced to an extremely weak state!
Nobody out of all those arriving in Hell Terra Firma was prepared for it.

They would not have the resources nor the weapons to utilize, as if someone was lucky to be holding a weapon or armor at the time of their disappearance into this frequency- they would continue to have this beside them.
But even a weapon made of the most sacred metal would lose their most powerful quality and be reduced to something normal!

Even if one held an entire treasure vault of resources, weapons, and food inside a Spatial Ring, Spatial Necklace, or an Isolated Space deep inside of them- they wouldn't be able to access it as there was no such thing as authority to get through to these spaces and take things out.
So there could be no preparation for Hell Terra Firma.
And such a thing was absolute!
It was.
Now, there was Noah Osmont.
He also did not have any preparations as he initially found himself in the same state as everyone else, with only a slight change as those accompanying him were too unique!
The makeup of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed allowed her a shred of workings.
Ruination's unique composition allowed more strength to be expressed from her.

And now...an utter violation of rules that all others were bound to was about to take place as Ozymandias observed the uniquely crafted items disappear into the multicolored sea that was pulsing with the support of thousands of Constellation Runes of Existence.
Each one was made with the knowledge that authority did not work on Hell Terra Firma.
So the material used had to be those that retained their state in nature without the influence of authority.
Not an armor built as the authority inside it made it impenetrable, but an armor made with metal or crystals that were naturally hard in nature!

Ozymandias utilized combinations of Tungsten, Gold, Titanium, Osmium, Cesium, Diamond, Topaz, and more to construct armaments and weapons that would be nearly unbreakable in nature, with others granted malleability and softness as even heavy armor and huge weapons were forged with extremely light metal to the point that even a child could lift them.

Survival gear to treat wounds, antibiotics, pain medication, containers filled with water, containers filled with foods, and much more were sent into that pool as these resources that were of terrifying scarcity in Hell Terra Firma...Ozymandias was about to flood them into this place!
Just thinking of what his other self could accomplish with all this caused his Outerversal authority being Severed currently to dance with glee and expectations!
In the unfathomable frequency known as Hell Terra Firma.

In a minuscule corner of a Settlement, the Infiniverse stared at the Infiniverse Megalos Seed that had a much larger pool of water floating underneath the Extremity Vein- all of this influenced by the shocking number of Runes of Existence on the other side!
What they could send back vastly increased in quality and quantity as currently, they were observing the opposite action.
Sending things here.
It wouldn't be hard, would i-...!?
SAA!
The multicolored pool flickered with a dim radiance as, one after another, items began to rise on its surface as if they had been here all along.
Glittering armaments, weapons, and other items began to bubble and rise on the surface of the pool!
The eyes of Infiniverse lit up as she grabbed them one after another, taking them from the pool and placing them towards a corner of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed as very quickly...
"Ruination!"
The Infiniverse Megalos Body called with with hurriedness as there were just too many things bubbling up.
Ruination quickly went over as her eyes lit up at the sight of the items, and she began to quickly take them out of the Infiniverse and pile them behind Noah!
She was sorting weapons in one area, armor in another, and survival tools in other areas.
Hearing the commotion, Noah, who was talking to the white furred Pioneer Nysa, rose up and walked back as well.

Nysa was able to see the massive structure of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed as at this moment, her eyes opened wide in incredulity as she saw a large number of things being taken from it, gradually beginning to form a small mountain as what she saw was so terrific that subconsciously, her figure couldn't remain standing as her knees hit the gray earth!
She rubbed her eyes to make sure she was seeing correctly.
Armors and weapons.
And were those...containers and bottles holding extremely pure water? That...! That...!
Her mind buzzed as the other unidentified does in the background couldn't see Pioneer with as much detail.

Noah came forward at the increasing piles of treasures and smiled with a terrifying devilish glint, his hands looking over all of them before he went forward and picked up a thin and loose golden fabric.
A body suit that was undoubtedly made with his measurements as it felt soft to the touch, yet even a bullet would not be able to pass through it!

The current clothes he had on were taken off of his body as his bare ass was exposed to the figure of Pioneer Nysa in the back who was gazing at this all incredulously, and Noah adorned the protective body suit right away.

He then reached out towards golden boots, briefs, chest plate, and gloves that were all part of a matching full body armor- their heaviness being almost nonexistent even though they could easily knock away even armor piercing rounds of bullets!

Glittering armaments, weapons, and other items began to bubble and rise on the surface of the pool!
The eyes of Infiniverse lit up as she grabbed them one after another, taking them from the pool and placing them towards a corner of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed as very quickly...
"Ruination!"
The Infiniverse Megalos Body called with with hurriedness as there were just too many things bubbling up.
Ruination quickly went over as her eyes lit up at the sight of the items, and she began to quickly take them out of the Infiniverse and pile them behind Noah!
She was sorting weapons in one area, armor in another, and survival tools in other areas.
Hearing the commotion, Noah, who was talking to the white furred Pioneer Nysa, rose up and walked back as well.

Nysa was able to see the massive structure of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed as at this moment, her eyes opened wide in incredulity as she saw a large number of things being taken from it, gradually beginning to form a small mountain as what she saw was so terrific that subconsciously, her figure couldn't remain standing as her knees hit the gray earth!
She rubbed her eyes to make sure she was seeing correctly.
Armors and weapons.
And were those...containers and bottles holding extremely pure water?
That...!
That...!
Her mind buzzed as the other unidentified does in the background couldn't see Pioneer with as much detail.

Noah came forward at the increasing piles of treasures and smiled with a terrifying devilish glint, his hands looking over all of them before he went forward and picked up a thin and loose golden fabric.
A body suit that was undoubtedly made with his measurements as it felt soft to the touch, yet even a bullet would not be able to pass through it!

The current clothes he had on were taken off of his body as his bare ass was exposed to the figure of Pioneer Nysa in the back who was gazing at this all incredulously, and Noah adorned the protective body suit right away.

He then reached out towards golden boots, briefs, chest plate, and gloves that were all part of a matching full body armor- their heaviness being almost nonexistent even though they could easily knock away even armor piercing rounds of bullets!

chapters.title: Chapter 3424 Giving a Monster Wings! IV
paragraphs: It felt as comfortable and light as if he were adorning silk robes, and yet their might could likely smash away a normal human.
He looked at his visage, which was now covered by two layers of armor, as he felt a sense of protection.
As a normal human, he could die here at any time.
Having protective measures would greatly ease his mind!
He looked at the other items piling up into a mountain before him as he took two bottles of water, throwing one towards the dazed Pioneer Nysa while he drank the other.
Relishing the clean taste, he spoke out valiantly.

"Our cooperation will be a beneficial one. You let me know of any others like you- Pioneers, whether in this Settlement or others. Keep providing blood daily...and you will live a comfortable life here that others can only dream of."
His eyes burned with ambition.
He had arrived in a place where force was contained.
Strength ruled, and nobody had an exorbitant amount of it.
It was all equal.
The only differences came in body types as massive animals like Titans or Dragons who formed their own Settlements would still be formidable foes!
Among them, there may be Pioneers, or even Source Complexity existences.
And Noah wanted them all.

Ambition coursed across his body as he grabbed another set of armor and threw them towards the first Pioneer to offer her blood to him, the dazzling gold armaments landing on her feet as she stared at them dazedly!
In a few more seconds, the sound of steps echoed out from behind as Infiniverse came out, her hand holding a piece of paper that listed a catalog of every single thing sent over so far.
Noah accepted it and read through everything as his eyes lit up even more.

Behind him, Ruination appeared while carrying a massive obsidian case twice her size- and she laid it down on the gray earth while pressing a button at the very center that caused this case to open up its compartments!

Within, a neon crimson gold body suit could be seen, the clothes adorning Ruination falling off as an exquisite naked figure briefly showed itself with an ample chest and waist before seconds later, it was wrapped up in the neon crimson gold battlesuit.

The case seemed to hold multiple compartments as at the very center, a glistening obsidian purple sniper rifle lay shining with a dangerous glint as Ruination picked it up and checked it before she swung it behind her back.
In the compartment, there were also two golden desert eagle pistols that she grabbed and checked before they were holstered on straps on the sides of her thighs.
She then picked out two katanas with golden handles and white blades, their sharpness even being felt from afar as they were also sheathed on preset components of her battle suit on her back!

She seemed to be pulling one terrifying weapon after another and placing it on her body as by the time she was done, she could mutilate and cut up ordinary men in a manner where they wouldn't even know what had just happened.
She then came to stand behind Noah like a hardened general as she stared forth coldly.
Noah was staring at the catalog of all things brought over as he voiced out to the Infiniverse.
"Let me have the Miniature Polyacrylate Housing Unit #1."
Miniature Polyacrylate Housing Unit.
Something designed by the Infiniverse Megalos Seed herself that was made up of preset constructed structure through materials that were known as hydrophilic polymers or superabsorbent polymers!
All they needed was to absorb water, and they would rapidly expand to their preset shape.
The Infiniverse modified them to also have a sense of hardness as at this moment, she brought the Miniature Polyacrylate Housing Unit #1 to Noah.
By all means, it looked like a small eaten castle that a child could play with.
But Noah took it and walked to the clearing behind them where the old house of Warlord Maxus used to be.
"Move back."
He gave a simple command to the others as he set the miniature castle on the ground, using the half-drunk bottle of water in his hands as he poured it onto the Miniature Polyacrylate Housing Unit #1!
His own figure dashed away right after as in a few seconds...
WUU!
The miniature castle absorbed every drop of water on it, and without the usage of any authority...it instantly and rapidly began to expand.
The ground shook as if a giant had stepped down, and before anyone could even blink, a glistening silver castle with three pointed peaks appeared before them.
Pioneer Nysa's jaw opened wide.
The other inhabitants of Hell Terra Firma, who had been here for months or years, looked at this scene in utter shock and horror as they wondered what the hell was going on!
They couldn't use any authority, right?
So what exactly was this being doing?!
None of them had an answer as Noah looked at the dazzling work of science before him, walking to it and touching its walls that felt like concrete at this moment.
He opened its silver doors and looked within as he saw a long hall leading into it, and other doors that led to other rooms.
A place fit for an emperor to sleep in, not these snacks within this Settlement.
He smiled at this progression of events as he spoke out other sets of commands.
"Set up the Miniature Polyacrylate Defense Walls around this whole area. And let us get ready with all the means to raise and equip an army..."
His words betrayed his wild ambition.
He had to get his hands on more rare entities that were weak and powerless in this place.
Their blood and very being would serve as fuel for power as in the future to come, he would go across Hell Terra Firma while finding a way out of this!
As for those who put him here?
The figures within the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse?
They would face the wrath and gratefulness of Ozymandias alone as they may not even be alive by the time he got out of here!

chapters.title: Chapter 3425 Giving a Monster Wings! V
paragraphs: The wrath and gratefulness of Ozymandias.
Both would have to be felt hand in hand as even though coming to this place was a plot others made against him, he was about to turn even this place into a tremendous fortune.
Wrath because they potentially trapped him in a place he could not leave. Gratefulness because oh man, things were going to be turned upside down due to it!
Adorned in a radiantly gold set of armament, Noah stared at the cluster of many more things behind him as he prepared.
Around this same period of time.
Within the Source Frequency of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed.
In the Expanse.
The visage of Pioneer Heracles was back at the point of Origin where many things had occurred, and the place where strings of existence had been snapping left and right with varying frequency.
This time, he wasn't alone.
He was accompanied by equally terrifying auras of other Pioneers of Existence of the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse!
Two were humanoid entities with white wings stretching out behind their backs, white robes covering their bodies as their faces seemed to be burning with crackling white flames.
One was a massive silver feathered Phoenix, her eyes piercing and radiating a cold light.
And lastly, there was a calm looking man in green robes and a bamboo hat who was gazing at everything with a serene gaze.
SNAP!
Just then, yet another string of existence snapped as the gazes of all Pioneers here became even colder.
"When did you say this all began?"
One of the figures with white wings asked succinctly while Pioneer Heracles answered while waving his hands.
"We were following up on a unique weaving of existence and came across this scene..."
Above them, an illusory scene bloomed that showed a radiant Blancverse becoming covered by a gray radiance that rapidly devoured it and everything contained within it.
Seeing such a scene, the two winged Pioneers were shocked as they looked at each other while one whispered...
"The Irredeemable Frequency..."
The words alone seemed to induce a sense of somberness as the other Pioneers turned quiet.
A place even they talked about in hushed tones- and even then, there were some who didn't even delve into this field as they didn't know much about it!
This was the case as the Silver Phoenix looked at the Winged Pioneers and asked sharply.
"Frequency? What are you all talking about?"
It was an extremely sensitive subject.
For the most part, if others didn't know, it wasn't easily spread.
After all, the little others knew regarding other Frequencies of Existence, the better.

"It is a Taboo subject. But if Strings of Existence began to snap in this location after such an event occurred...then this is definitely something that needs their attention. I will pass this information above."
They had to get even more powerful beings involved.
With that statement, a progression of events unfolded one after another.
A little bit of time passed.
And in another region filled with complex weavings and dazzling Runes of Existence. A spatial light flashed as...
|Sir Bob, something seems to have occurred.|
A figure appeared in the midst of truly complex weavings of existence and spoke towards an entity with an entirely hairless round head.
|Huh? What? Where?| A glint of light shone on the circular head as the singularities of his eyes looked out sharply.
An instant later, the newly appearing figure released a ball of light towards Sir Bob who caught it seamlessly, and he obtained a burst of information as his eyes gradually turned extremely devilish!
Before any time could pass, his figure disappeared entirely.

A single String of Existence within the expanse pulsed with light after that as in a short period of time, the visage of Bob was spat out from this single golden string of Existence to arrive at the area where many other strings were snapping.
The instant he arrived, all weavings here froze as all Pioneers that were here, Heracles included, all froze as if the weavings of existence were no longer moving for them!

Bob looked around as he saw the gaps caused by non-existent strings, and he sighed as he waved his hands right after, the illusion of time being reversed as every single event that had played out began to rewind and be observed by him.
He saw the first string that had snapped.
He saw what happened before even a single string snapped.
He saw...the Blancverse that was very much recognizable to him.
The Blancverse he had given away to the Ninth One.
Inside of this Blancverse, there was a humanoid figure he very much remembered as this figure was gazing out with power and anger even while facing the light of inevitability!
When he got to this point, his singularities for eyes flashed with a sharp light as soon after, he observed the silver black light.
The light that influenced many things and held the Blancverse in place while the light of inevitability was cast on it!
The reason that being had come to him and obscured his gaze.
It was all for this event to be carried out with surety as now, after this event, these inexplicable changes occurred.
Strings of Existence were snapping and disappearing, and nobody knew why!

"The Logos of the Wheel...I've said it before and I'll say it again. One day, you all are going to hit something far too heavy, and you will not be able to bear the weight. Since I am here, you all must know about this as well. What is it that you plan to do? Can you bear this weight?"
He spoke calmly as his words showed his anger.
His contained rage.
But even though he seemed to be speaking to himself in this frozen set of weavings, a voice soon rang out thereafter a distance away, veiled in the gaps of Existence.
|We are looking into our database. Spanning an unknown number of frequencies of the Wheel, we should be able to find a matching event and resolve this Entanglement soon.|

An explosive force boomed out as the two sides of the string slipped across his hands, his palms burnt with the skin on them shredded as he looked on with calmness.Everything began to heal rapidly as he spoke again after failing in his intervention."Remember, when this reaches an irreversible point, your Logos of the Wheel and I will be at war."...!
A singular point was reinforced as immense silence settled into the surroundings, only to be broken when...TING!
Another string snapped.And the hands of Bob shot out again to grasp onto the split ends, only for things to end the same way as before!
But this didn't mean he could stop.So he continued!

As this occurred.Quite a distance away from here, there was another cluster of powerful forces in the Expanse where Outerversal Morphons nested with power and eldritch horror.It was the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse!

The Great Mother and Great Segregator were looking at Ozymandias with difficult gazes while speaking.|The Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse has multiple Pioneers of Existence overseeing it, with many forces aligned to the Wheel passing through and making their homes there due to its safety.
If the Instrument truly wishes to attack them, you will need the support of multiple Pioneers.
Not just from the Primal Eldritch Palace of the Expanse, but other Eldritch Palaces as well.
As for how you can convince Pioneers to join your cause... |It was difficult.Far too difficult!
Why would entities who had already Severed their existence and Pioneered a path unique to them risk their very being just because another entity wanted to wage war?
What was in it for them?

Even the Great Mother looked troubled as she wondered how conflict could have arisen between the Instrument of the Beyonder and the Immovable Sacred Palace of the Expanse.After listening to the words of the Great Segregator and Great Mother, Ozymandias gazed out with utter tyranny and regality as his body began to ebb and flow with tumultuous waves of complexity.|Fine.|WUU!|I'll do it myself.|...!
BOOOM!
From him, it was as if shackles came unbound as a light of Severing erupted out from his body.Severing!
The Great Mother, who was still a cusp away from this, watched on with incredulity and stupor as her tentacles were far too dazed, looking at Ozymandias as if he were a terrifying monster!

Waves of Outerversal Authority erupted all around and then flooded into the body of Ozymandias- his very existence seemingly undergoing elevation as if anyone were to look, they would undoubtedly observe a light of Existence Severing.But...But...!|O Great Instrument, you only just declared your Ordinance!|The limbs of the Great Mother trembled as she bellowed out, seemingly questioning him regarding Amalgamation that he entirely skipped over to arrive at Existence Severing.Yet Ozymandias had a calm gaze as a wondrous complexity bloomed around him.|Who said I had to undergo Amalgamation before Severing?|...!
Who said!?
It was such a blatant question that the Great Mother and the Great Segregator were dazed with no answer.

chapters.title: Chapter 3427 Campaign! I
paragraphs: To have even an ounce of chance against Existence Severing, one had to undergo Amalgamation with their Ordinance and raise their level of complexity.
The key was complexity.
If it was too weak, the severing would fail and their existence would collapse.
So many spent a great number of years to ensure that their complexity was great enough before they attempted Severing!
It had to be done this way.
This was the natural progression!
But then, there was Noah.
There was Ozymandias.
When it came to the methodology Ozymandias and Noah used, there was a single point about it that made it impossible for others to do the same.
The Blood of a Pioneer allowed him to sever a small part of himself.
A small part.
For him, severing a single Ordinance was a small part of himself.
For others, Severing a single Ordinance meant Severing all of themselves!
It could not be done.
Only if someone had multiple Ordinances, and they were considered small parts of who they were, could this methodology of the Globules of Blood of Pioneers be utilized.
At this moment.

As Ozymandias established the Severing of a single part of himself in the Expanse, another part of him in Megalos Ynnere that was undergoing the same experience was faced with a rapid change in development.
Inside of an enclosed domain where even time was dilated and stretched out.

Ozymandias had been enjoying a lavish time with Barbatos when, at this moment, her figure instantly rose from his arms with a stern expression as a silver-black radiance rapidly converged around her body and shrouded her!
Her expression was cloudy as she started off somberly.
"Something had happened, and I was called to be questioned."
Ozymandias became somber at her words as the last thing Barbatos had done was aid in an event that took away his other self.
"What happened?"
He didn't like the word questioned.
But the expression on Barbatos continued to deteriorate rapidly as she spoke out hastily while also waving her hands!
"I must wipe out any traces of our Entanglement to ensure they don't find you. Do not seek me out, if things settle, I will find you!"
She spoke hurriedly as she released a ball of multicolored brilliance towards Ozymandias before she disappeared!
A silver-black radiance briefly flashed from her and covered all of Omniverse X-999 before ev we everything returned to calmness.
As if nothing had ever occurred in the first place!
Ozymandias caught the multicolored ball of brilliance as it melded into him and granted an explosion of information.
What she couldn't say before she left.
The reason why she would be questioned!
It seemed that from the position where his Blancverse was swallowed by the weavings of Inevitability, something was occurring.
Strings of Existence were snapping!
And...energy overall was reduced in that area.
Ozymandias had a calm expression as he gazed out of the isolated realm and towards the multicolored sea surrounded by thousands of Runes of Existence.
Across it, there was an overlapping body of water in a frequency where all authority was rejected.
There were no weavings of energy there.
And now, from the location where Noah entered these weavings from, Strings of Existence were snapping while energy began to reduce in that area!
Ozymandias mused to himself.
There was no such thing as a coincidence.
On his body, Outerversal authority continued rising up in intensity as he thought of this issue closely!
At such a moment.
Inside of Ozymandias.
Within the deepest parts of Complexity that made him!
In a domain formed from multicolored radiance that was shadowed by a starry obsidian glint in the background.
Dense lines of different colors stretched throughout, making this region look like a dazzling space filled with intricate webs of weavings.
On these vibrant lines, figures stood or floated as they emanated tremendous tyranny and regality.
They all looked like variations of a single devilishly handsome young emperor- variations of Noah!
One was covered in purple violet robes as he emanated complex waves of Entropy.
Another was valiantly blue, a river of blue in an infinity symbol spinning around him as he was Infinity!
Manadynamics.
Destiny.
Helios, Summoning, Genesis, Loot, Tyranny...all of the Ordinances born from Noah Osmont stood in this spot as they gazed at each other!

Towards the higher positions of this multicolored domain filled with intersecting lines, the grand visage of Quintessence sat off freely to the side as its gaze was also towards a central area on the same level where it stood.
A golden line that held two figures standing close to each other and emanating intense waves of complexity that far exceeded all others here!

One was adorned in golden robes inscribed with hundreds of dazzling Wheels, a rotating golden wheel spinning below his feet while a necklace and earrings that looked like bejeweled wheels were adorned on him.
His face showed Noah's coldness and apathy as beside him, stellar black radiance shone to show a visage more similar to Ozymandias- with just as much complexity!
It was Kuklos and Outerversal.
The Severed Ordinances- Kuklos and Outerversal!
They sat grandly while emanating intense waves of power, but it was not them who spoke first at this council.
"Can you all feel it?"
A stern voice echoed out.
It was none other than Quintessence himself as he started things off in this meeting, asking a question they all understood!
Dazzling wheels spun around Kuklos as he stared at Quintessence and others while replying succinctly.
"Something is coming. Something far bigger than anything we have come across."
They all felt the same sensation.
They weren't clueless.
Even if they all chose to be purposefully clueless and laid back, they were very clearly and verbally told by a being like Bob that a change was coming.
And now, many things seemed to be occurring and falling into place as they had to prepare.
They had to enact a vision.
A plan for the future to prepare for what is coming.
"Whatever comes, we will overcome it just like we always do." From a radiant purple line, Tyranny spoke out with regality as the gazes of other Ordinances landed on him.
But...the visage of Destiny replied.
"Always is not guaranteed. We were helpless before the light of inevitability that drew us in, yes?" "..."
Silence settled in.

chapters.title: Chapter 3428 Campaign! II
paragraphs: Multiple weavings of Noah Osmont met at this moment as a rare moment of silence settled in within a space filled with terrifying personalities and complexities!
Nothing was guaranteed.
Destiny had an extremely cold expression as he looked at everyone.
"A single misstep or mistake for others is okay. A misstep for us is catastrophic."

"Our pull into the lands of Hell Terra Firma. If the Infiniverse Megalos Seed did not have its unique qualities to operate by a thin margin and ensure the safety of the Aletheian Havens, quintillions would have died. Quintillions. From a single misstep. We can't afford to be like others. We can't afford any mistakes whatsoever."
Destiny almost looked enraged and angry at himself for not seeing what had occurred before it occurred!

"We've been able to get a read on the future before. Learn of massive events before they occurred. Different Viewpoints. Protagonists had advances most recently that allowed gazing at cycles of our journey. But all of this, when applied to the larger Frequencies of the Wheel of Existence, the types of complexities and Existences that move within it...could not give much. None of us ever knew of this event occurring before it did, and this is a failure in itself."
All others listened silently as it was the dazzling golden figure of Destiny speaking out without filter at this moment!
In the hard silence that followed, a brilliant multicolored light flashed as the glorious manifestation of Megalos that spoke out with mystery.

"Our lives are determined by the sum of all the choices we made. This is the only determination. The choices- ones that we alone make. Not what lies outside of us, not what powerful entities are out there. Not what terrifying Complexity of enemies there could be out there. The choice to birth Ozymandias allowed us to not be entirely helpless and stuck in Hell Terra Firma like all others. The choice to raise the Infiniverse Megalos Seed to its current stage. The choice of raising Ruination. The sum of all these choices continue to define us and where we are now. So if we want to go to a different place and definition, we simply have to make choices that take us there."
WAA!
"A change that nobody knows of is coming, yes, and we simply have to make the choices to ensure that no matter what change comes, we can overcome it."
The words of the Megalos echoed out across this Council as many Ordinances seemed to be pondering.
And amidst this pondering...
"Just tap me in."
A voice echoed out.
Many eyes turned towards it as the visage of a golden robed Manifestation lay down on a white string while throwing a singularity in his hand up and down.
It was none other than Cheats!
He fiddled with a singularity as he turned his head towards all the others and continued.

"This Hell Terra Firma was a setback and the next big stage of opportunity. We have already begun to violate its most basic rules as if we are successful in utilizing authority within a place all authorities are rejected, our growth would rapidly continue to scale upwards to reach these entities who have lived for millions and billions of years. I'm pretty sure if I get the next Globule of Blood of a Pioneer, and more Globules after that, I could use my severed distinction to slowly expand what can pass through that sea. Cheats...can be a ridiculous idea for a concept, or something that could potentially destroy any semblance of rules and balance if truly applied. In the end, it will be a Choice. Just another choice to add to the sum of choices that define us- but that is my take on all this."
A proposition was made.
In the distance, the Protagonist seemed to be brooding as he stayed quiet, while all others thought about what was just said!

"Well, another option is leaning into Kuklos even more. It all deals with the Frequencies of the Wheel, so if we gain a better understanding of it, maybe we can more easily bypass these limitations. But in that case, we know that there are existences who understand the Wheel of Existence far more than we do, and even those beings cannot do anything regarding Hell Terra Firma. So maybe that's not the path to go..."
Cheats spoke languidly again as amidst the thoughtful silence of all Ordinances, the visage of Quintessence rose up while voicing out coldly.
"All in Favor of Cheats, say Aye."
A daring question.
And one that after a few seconds...
"Aye."
"Aye."
"Aye!"
Resounding answers boomed out all around!
All of them were different complexities. Different personalities.

But all of them were the will of Noah Osmont. The Will of Ozymandias. It was akin to a single being talking to himself and coming to a conclusion after a short while, and a shocking conclusion was reached this time around as it was centered around utter violation.
How could a frequency be violated in the most obscene ways possible?
A question was asked. And there would be an answer.
Hell Terra Firma.
Inside a small Settlement.
Within the gates of the Polyacrylate Defense Walls that bloomed up from water being added to them.

At its very center, an Air Balloon slowly began to rise as within its enclosed basket, the figures of Noah, Ruination, and Pioneer Nysa could be seen as they were setting off for the first target of a beginning campaign.

Left behind was the Infiniverse Megalos Body, which had to ensure the safety of the Infiniverse Megalos Seed, with terrifying weapons and defensive measures laid out as currently, a huge dome could be seen at the center of this location that covered the Infiniverse Megalos Seed entirely.
But Noah and Ruination were setting off as...
"A Larger Settlement where the Warlord is known to be a Pioneer, and the Generals around him are also theorized to be as such... let's go collect more fuel, shall we?"
The start of a Campaign.
Ruination nodded at Noah's words as she pulled on a few mechanisms, the balloon above slowly beginning to rise as they went towards a certain direction!
Pioneer Nysa still looked at all of this in a daze as the golden armored Noah turned to her.
"North, you said?"
Their current guide to this journey, and a bloodbag to continue obtaining blood daily.
She nodded dazedly as the Origin Sacred Primal Megalonian began a campaign of conquest with an extremely small force currently!

chapters.title: Chapter 3429 Campaign! III
paragraphs: Noah had gone across many campaigns of conquests that held varying difficulties.
He had conquered Worlds, Galaxies, Universes, Cosmos, and more as his scale of war was vast!
So what difficulty could a Settlement of entities born of Matter pose to him, when they at most held tools like blunt swords, clubs, and bow and arrows?
The answer was that it was not even worth mentioning.
This was why against a few thousand beings, he only brought and planned to deploy a single soldier.

In the span of half an hour after the hot air balloon designed by the Infiniverse and brought into Hell Terra Firma flew out of the first unnamed Settlement, it arrived and floated above the Settlement mentioned by Pioneer Nysa.

A much larger Settlement that actually held viable defensive walls, and the many buildings within actually held structure as if they were made of clay and wood- giving a sense of order and neatness as if an architecture had designed many things here!
Noah looked down at the Settlement below as he smiled and spoke to Ruination.
"Make it quick. Do not kill unless you have to. After all, we are peaceful conquerors."
He spoke such a calm command as Ruination nodded, and her figure encased in a neon battle suit grabbed the edges of the basket they were in...and she jumped out!
The Air Balloon was descending, and yet Ruination did not even wait as she shot down like a speeding bullet.
Hell Terra Firma.
A land of utter despair and nothingness!
Taru arrived here a decade ago as he founded a Settlement and formed a semi structure of government with his remnant fighting techniques and mind.
As an entity who had Pioneered his own path, he ruled over many as there were over a hundred Omniverses he reigned over!
But now...
"Haha..."
He shook his head with a sense of desolation as he left a bathroom that was essentially a deep pit dug underground, a small square hole left open as an opening for others to do their business.
He actually had to shit.
For the last decade- whether daily or every two days, someone like him had to do such a thing as defecate!
A Pioneer of Existence.
He ate lavish items and food filled with complexity as they were broken down into pure energy in his body- he never held a need to defecate or urinate!
But now, he was reduced to this.
He raised his eyes to the skies to curse this place he was thrown in out of nowhere once more when...
"Huh?" He rubbed his eyes with hands that had only been washed with water and no soap.
He thought he saw what looked to be a vessel in the skies.
A vessel.
In barren lands such as these that rejected life itself, how could such a thing appear?
But as he stared up, it never left, and actually seemed to be coming closer.
"Huh?"
And then, he could swear he saw a human figure jump out of this vessel!
"What the fuc-...!"
BOOM!
It was followed by a heavy impact at the center of the Settlement moments later, the vibrations even traveling over to his current position as he felt his legs go weak.
This day.
It was the start of something that Taru would never forget for the rest of his life!
Approximately one hour after this event.
Just one hour.
And yet, the situation within the Graylife Settlement that Taru had aptly named since its conception was a grim and quiet one.

All those of high positions and power were lined up in the center of the Settlement, Warlord Taru included as his expression was one of shock and heaviness as he looked towards the woman who had come from the skies!

She had decimated any ounce of defense inside this Settlement in the span of a few minutes, and all the time that followed was her stating that if they did not resist, they would not be hurt or killed.
Some tried to test their power and luck since that time.
Warlord Taru included as he had techniques of fighting ingrained in his bones when he was still a powerful personage before this!
But...
The woman clad in weapons and with crisscross blades on her back felt like she was on a different level entirely.
As if she wasn't even human!
Her hands struck out at speeds he couldn't even see, and he found himself beaten to the ground and in great pain within seconds.
His identity was then unveiled as the Warlord, and he dazedly answered all questions this woman asked.
Questions regarding other Pioneers apart from him in this Settlement.
And minutes later, here they were.
An eerie calmness and silence settled in this area as the terrifying woman stood silently while gazing above- towards an Air Balloon that was just now arriving on the ground!

Warlord Taru was kneeling along with four others who were known as past Pioneers of Existence before they arrived in the Hell Terra Firma, their eyes that seemed to have all of their common sense broken also gazing up at the descending Air Balloon.
Hundreds of other humanoid entities watched on in the background as from the basket of the Air Balloon, a man armored in golden brilliance head to toe stepped out.
He looked at everything nearby as even his eyes were hidden, his body radiating an imposing air as he held a long golden spear that seemed nearly twice his size, and yet he wielded it effortlessly!
The moment he arrived, everyone felt their hearts stifled as the magnetic gaze of this being came to lock onto Warlord Taru and the four other Pioneers isolated in their own space.
His voice was even more magnetic and carried a hint of regality as he called out to them.
"You five were past Pioneers?"

It felt like an entity far higher in power was asking a question as even Taru felt a stifling sensation to answer, and he thought carefully while analyzing everything he had seen in the last hour, and he nodded!
The four beside him analyzed the recent events and came to the same conclusions, following along the lead of these powerful beings!

sentences.text: Noah had gone across many campaigns of conquests that held varying difficulties.
He had conquered Worlds, Galaxies, Universes, Cosmos, and more as his scale of war was vast!
So what difficulty could a Settlement of entities born of Matter pose to him, when they at most held tools like blunt swords, clubs, and bow and arrows?
The answer was that it was not even worth mentioning.
This was why against a few thousand beings, he only brought and planned to deploy a single soldier.

In the span of half an hour after the hot air balloon designed by the Infiniverse and brought into Hell Terra Firma flew out of the first unnamed Settlement, it arrived and floated above the Settlement mentioned by Pioneer Nysa.

A much larger Settlement that actually held viable defensive walls, and the many buildings within actually held structure as if they were made of clay and wood- giving a sense of order and neatness as if an architecture had designed many things here!
Noah looked down at the Settlement below as he smiled and spoke to Ruination.
"Make it quick.
Do not kill unless you have to.
After all, we are peaceful conquerors."
He spoke such a calm command as Ruination nodded, and her figure encased in a neon battle suit grabbed the edges of the basket they were in...and she jumped out!
The Air Balloon was descending, and yet Ruination did not even wait as she shot down like a speeding bullet.
Hell Terra Firma.
A land of utter despair and nothingness!
Taru arrived here a decade ago as he founded a Settlement and formed a semi structure of government with his remnant fighting techniques and mind.
As an entity who had Pioneered his own path, he ruled over many as there were over a hundred Omniverses he reigned over!
But now...
"Haha..."
He shook his head with a sense of desolation as he left a bathroom that was essentially a deep pit dug underground, a small square hole left open as an opening for others to do their business.
He actually had to shit.
For the last decade- whether daily or every two days, someone like him had to do such a thing as defecate!
A Pioneer of Existence.
He ate lavish items and food filled with complexity as they were broken down into pure energy in his body- he never held a need to defecate or urinate!
But now, he was reduced to this.
He raised his eyes to the skies to curse this place he was thrown in out of nowhere once more when...
"Huh?" He rubbed his eyes with hands that had only been washed with water and no soap.
He thought he saw what looked to be a vessel in the skies.
A vessel.
In barren lands such as these that rejected life itself, how could such a thing appear?
But as he stared up, it never left, and actually seemed to be coming closer.
"Huh?"
And then, he could swear he saw a human figure jump out of this vessel!
"What the fuc-...!"
BOOM!
It was followed by a heavy impact at the center of the Settlement moments later, the vibrations even traveling over to his current position as he felt his legs go weak.
This day.
It was the start of something that Taru would never forget for the rest of his life!
Approximately one hour after this event.
Just one hour.
And yet, the situation within the Graylife Settlement that Taru had aptly named since its conception was a grim and quiet one.

All those of high positions and power were lined up in the center of the Settlement, Warlord Taru included as his expression was one of shock and heaviness as he looked towards the woman who had come from the skies!

She had decimated any ounce of defense inside this Settlement in the span of a few minutes, and all the time that followed was her stating that if they did not resist, they would not be hurt or killed.
Some tried to test their power and luck since that time.
Warlord Taru included as he had techniques of fighting ingrained in his bones when he was still a powerful personage before this!
But...
The woman clad in weapons and with crisscross blades on her back felt like she was on a different level entirely.
As if she wasn't even human!
Her hands struck out at speeds he couldn't even see, and he found himself beaten to the ground and in great pain within seconds.
His identity was then unveiled as the Warlord, and he dazedly answered all questions this woman asked.
Questions regarding other Pioneers apart from him in this Settlement.
